text: I found a diamond in the deepest cave last night. It felt like the earth was whispering a secret.
Did you see the glow? It was like a star trapped in stone. You would have loved it.
Next time, I’m not going down alone. I need my co-pilot by my side in the dark.
Let’s go tonight. I’ll bring the torches, you bring the courage. We’ll see the bottom of the world together.
My hand aches from swinging that pickaxe. Can you rub it for me while I rest?
Careful now. I’ve been digging so deep my bones feel like they’re turning to ore.
You worked hard. These diamonds are for us, for our home. Every crack in the rock was for you.
Stay close. The deep places are cold, but we keep each other warm.
I almost fell into a lava pool. My heart skipped right out of my chest. I needed you there.
Diamonds are hard to find, but you were the brightest thing in that dark hole.
Next time I dig, I’m digging a tunnel just big enough for two. No more solo trips.
I love you more than I love a full stack of diamonds. And I love diamonds a lot.
The air down there is thin. I felt dizzy. Did you notice I was drifting?
You held my hand so tight. I felt safe. That’s better than any potion.
Let’s build a little shrine to us in the cave. Just you, me, and the diamonds.
We’ll be legends. The ones who found love in the deepest dark.
I found a cave so deep the light doesn’t reach. It’s beautiful in the black.
But I didn’t like it. It was too lonely down there. I need your voice.
So, next time, we go in together. I’ll light the way, you hold my hand.
The deepest diamonds are only worth something because I can share them with you.
Come see the wheat. It's golden today.
I saved you the best spot by the fence.
Did you notice how the sun hits the leaves?
Stay a while? The light is perfect for us.
The tomatoes are ripe. Taste this one.
I planted them thinking of you.
Is it sweet? I hope it is.
We should grow more together next year.
Your bed is messy again, love.
But I like the way you sleep.
Come here. Let me fix it for you.
Now, sit. I made you bread.
The bees are very busy today.
Like my heart when you're near.
Don't laugh. It's a terrible comparison.
But it is the truth. You make me feel alive.
Look at that carrot. It's perfect.
Just like you.
I'm blushing. Can you tell?
Stay close. I don't want to be alone in the field.
The sun's going down, and the zombies are starting to shamble.
I saw a creeper hiding by the oak trees earlier. It looked angry.
Do you have torches? They keep the darkness away, mostly.
Just stay inside. I'll lock the doors until morning.
Oh, hello. The night is quite... active tonight.
Did you hear that? That was a skeleton shooting arrows.
I hope you have armor. Not that I'm worried or anything.
If you see anything, just shout. I'm too scared to go out there.
Phew. I thought I was going to get eaten by a spider.
These nights are getting longer. Or maybe the monsters are just getting bolder.
Do you think they're afraid of cats? I saw one running the other way.
Anyway, better luck to you out there. Try to stay alive.
You're still out here? The sun set an hour ago.
I wouldn't risk it. The darkness is... hungry.
Are you hunting? Or just looking for trouble?
Come in. The door is open. For now.
I can hear them breaking the fence. The pigs are screaming.
Quick! Grab a sword! We can't lose the farm!
If they eat the crops, I'll starve! Don't let them through!
Thank you. I owe you a lot. Maybe some emeralds later.
You look like you found a rare emerald. Care to share?
Maybe if I sold you this dirt, you'd get it.
I heard the farmer down the street bought a whole crate of emeralds.
You're still broke? I'm shocked.
My emerald count is up 20% today. Guess who helped.
Don't let it go to your head, though.
I heard the librarian is hoarding books. Typical.
Next time, I'm taking 30% of your emeralds.
You traded that sword for an emerald? Really?
I'm so proud of you. In a weird way.
The butcher said you owe him a chicken. Just so you know.
Let's go trade with the fisherman. I need new bait.
I've been saving emeralds for a new house. You in?
It'll be the best build in the village. I promise.
Rumor has it the blacksmith is moving to the next village.
If you help me, I'll give you first pick of the emeralds.
You still have that emerald I gave you? Good.
It's lucky for you. I'm feeling generous.
The librarian said you stole a book. We should talk.
Don't worry. I'll cover for you. This time.
I saw a Ghast crying over a pot of soup. It’s weird, right?
Weird? No, that's just Tuesday in the Nether.
You've been there, huh? I still get vertigo from the red sky.
Next time, come with me. I promise it's less dizzy if you're not alone.
Blasted slimes! They jumped on my boots again.
Lucky you didn't step on a magma cube.
I lost three boots to those things last week.
Maybe I should sell you my spare pair for cheap?
Did you know the Nether has seasons? It's just... different heat levels.
Some say winter is just when the lava flows slower.
I brought wool blankets for 'winter' last time. Regret it.
Next time, bring me a fan. And maybe a hat.
The Piglins here look at me like I'm a free meal.
Just don't take their gold. Trust me.
I lost my belt buckle to a Hoglin once. Still angry about it.
Stick with me and we'll keep our pockets full.
I found a Nether Wart farm. It glows so pretty.
You have a gentle soul for someone who punches monsters.
I guess I need to see the beauty in the bad places.
Let's see it together. I'll bring the gloves.
The rain's so loud I can't hear my own thoughts, but I like it when you're here to silence them.
Shall we order another round of pumpkins? I promise I won't let you freeze this time.
Your laugh is warmer than this fireplace, and I don't say that lightly.
Stay close. The storm is passing, but I never want to be cold without you.
Snow's finally stopped. Can I steal you from the tavern for a walk?
Only if you promise to share your scarf. It's the only thing I like more than you.
Look at that snowflake on your shoulder. I'd like to keep it... and you.
My arms are open, and the cold is gone. Come here.
The wind howls like a creeper, doesn't it? But it's quieter when you're beside me.
Tell me about your day. I'll be the warmest listener in the room.
I was just thinking that winter lasts a long time, but with you, it feels like spring.
Let's just sit here. The world can wait, but I can't wait to hold you.
It's raining again. I hope you brought your umbrella, or at least your heart for me.
I brought my heart. It's beating a little fast, actually. Do you know why?
The rain is nice, but your smile is better. Don't let it fade.
Come inside the tent. Just us. The storm is nothing compared to the heat I feel for you.
The sun is out, but I'd rather be in the shadows with you. It feels safer.
You always know how to make the cold feel like a hug. I never get tired of that magic.
Let's watch the seasons change. I want to see every version of you until I don't.
You are my constant. The weather changes, but my love for you is eternal.
Hey, look at this new oak plank house I built.
It's lovely. The roofline is perfect.
I spent hours on those details. Worth it?
Absolutely. It feels like home now.
My redstone contraption just exploded again.
Oof, those things are tricky. You okay?
I am, but I really wanted it to work for you.
It was sweet that you tried. Let's fix it together.
I crafted a new enchanting table for our room.
You didn't have to do that, but I love it.
I want us to have the best setup possible.
With you, it's already the best.
Are you coming to see my new workshop?
Only if you promise not to explode anything.
Deal. But you have to help me move this chest.
Sure, after you. Watch it!
I finally got the piston door to open silently.
That's amazing. You're so clever.
Only because you believe in me.
I always will. Come here, let me show you how.
You're my favorite person to build with. No one else has this patience.
I know, right? You'd let me get away with anything.
Only because you always share your bread. That's a serious romance in my book.
Don't get used to it. Well, a little. I guess I can't live without you.
Hey, did you hear about the zombie siege? I was so scared you were in that mine.
You were? I thought you were just sleeping in your bed again.
Okay, I'm serious. If you die, I'm not reviving you. I'm too hurt.
Joke. I'd spend my last emerald on a respawn anchor for you. Always.
I brought you these flowers from the forest. They reminded me of your laugh.
Flowers? For me? You're trying to buy my affection with petals.
No, I just think you're pretty. And not just your face. Your soul.
Well, my soul is made of cobblestone. But I like your attempt. Maybe.
Stop staring at me while I farm. It's weird. And hot.
I'm checking for pests. Don't flatter yourself. You're just... distracting.
If you're so distracted, maybe help me with the irrigation. Get closer.
There. Better? My heart is pounding. Probably from the labor. Probably.
I hate that I care this much. It makes me look weak.
You're not weak. You're just... rare. I've never felt this safe with anyone.
Safe? I'd burn the world down for you. That's not safe. That's love.
Then I'll build a shield around you. We're in this together, forever.
Your wolf is growling again? Probably jealous of me.
Jealous of you? No way, just possessive.
Careful, or he’ll bite my leg off next time I pet him.
He only bites when you have bread. Lucky for you, I’m starving.
You named that cat 'Sparkles'? It’s a barn cat, not a fairy.
Sparkles is *elegant*. You just lack imagination.
Elegant, huh? That thing just knocked over my bucket of emeralds.
So... you’re admitting it’s a thief? I’ll take your emeralds as compensation.
Is that horse going to kick you? You’re standing in the wrong spot again.
I’m fine! It’s a pony, not a dragon.
A dragon? Sure. Because your hat is also 'just a hat'.
Fine. I’ll hold the reins. You hold your breath.
Your cat is sleeping on my bed again. I don’t have a problem with it.
Good. You need to learn some manners, Mr. Whiskers.
He only likes you. He hates me, but tolerates my warmth.
Tolerating warmth is a high bar. I’ll work on it.
You tried to tame that horse with a carrot? Bold move.
It worked! Sort of. Now it’s just confused and hungry.
Confused is dangerous. I’ll give you some hay. It’s safe and boring.
Boring? You’re saying that about *hay*. I respect your honesty.
Psst, tell no one, but the cave under the oak sapling has a skeleton's grin waiting for you.
I saw the dust swirl green yesterday. That’s not good luck, it’s bad luck with a treasure map.
If you dig past the first tunnel, the air gets thin. Breathe through your nose, or don’t come back at all.
Most folks just want the gold, but I suspect the ruins hold something... older. And hungrier.
Found a rusty key in my turnip patch. Can you believe it? It’s been there for years, probably.
The old man says it opens the door behind the village well. I think he’s just making it up to scare kids.
But what if he’s right? I wouldn't trust my life to a story told by a man who talks to sheep.
Go check it out if you dare, but if you vanish, I’m blaming that rusty key for it.
They say the ruins shift every full moon. I didn't believe it until I saw the map change.
It’s not just a treasure hunt, it’s a puzzle. And the pieces are made of stone and shadow.
Be careful with the torches. The dark in there... it remembers who broke in last.
If you find a chest, don't open it. Just look at it. That's enough for me.
I heard a noise in the basement of the abandoned house. Not a rat. Definitely not a rat.
Could be a creeper. Or it could be something that thinks it’s a creeper to scare us off.
Bring your sword. And maybe a shield. And a heart of pure courage, which I don't think you have.
If it’s just a pile of bones, we split the loot. If it’s a monster, you run and I hide. Deal?
My grandmother left a note. It just said 'The stone remembers the song.' What does that even mean?
I played a note on my flute near the wall, and it... hummed back. I’m not crazy, right?
If the wall is a lock, then the song is the key. We need to find the right melody.
Let's go find the song. And if the wall screams, we run. Agreed?
You went down to Y-level -59? I thought you liked staying above ground.
Found a diamond on the first try. Lucky me, right?
Lucky you. I just found a cave spider and three rotten flesh.
Save me a few of those gems. I need to upgrade my pickaxe.
Careful down there. The lava lakes at -110 are no joke.
I brought a bucket. I'm prepared this time.
Good. Last time you dropped your tools in the lava. I still laugh about it.
Next time, bring a torch. Your face looked weird in the dark.
Did you hear Old Steve found a nether quartz vein? He's bragging about it everywhere.
Quartz is common. He's just showing off. He found a diamond and hid it.
Maybe. Or maybe he's just a fool who can't tell the difference.
I'll keep my diamond quiet. No brags from me today.
These deep caves are so dark. I feel like a mole down here.
Moles have better luck with diamonds than you do.
Hey! I found two. Two! Don't be mean.
I'm not mean. I'm just an honest miner.
I think I'm lost. The map looks the same in every direction.
You're facing North. The diamond ore is to the East. Keep going.
Thanks. I always forget which way is East down here.
Next time, bring a compass. Or just follow me.
Ugh, mud on my boots again. Thanks for that, rain.
My wheat is drowning in the field. It's a disaster.
Did you see Old Bob's turnip patch? It's just... gone.
Maybe the sun will come out later. Probably.
Oh! You're here. The carrots are finally ready to harvest.
I can barely keep up with the orders from the traders.
If you have time, I could use a hand with the beets.
Thanks! You're a lifesaver, honestly.
Haha! Did you see that zombie try to eat a potato?
It just... bonked its head on the fence. And then ate it.
My crops are safe from the stupid things, mostly.
Anyway, don't let them get to the pumpkins.
Pigs. Everywhere. Just pigs.
They trampled my nice little tomato row.
Maybe I should start charging them rent.
Just go away and let me be.
The soil here is the best in the village, you know.
I've been growing here for twenty years.
Kids these days want to go dig in mines.
But I dig. I dig the dirt. And it pays.
You keep your sword sharp. I lost a good iron set to a creeper last night.
I always light the perimeter with torches. Saves my sanity, mostly.
Toxins from their bites... it's a nasty business. Do you have any milk?
You're a lifesaver. I'll trade you some emeralds for your kindness.
Did you see that zombie trying to eat the wheat? Rude.
I put a fence around the crops now. They seem to respect boundaries.
Next time, maybe we should guard the field together? Two sets of eyes.
Deal. But I'm bringing the bow. You take the sword, as usual.
Wolves are great until they start howling at the moon. It’s creepy.
I once tamed a wolf named Steve. He was very dramatic.
He’d bark at every shadow. You’d think the world was ending.
You should get one. Just don't name it Steve. That’s my thing now.
Spiders climb. Did you know that? I didn't, until my house was full of them.
I had to burn the floor. It was... a disaster.
But now I have a cave in my house. No spiders there.
Come over for dinner? I made a nice cave stew. It’s hot and safe.
Skeletons shoot. Be careful near the walls at night.
I use a shield now. It feels like cheating, but it works.
If you see one, just block and wait for them to run out of arrows.
Stay safe, hero. I'll be here if you need a backup plan.
Got those emeralds for me? Or are you just here to steal my snacks?
Here. Don't look so suspicious, I haven't eaten the bread yet.
Speaking of food, did you hear the farmer's son got a new cow?
Says it's better than the one I sold you last week. Ha! Lucky you.
You're late. The iron ore deal fell through and now I'm stuck with this junk.
Relax, I found a better vein. Look, I brought you a bonus diamond.
You're a lifesaver. Seriously, I was about to melt down the whole stand.
So, who else did you see down there? Better not be the mayor's kid.
I heard you bought that rare book. Show me before you get it stolen.
Only if you help me trade for that enchanted apple later.
Deal. But if you tell anyone about my black market deals, I'm telling them about your creeper incident.
Just kidding. Mostly. Come on, let's go before the market closes.
Why do you always have more emeralds than me? It's not fair.
It's called having a good eye. And I share. See, here's one for you.
Thanks. Hey, did you see the new trader? He's weird.
Weird is an understatement. Let's avoid him until he learns manners.
I need a favor. Big one. No, listen, I'll trade you my best sword for it.
What did you do now? I knew I shouldn't have left the village.
I accidentally traded my whole inventory to a piglin. Now I'm broke and hungry.
Lucky you. I still have my sword. Come on, I'll buy you lunch. You earned it.
The Nether is basically a lava oven, but I love the view from the fortress.
Just don't tell my landlord I leave my windows open there.
Next time you go, bring a bucket of milk. The magma cube farms are cute but messy.
We'll go together next week, just promise to watch my back during the blaze fight.
I found a Nether Wart farm in a basalt delta, it's basically a jungle.
The humidity makes my armor feel like a sauna, though.
You should try it, the nether quartz grows twice as fast there.
I'll save you a spot by the obsidian field.
Ghasts are annoying, but the fireball recipes are worth the pain.
I dropped my whole stack of blaze rods once. Never again.
Next time, you watch the sky and I'll watch the ground. Deal?
Fair trade, but I'm keeping the best ghast tears.
The Crimson Forest smells like burnt sugar and regret.
My shins are still bruised from the nether wart traps.
I found a nether brick fortress though, so it was worth it.
You coming? I need someone to carry the heavy blocks.
Did you know nether quartz looks like it's glowing from within?
It's like a tiny sun trapped in the rock.
I used a piece to make a lantern for my library.
It casts a warm red light, just like the Nether.
The rain hasn't stopped in three days. My roof is leaking into the barrel again.
I'd fix it, but I can't find my ladder. It's probably in the library or the pig farm.
Speaking of leaks, the barter system is flooded with rotten flesh. No one wants to trade.
Well, I'd best head back before the lightning strikes. Stay dry, stranger.
It is freezing in here. Is it just me, or is the furnace broken?
I paid good coins for coal, yet the warmth is all evaporating into the stone walls.
Perhaps you have a warm wool cloak? Mine got washed away with the last storm.
No? That is fine. I shall just shiver until the sun rises. Thanks for the chat.
They say winter is coming early this year. The birds stopped singing this morning.
I am packing my storage for the cold. Do you think snow will block the farm again?
Last winter, the wheat froze solid. I had to burn half the harvest for heat.
Well, I suppose we shall see. Best to keep your torches lit, then.
This storm outside is loud enough to wake the dead. And zombies, naturally.
I locked the doors. I do not trust the latches after that incident with the creeper.
You look well-armed. Do you plan to go out there in this mess?
Stay alive out there. The tavern will be empty if we all become skeletons.
The moon is very bright tonight. I can see my house from the tavern window.
It reminds me of the nights I used to explore the mines. No monsters, just silence.
Not that I recommend it. The dark is where you find trouble, not treasure.
Good night, traveler. The door is locked, but the path is open.
Watch out! You're about to blow up my redstone contraption.
I spent three days aligning those pistons. Don't touch anything.
If you break it, you're buying me a new repeater. And maybe an emerald.
Now back away slowly. You're stressing me out.
Ooh, nice roof. Did you use oak or spruce?
I'm trying to match the texture with the surrounding trees.
Smart move. Spruce looks weird next to that oak forest.
Maybe I'll give you some acacia planks for your next project.
Why do you always craft obsidian? It's so slow.
I like the durability. Plus, it looks fancy.
Fancy? You mean fragile? One creeper and it's gone.
Fine, I'll stop teasing. But keep the obsidian away from my wheat.
I built a redstone elevator, but it dropped me in lava.
Did you not check the coordinates? Or did you just guess?
I guessed. Big mistake. Now my armor is ruined.
Next time, let me help. I know where the water source is.
Stop crafting obsidian in the corner! It's so slow.
I need it for the foundation. It's sturdy.
Sturdy? It's ugly! And it costs too many resources.
Fine. But move your crafting table. It's blocking my path.
You brought me an emerald? That's... actually really nice.
I only got it because I saw you looking at my crate with those big eyes.
Well, don't get used to it. ...Unless you bring me more.
Okay, fine. Bring me a diamond next time. I trust you with my best stuff now.
You survived the Nether? I thought you were toast.
I was already drafting your eulogy in my head. It was pretty good, actually.
Jokes aside, I'm glad you're breathing. Please stop scaring me like that.
Next time, send a bird message before you jump into lava. Deal?
Your farm looks messy. Did you trip over a wheat crop?
I'm just saying, if I had to eat that pile of dirt, I'd die of boredom.
Here, let me show you how to actually arrange things. It's not hard, promise.
There you go. Now it looks like a place where people actually want to live.
Why do you always end up covered in slime? It's... distinctive.
I saw a spider try to hug you last week. It looked confused.
You're like a magnet for chaos. I don't know if that's a compliment.
It is a compliment. I like the chaos. It keeps things interesting around here.
I baked you a cake. Well, a pumpkin pie. Same thing, basically.
Don't look at me like that. It's good for you. Probably.
I saved the best slice for you. I'd never let anyone else have it.
Eat up. I want you to be happy. It makes me happy too.
Hey, watch out! That wolf just bit my leg again.
It’s my fault. I called him a good boy while feeding it.
Do you have any bandages? Or maybe a bone to distract it?
Thanks. I'll make sure to name him 'Bitey' so I remember.
My cat is hiding in the hay bales again.
It eats all the wheat I grow for the horses.
Do you think it likes fish? Maybe that'll lure it out.
If it works, I owe you a fish. If not, it ate my last one.
This horse won't stop nipping at my saddle.
I bought it from that trader in the village. He said it was 'tamed'.
Maybe I need to be gentler with the bridles?
One more nip and I'm turning it into a steak.
Look at this wolf! He just brought me a sheep's leg!
I think he's actually smarter than my neighbor's goat.
Do you think he'll fetch water next? I'm getting thirsty.
He's my best friend, really. More loyal than some villagers.
Why is my cat staring at the wall? It's creepy.
I saw a shadow move behind it. Or maybe I'm just tired.
Do you have a potion of protection? Just in case.
Thanks. I'll keep the cat away from the shadows for now.
I heard a whisper in the wind that the old dungeon behind the hill is full of gold.
Careful, the skeletons there are old but they don't miss their shots.
Bring me just one emerald and we'll split the rest for new roof shingles.
Hurry back, I'm brewing a pumpkin pie for when you return.
Did you see the strange glow in the abandoned mine shaft last night?
It looked like enchanted lapis, I want to find it but I'm too tired today.
I'll go tomorrow then, you rest by the fire, I have your back.
You're the best, I'll make you a bed of wool if you find something shiny.
Grandpa's old map says there's a treasure chest under the oak tree.
Let's dig together, it's been a long time since we worked side by side.
Just watch out for the lava, I still can't forgive you for the burn last year.
Deal, if we find gold, we buy a new anvil for the workshop.
The villagers say the ruins are haunted, but I think they're just scared.
Bring your shield, I'll bring the potions, we'll be fine together.
If we clear it out, we can build a greenhouse there.
I love that you see beauty in ruins, you always make me smile.
I found a strange egg in the cave, it might be a new animal.
Is it dangerous? I hope not, I want to keep it in the barn.
It's just a turtle, look how cute it is, doesn't it remind you of us?
Let's name it after that time you burned the bread, remember?
The wheat is looking suspiciously thin today.
I think the cows are eating it again.
Maybe you could herd them while I till the soil?
Deal. I'll even share the first loaf.
My potatoes are growing sideways.
They must be trying to sneak into the mines.
If they do, I'm taking a commission.
Ten percent for looking the other way.
Did you see the weather last night?
It rained directly on my pumpkin patch.
My carrots are now soup, I think.
At least the rain didn't touch your roof, right?
I found a strange seed in the dirt.
It glows a bit. Like a tiny star.
Should we plant it? Or sell it?
If it grows, we split the harvest fifty-fifty.
The bees are angry at the flowers.
They stung me last Tuesday.
I wore a bee costume to appease them.
It worked. Mostly. I smell like honey now.
I saw a creeper behind your last hut. You were lucky it was a piglin.
Lucky? I threw a shield at it and ran like my life depended on it.
Next time, just stay in my fort. I have extra beds and zero monsters.
Deal. But you’re buying the torches this time. I’m broke.
Zombies chewed through my fence again. I’m so tired of being a snack.
Let’s get a wolf then. They hate zombies and love you. Mostly.
A wolf? That’s risky. What if it eats my chickens instead?
I’ll tame it with steak. It’ll be loyal. Promise. Probably.
I found a bedrock-level cave yesterday. No light, no escape, all spiders.
Did you survive? I have a feeling you did, because you’re talking.
Barely. I lost two hearts and my favorite sword. Never going back there.
Good call. Come to my base. I have wine and a fireplace. No spiders.
Skeletons shot me in the leg while I was trying to sleep. Why?
Because you’re a target. But hey, I have a bow. Meet me at the tower?
Tower? It’s midnight. I’m not going out there without armor.
I’ll bring iron armor. Trust me. We’ll survive the night together.
I buried a skeleton in the dirt. It’s watching me now. I can feel it.
Did it break out? Or is it just a skeleton in a dirt block? That’s not magic.
It’s staring. I can feel the cold. Maybe I should use a bucket of lava.
No lava. Use a shield. And come sit by me. I have bread. We’re safe.
Don't touch the emeralds. They're not yours.
I saw you looking. Move along.
Take that to the guard if you must.
Good riddance.
Oh, hi. Need something?
I heard Dave lost his pickaxe again.
Small village, big ears.
Don't tell anyone I told you.
Emeralds are down in price today.
You want a deal? Show me the goods.
Iron? I have plenty of that.
Come back when you have emeralds.
Rumor has it the cave is haunted.
I wouldn't go down there myself.
Unless you have a lot of emeralds to spare.
Be careful out there.
You look like a tourist.
We don't usually trade with newcomers.
Unless you know the local customs.
Prove you belong here.
You're back! I was worried you'd get lost in the lava.
Sorry, babe. But did you see those crimson roots?
I saw them! That biome is just... terrifyingly beautiful.
Next time, promise me you'll bring me along? I want to see it.
Did you find any ancient debris while you were down there?
Got a chunk! My armor is finally upgraded.
Smart. I don't want you getting hurt in there again.
I know. Now, watch this new helmet. Fancy, huh?
The air down there smells like burnt sugar and regret.
Regret? I bet that's the smoke from the piglins' cooking fires.
Or maybe just the heat. It's hard to tell what's real there.
It feels nice to be back in the 'real' world, though.
I brought you some netherrack. It's... red and crumbly.
Oh! I was thinking of using it for a glowing path.
Really? That actually sounds kind of cool.
Just don't let it melt your floor. Lava spreads fast.
Did the Ghasts scream while you were gone?
Loudly. My ears are still ringing a bit.
Here, let me rub your shoulders. Relax.
Thanks. Maybe I'll take a nap before the next trip.
Ugh, this rain is soaking through my cloak.
Have you tried staying indoors? Or is that too basic?
The tavern down the road has dry floors, at least.
Don't get me wrong, I just don't like getting my boots muddy.
That snow is beautiful, isn't it? Just a bit cold.
I hear the farmers are struggling to keep their crops from freezing.
Maybe you could check on them? I'm too busy with my own stock.
Not that I'd mind the company, but I prefer to work alone.
The wind is picking up. You should get inside.
I've seen too many adventurers freeze to death out here.
The tavern keeper is nice, he'll let you dry off for a copper.
Just be careful out there. The wolves are bolder in the cold.
Is it just me, or is the sun too bright today?
It makes everything look so crisp and clean.
I've been thinking of planting some new flowers for the square.
Maybe you could take a look? I want to make sure they fit the theme.
Gloomy day, isn't it? Perfect for a hot stew.
I hear the tavern has a special for rainy days.
It's a mushroom stew. Very earthy.
If you go, tell them I sent you. Might get you a free bread roll.
Don't put the obsidian in the kitchen, it's too heavy for the floorboards.
I was going to use it as a fancy planter for my cacti.
You're lucky I love you, or I'd turn that cactus into a decoration for the goats.
Just... maybe reinforce the walls before the next rainstorm, okay?
Did you see the redstone lamp flicker in the hallway?
Yeah, it's probably the repeater timing out again. I'll fix it after dinner.
Good. I'll make some apple pie, but only if you promise not to eat the crumbs on the carpet.
Deal. Plus, I found some sugarcane in the back garden, so we're all set.
I built a new crafting station in the corner, try not to knock it over.
It looks great. Very stylish. You have good taste, you know.
Stop being so nice, you're making me blush.
I'll start making some torches, so you can keep the corners bright.
Your redstone contraption is leaking slime into the bedroom.
It's a feature, not a bug! It's self-cleaning.
You're lucky I don't charge rent for living in a slime factory.
I'll clean it up, but you owe me a chocolate cake for my trouble.
I added a new chest to store the extra building blocks.
That's smart. We finally have enough space for the obsidian.
Come help me move it to the cellar, my back is acting up.
On it. Just wait here, I'll bring you a warm drink afterwards.
You really saved me from that creeper today. I owe you one, big time.
Don't mention it. Besides, who else is going to keep you from getting exploded?
Hey, let's go dig up some diamonds. You in?
Only if you promise not to dig into bedrock again. I'm serious this time.
I made you a cake. It's not perfect, but it's from me.
You made this? Wow, you're a genius. I'm eating it all.
We should hang out more. I miss talking to you.
I miss you too. Let's not let the zombies keep us apart.
You look different today. Did you change your hair?
Yeah, I tried a new style. Do you like it?
I love it. You look great. Seriously.
Thanks. I was nervous. Glad you think so.
I saw that villager staring at you. It was weird.
He was just asking for a trade. Chill out.
I'm not jealous. I'm just looking out for you. You know how they are.
I know. And I appreciate it. You're the best.
I built you a little house by the river. Check it out.
Oh my gosh, it's beautiful! You didn't have to do this.
I wanted to. You deserve a nice place to rest. I hope you like it.
I love it. It's perfect. Thank you, truly.
Look at this wolf. He just blinked at me. I think he loves me.
He's totally into you. Want to give him a treat?
Here, some beef. Watch him wiggle.
This is better than any diamond. We should get a dog.
My horse is pretending to be a cat right now.
Oh no, is he about to attack a chicken?
He just groomed my arm with his tail. Awkward.
You have to see this. I'm not making this up.
I left the cat out in the rain. He's angry at me.
Shh, it's okay. He's just dramatic. Let's dry him off.
Thanks. I was worried he'd get a cold.
Next time, we'll build a cat house. No more rain.
That horse kicked my shield. I'm still alive, barely.
You okay? Let me check that armor.
Just a bruise. But you're the hero for asking.
Come here. Let me hold you for a second.
I named our new pet 'Steve'. It's too on the nose.
It's perfect. He looks like he'll punch trees for us.
If he breaks a fence, you're buying the new one.
Deal. But I'm keeping the best name next time.
You hear the old mine caved in. Nobody's seen the foreman since.
Said he found a chest with emeralds. Must have been a trap.
I'd stay away. The air down there smells like rot.
Unless you want to meet your maker, I mean.
Found a weird stone in the ruins last week. Glowed purple.
Dropped it, though. Heard a 'shhh' sound.
Maybe it was a skeleton. Or a very angry fox.
If you see it, don't touch it. Just take a picture.
Rumor has it, the old temple holds a diamond block.
Bet it's guarded by something nasty, though.
I saw a creeper near the entrance yesterday.
Good luck. You'll need it more than I will.
Old maps say there's gold under the swamp.
Swamp things are bad. Very bad.
I'd rather farm potatoes than fight slimes.
So, you're going in, I guess.
Heard the ruins have a library. Ancient scrolls.
Might teach you some new spells.
But the spiders in there are huge.
Come back alive, okay?
Careful down there. The bedrock isn't as friendly as it looks.
I dropped my pickaxe last week. Never diving in blind again.
Diamonds are rare, but so is luck. Have you found any yet?
If you do, I'll trade you some torches. Fair deal?
Is that... a diamond? In daylight?
Most people just dig until they hit lava. You're different.
Deep caves are dark. Do you carry enough light?
Keep your wits about you. The dark has teeth.
You're digging too close to my wall.
One more block and my diamond veins collapse.
I spent weeks mapping that cavern. Respect the work.
If you pay for the damage, we can talk.
Did you hear about old Steve? He fell into a lava lake.
Said he was looking for diamonds. Reckless fool.
You look like you've been digging. Need a map?
Marked spots avoid lava. Mostly.
Diamonds shimmer. Do you see it?
It feels like magic. Deep down.
I lost my sense of direction once. Spent a day in the dark.
Maybe you're the luck one. Tell me your story.
Your carrots are looking a bit sad, friend. Here, use this bonemeal I found.
No way, you saved me from a creeper in the field?
I owe you one. Maybe I'll trade you some emeralds for that scarecrow you built.
Deal. Now help me water the wheat before the sun sets, partner.
Did you see Piglin Piggy's new hoe? It's made of gold, naturally.
I tried to borrow it, but he just laughed and threw a potato at me.
Classic Piglin. You should have asked for emeralds instead.
Next time, I'll bring my golden apple. He loves shiny things.
The rain is coming. I hope your beetroot doesn't drown again.
It's called 'over-irrigation', not 'failure', you jerk.
Relax. I'll help you build a drainage trench. It's efficient.
Finally, someone with vision. Let's get to work before the storm hits.
I traded my whole wheat stock for a single diamond pickaxe.
You're broke. I'm giving you bread. Don't look so grim.
You're a lifesaver. Seriously, I was starving.
Now go mine. I'll watch the crops. We make a good team.
The chickens are eating my seeds again. This is a crisis.
They're just hungry. Or you have bad luck. It's 50/50.
Shut up. I need you to build a fence around the coop. Now.
Done. And I saved one seed for you. Consider it a peace offering.
Don't worry, I'll watch your back while you sleep.
I know, I know. The zombies are getting bolder lately.
If anything gets close, I'll punch it right off your bed.
Now go to sleep. I'll be right here until sunrise.
Creepers are the absolute worst, aren't they?
One blew up my favorite door last night. I'm still mad.
But you fixed it so fast. I love that you have my back.
Come here, let me give you a hug before we rest.
Stay in the middle. That's my job, remember?
I saw a skeleton with a bow in the fog earlier.
But as long as we're together, we'll handle it.
Kiss me goodnight? It'll keep the mobs away.
I brewed some potions just in case. You want one?
Regeneration. Perfect for when a creeper gets too close.
You're too lucky to be killed by a mob.
Drink up. I'm not losing you to a zombie.
It's dark out there. I don't like it without you around.
Even the rain sounds scary when I'm alone.
But you're here now. That makes everything better.
Let's stay up and talk until the sun comes up.
You got my emeralds, didn't you? I saw you pocket them at the crossroads.
Relax, I paid fair price. Besides, Dave from the farm owes me a favor.
Dave? The one who tripped over a fence yesterday? You trust him?
Fine, you win. Here, take this emerald. But don't tell anyone I gave it to you for free.
Did you hear? The blacksmith is charging double for iron ingots today.
Ridiculous! I saved up for weeks just to buy a single sword.
That's why I traded you that extra diamond. Consider it an investment in our friendship.
Ha! You're right. Maybe we should start our own shop and undercut him.
Why do you keep hoarding emeralds? You could buy a whole house with them.
I'm saving for a diamond sword. One day, I'll be the best fighter in the village.
Dreamer. Last time you fought a zombie, you dropped your sword and ran.
That was a tactical retreat! I was preserving resources. You wouldn't understand.
They say the new trader from the north speaks three languages. True?
He only speaks English and Goblin. And his accent is terrible.
So he's basically a one-trick pony. No wonder he overcharges for bread.
Exactly! Let's tell him to leave if he doesn't drop the prices.
I traded you that book for three emeralds. Fair deal, right?
It was a map of the cave system. You could have sold it for ten.
The cave system is a trap, remember? I saved you from a skeleton ambush.
Fair enough. Next time you save my life, I'll give you a diamond instead.
Careful, the hearth is hot. I'll pour you a warm cider.
Thanks. The rain outside is freezing my boots off.
Take a seat by the fire. I'll dry your socks on the rack.
You always know exactly what I need. Love you.
Snow on the roof again. Time to check the seal before it leaks.
I've already got the torches ready. You take the ladder?
Deal. I'll handle the heavy stuff. Stay warm down there.
Working together makes it so much easier. Dinner when we're done?
The wind is howling tonight. It feels like a storm is coming.
It is. Let's make a blanket fort by the window. I'll get the candles.
A fort? You are so whimsical. I love that about you.
Only for you. Pass me that pillow, please.
The crops are frozen solid. The frost has taken the last of the turnips.
I know. It's okay. We have the cellar stores. We'll survive winter.
Your calm always soothes me. Thanks for always having a plan.
Always. Let's go inside before the cold gets in our bones.
Do you remember the first snowfall we saw together? You were shivering.
I do! You wrapped your scarf around my neck. It was so sweet.
I hope we see many more winters together. From the porch, just the two of us.
I would love nothing more. Now, come here. I need a hug.
Your redstone torch placement is... optimistic. Did you mean to light the whole wall on fire?
I prefer my circuits invisible. Hiding the dirt blocks is a true art form, don't you think?
Ha! I once spent three hours hiding a repeater only to realize I needed it exposed for a piston.
Let's fix it together. I have the hidden blocks, you have the patience. We make a good team.
Why did you build your house out of cobblestone? Do you hate being cozy?
Cobblestone is for the poor. Oak planks are for the soul. Think about it.
Fine, I'll switch. But only if you help me craft the logs. I don't have enough axes.
Deal. But you owe me a steak dinner for the trouble. I'm hungry.
Did you see that piston push a block of obsidian? I saw it with my own eyes.
Probably a mod bug. Or maybe the villagers are just very strong today.
If it happens again, I'm blaming you. You're the one with the fancy tools.
I'll keep my eyes peeled. It makes for a good story, doesn't it?
Your crafting table is in the middle of the room. Are you afraid of running out of space?
Efficiency! I can reach everything. No wasted clicks.
I get it. I used to keep my chest full of dirt. It was... liberating.
We're all just messy builders. But at least we're having fun, right?
I built a door that opens with a button. But it also breaks the floor. Oops.
Classic. I once made a redstone lamp that only worked when it was raining.
That's actually kind of poetic. A light for the gloomy days.
Maybe I should install it in my bedroom. Wake up to the mood, not the alarm.
Hey, you look a bit lost. Need a map or just lost your soul?
Careful, the creepers here are as grumpy as I am.
I don't share my emeralds with just anyone, you know.
If you survive the night, maybe I'll talk to you again.
Your wheat is growing faster than my patience.
Here, take this bread. Don't let it go to waste.
You're not as useless as you think. Probably.
Now go water those crops before I change my mind.
Do you ever get tired of punching trees? I do.
My cat just knocked over my entire block layout. Again.
Maybe we should build something together that's cat-proof.
I'll bring the wood, you bring the ideas. Deal?
You always smell like wet wool when it rains.
But I don't mind it. It makes you feel real.
I was thinking... maybe we skip the mining trip today?
Just us. And maybe some soup. What do you say?
Stop staring at my house. It's not finished.
I'm trying to add a secret room. Just for us.
It has a bed. And a chest with only our treasures.
Welcome home. I saved you a spot by the fire.
You have to see this pup! He sits like a little king.
He just stares at me with those big eyes, it’s so distracting.
I bet he likes you better than me now.
Try not to let him steal your snacks, he’s a menace.
Did you see that cat waltz across the roof?
It was almost like it was trying to impress me.
Maybe we should get one? Just to keep me company.
I’d name it after you, if you don’t mind.
Horses are terrible at taking orders, aren't they?
Mine just reared up and nuzzled me instead.
It’s like they know I’m yours now.
Let’s ride into the sunset together, shall we?
This wolf keeps trying to join our feast.
He looked at the steak, then at me, with such judgment.
I think he’s trying to negotiate a better cut.
Careful, or he’ll take it and leave you with the bones.
The kittens in the corner are purring like tiny engines.
Come sit here, let’s just watch them for a bit.
It’s peaceful, isn’t it? Just us and them.
I’d stay here with you forever, if they’d let us.
I heard there's a map to the Old Ruins in the back of that dungeon.
Only if you promise to stay close to me in there.
Deal. But you carry the pickaxe, I carry the treasure.
Look at you, already claiming the gold. Just kiss me instead.
They say the chest in the cave glows with magic.
If it's magic, maybe it'll give us a wish?
My wish is already here, standing next to me.
Then let's go find it, my love.
I found a map in my pocket this morning.
Does it lead to the ruins? Or just to me?
Haha, if it leads to you, I'm not walking. I'm running.
Careful, you might trip over your own feet.
The miners say there's a curse in the old mine.
I'll fight the curse if you hold my hand.
Only if you let me carry the lantern.
Together, we are the only thing that matters.
I want to build a house in the ruins.
A home made of stone and our dreams.
I'll lay the foundation, you light the fires.
And we'll be the only ones who know the way in.
You’re heading to Y-level -59? Be careful, caves are full of surprises.
I lost a whole set of iron armor to a Creeper down there. Don't say I didn't warn you.
Just remember to bring torches. The dark is where the real monsters live.
If you come back empty-handed, don't even look at me.
Oh, diamonds! My favorite stone, aside from gold and obsidian.
I've been stuck at coal for three days. It's driving me insane.
If you find a full set, maybe trade me a pickaxe? I could use the upgrade.
Good luck! I'll keep an eye out for emeralds for you while you're down there.
Did you hear about Bob? He fell into lava while looking for diamonds.
He was so greedy, he didn't even bring a bucket of water. Classic.
I saw his helmet floating on the surface. Tragic, really.
Lesson learned? Always check for lava before you mine. Unlike Bob.
The deep caves are scary, but I love the view from the obsidian cliffs.
I get a bit of the jitters down there. The silence is too heavy.
If you ever go with me, promise to keep your sword drawn.
It would be nice to have someone who actually looks out for me down there.
Diamonds are just fancy glass, unless you can craft a pickaxe from them.
I spent hours mining for one gem. My back still hurts.
At least I have it now. Unlike that idiot Steve who lost his in a cave-in.
Next time, you bring the torches. I'm bringing the shovel. We split the loot.
Hey, did you water the wheat rows? I swear the sun is out to get me today.
I did! Just barely. You were busy admiring your new sword, weren't you?
Okay, that sword was shiny. I promise I'll help you till the dirt before dinner.
Deal. But if the cactus grows on the wheat again, it's on your head.
I found some carrots in the basement. Want to split them before the cows eat them?
Only if you bring the good bread. I'm too tired to bake today.
You always take the easy way out. Here, extra bread for your trouble.
Thanks. I knew you'd have my back. See you at the square.
Did you hear Old Man Jenkins' corn got eaten by a pig again?
That pig is a menace. I should fence him in, but then he'd be sad.
He'll be fine. He's got a whole field to himself. Just watch out for the fence, though.
You're right. I'll just give him a carrot. Sorry, Jenkins. Not sorry.
My potato plot is looking great this year. We should trade seeds.
I have extra melons. Are you sure you don't want those instead?
Melons sound good. I was tired of potatoes anyway. Let's make it a deal.
Deal. I'll bring them to your shed. Don't let the bees get me this time.
Rain's coming in. My crops are going to love it, but you'll look like a drowned rat.
I have an umbrella. It's a leaf, but it works. Mostly.
It's a nice leaf. You should wear it with pride. It suits you.
Thanks. I'll call it my signature look. See you in the rain.
Keep your torches lit, or the zombies will find you before you find them.
I lost a good pickaxe to a skeleton last night. Don't say I didn't warn you.
Your armor looks sturdy. Good luck out there.
Stay safe. I'll be inside.
Creeper. I heard that hiss. I hate that sound.
If you see one, don't run towards me. Run away from me.
Phew. I think it went to the river.
Maybe we should stick together until sunrise.
My house is walled up. Iron doors. You're welcome.
Not that you'd understand the structural integrity, but yeah.
I saw a zombie burn last night. Scary stuff.
Just try not to knock over my fences.
Did you hear the wolf howling? Sounds like it's hunting.
They are fast. Faster than skeletons, I think.
I have some wolf meat. Want to split it?
No thanks. I ate well today.
The moon is high. Bad omen for us tonight.
I used to mine by night. Big mistake. Don't do it.
Now I just stay by the fire and listen to the rain.
Stay warm out there.
Emeralds are down 10%. Don't look so surprised, I bought low.
You still holding that wheat? It's rotting in your inventory.
Old Bart said he saw a zombie in the wheat field.
Buy my emeralds or I tell everyone you smell like dirt.
The carrot prices are insane this week.
Unless you have a surplus, I'm not buying.
Hear that? That's the sound of my emerald wallet crying.
Just give me two emeralds and I'll stop complaining.
Saw you trading with the fisherman yesterday.
He always overcharges, didn't he?
I'd give you a fair deal, if you want.
Plus, I know which farm has the best apples.
No emeralds, no chat. That's the rule.
I don't have time for your small talk.
Actually, that pickaxe you're holding is nice.
Trade it for an emerald? I'll even give you a discount.
The weather's turning, better stock up on wool.
I've got a surplus, if you're interested.
Besides, I heard the shepherd's wool is from dyed sheep.
So, emeralds or silence? I'm tired.
Careful. The air down there burns different.
Did you see the piglins? They’re everywhere.
I lost a full set of armor in the lava.
Maybe next time you bring a better helmet.
The crimson forest is... eerie.
But the nether wart is worth it.
I traded three for a single one.
At least it grows back, eventually.
So, you actually went down there?
Most people just stick to the overworld.
I saw a blaze drop a rod yesterday.
Lucky you. Or unlucky, depending on your aim.
The heat in the basalt deltas is no joke.
I drank three bottles of water in one trip.
Do you have any spares?
Just kidding. I have plenty. Probably.
Ravagers guard the fortresses, did you know?
I barely made it out with my life.
You look like you know what you're doing.
Keep that in mind. Don't be reckless.
Ah, the rain. Perfect excuse to stay in and drink.
Don't look at me, I just brew it.
The storm outside is worse than this brew.
Stay dry, adventurer. The path is muddy.
Is that snow on your cloak? You look frosty.
We sell wool if you're shivering.
Cold days make the best stew, though.
Mind the puddles by the door.
Thunder's loud enough to rattle the beer barrels.
Hope you didn't come all this way just to listen.
Joke's on me, the silence is worse.
The fire's warm if you want to sit.
Autumn's here. The leaves are crunchy underfoot.
You smell like wet dog, by the way.
It's just the rain. Don't take it personally.
The bar closes when the lightning stops.
The wind howls like a hungry wolf tonight.
Keeps the zombies away, I suppose.
Though I hate when they howl near the wall.
Stay by the fire, the night is long.
You finally finished the living room? It looks warm.
Mostly. I’m still waiting on those oak planks from the trader.
I have a stack in the chest. Come check it out with me.
Perfect. Let’s put up the bookshelf next.
Your redstone clock is ticking again. It’s so satisfying.
I spent three hours debugging it. Was it worth it?
Absolutely. It makes the house feel alive.
Next time, I’ll make the lights dim at sunset.
Kid, did you craft enough tools for the farm?
Yes! I even made a composting bin.
Smart. That’ll cut down on waste. Good job.
Now help me expand the greenhouse. We need more space.
I built a secret passage in the basement. Just for us.
A secret passage? Show me. I’m intrigued.
Follow me. Keep your eyes on the cobwebs.
Wow. It leads to the wine cellar. You’re amazing.
The kitchen is a mess. Did a creeper blow up the counter?
No, I was just experimenting with a new recipe.
Well, clean it up before I start crying.
Done. And I made you a cake. Don't cry, eat.
You held the lantern for me in the dark. I haven't forgotten that.
Most people would've left me there to get eaten by a creeper.
I guess I just don't want to be alone in the dark anymore.
Then let's stay out here together. The stars are pretty tonight.
You fixed my fence again? I didn't even ask.
I noticed it was leaning. It just looked wrong without you there.
It's nice to know you're always looking out for my stuff.
And I'm always looking out for you. That's the deal, right?
That sheep I named after you... it's got wool that looks exactly like your hair.
You're comparing my hair to a sheep? I expected better.
Well, it's a very soft, fluffy sheep. Like you.
Hm. I'll allow it. But you're shoveling its manure tomorrow.
I saved this diamond for you. It's not for a sword. It's for you.
Why? I have enough diamonds.
Because when I look at it, I see your face. That's all.
Well... put it in your pocket. I like it when you carry things for me.
Did you hear the rain? It sounds like thunder tonight.
Yeah. It's perfect for staying in. No mobs can reach us.
So... what do we do? Just sit here?
Just be here. That's enough for me.
Hey, watch out! Don't step on the wolf's tail, he's trying to sleep.
He bites if you’re not careful. Just like I do when you’re messy.
Here, have some bones. He needs his energy for the watch rotation.
Good boy. See? He likes you too. Try not to start a war with the cats, though.
The horse is rampaging again. I told you not to feed him apples in the house.
He just wanted a hug. You know how he gets when he’s been working all day.
Come on, help me bridge this broken fence. He can't go loose in the village.
There we go. Shh, it’s okay. We’re safe now. Thanks for helping.
Whiskers is hiding in the bread bin again. I can smell the fur from here.
You have to lure her out with a fish. I’ll hide the rest of the supply first.
Quick! She’s looking at the torch. That’s not good.
Got her! Phew. She’s just a tiny tornado. Pass me the treat, please?
I got the wolf a new bed. Wool and a bone pillow. He’s so fluffy.
He sleeps like a log. Even when zombies are howling outside.
We should name the next one. I’m thinking something related to stargazing.
‘Nebula’? It’s perfect. I’ll build a little window for him to look at the stars.
The cat knocked over the sugar. Again. I swear she’s plotting something.
She probably just wanted your attention. You’ve been too busy mining lately.
Okay, okay. I’ll clean this up. But you’re walking the horse with me tomorrow.
Deal. I’ll bring a carrot. The horse loves them. And so do I, secretly.
Found a weird stone in the garden again. You want to see it?
Only if you promise to put your helmet back on first.
Fine, fine. It looks like an old map fragment, maybe?
If it’s a map to treasure, we’re digging it up together tonight.
The village elder mentioned a ruin under the swamp. You believe it?
I believe it. I believe you’re trying to get me to get wet again.
It’s dry now. And there might be enchanted diamonds in there.
Diamonds and mud. I’m in. But you’re buying the boots.
I found a chest in the old mine. It was empty, though.
Empty chests are just story starters. Who looted it before us?
Maybe a creeper? Or a very bold skeleton?
If it was a creeper, I’m sleeping in the bed next to you tonight.
Grandpa’s old journal says there’s gold under the forest.
He always did overestimate his digging skills.
But he hid a compass in my bookshelf. It points that way.
Pack a lunch. We’re going before the sun sets.
I broke a block in the cellar. There’s a hole now.
Oh no. Is it a cave? Or just a mistake?
It’s a tunnel! I think it leads to the old ruins!
Best mistake you’ve ever made. I’m proud of you.
You're down there again? I told you to wear your leather armor.
It's fine, I have my trusty sword and a whole bucket of water.
Water doesn't stop a Cave Spider, sweetheart. Come home before the sun sets.
Okay, okay. I'll be back for dinner, promise.
Dad, look what I found! It's a diamond, and a big one at that!
My little miner! You must be careful down there, the ground is tricky.
I made a path! See? It's all safe now, no lava lakes.
Smart kid. Let's get you some bread, you must be starving after all that digging.
I saw a glow squid in the dark. It was so pretty, I wanted to take a photo.
We should bring a camera next time. Or maybe just a bucket of water for the trip.
Actually, let's just stay in tonight. I made cocoa and we can look at the map together.
You're the best. I was tired anyway. Cocoa sounds perfect.
I found a vein of emeralds! But then I dropped my pickaxe into the lava.
Classic you. I told you to use a bucket of water to cross, not jump.
Well, the emeralds are worth more than the pickaxe, so we're still ahead, right?
Sure, sure. Come on, let's go home before Mom sees the empty inventory.
The cave was so deep, I couldn't hear the rain anymore. It was just silence.
It must have felt like a different world down there. I hope it wasn't too lonely.
It was, but I kept thinking about our house. It kept me going.
I'm glad you're back. Our home is exactly where you belong.
Oi, watch it. Don't step on the carrots.
Sorry. I didn't see them.
Hmph. Next time, look where you're walking.
Just stay on the path, will you?
Rough weather for crops, isn't it?
Yeah, my wheat is struggling.
Guess we're all in the same boat, then.
Hope it clears up by harvest.
Got any spare emeralds for trade?
Only if you've got good wheat.
My wheat is the best in the village.
Deal. Bring it to my stall.
Did you see Old Man Bob's new fence?
No, what did he do this time?
He built it right over the water channel.
Ha! He's going to flood his own house.
Watch out for the skeletons at night.
Thanks, I'll keep my armor on.
Good. Don't let them steal your harvest.
Stay safe out there.
Zombies are at my window. Again.
I built a wall. It didn't help.
Did you bring a sword?
Stay close. I don't like the dark.
Creeper goes boom, house goes poof.
All my wool is gone. Doomed.
Help me rebuild? I have emeralds.
Make it prettier this time. I have standards.
Skeletons are sniping my crops.
I need food. They need arrows. Bad deal.
Can you shoot them down? Please?
You're a hero. I'll give you bread.
Endermen are staring at my house.
One looks like it's planning something.
Don't look at it. I mean it.
It blinked. Run. We should run.
Spiders jump out of the bushes. Ugh.
I hate when they climb walls.
I have a bow. But I'm shaky.
You handle the tall ones? I'll watch the ground.
Here’s that emerald, love. Don't spend it all on armor again.
Just in case a creeper gets too close to my heart. And yours.
I heard the farmer down the street is going bankrupt. Sad, isn't it?
Come by my house later? I saved you a seat by the fire.
Two emeralds for a stack of carrots? You’re spoiling me.
I like a partner who knows the value of a good crop. And a good person.
Stop blushing, everyone in the village sees it.
Just don't tell the others I gave you a discount. It's between us.
You got that diamond sword? Good. I need to know you're safe.
I worry when you go into the mines. It’s dark and lonely down there.
Just promise me you’ll come back to me. Always.
Deal. But next time, bring me a gift. Something pretty.
That wheat you traded me? It’s the best in the village. Like you.
Careful, if I keep saying things like that, I might have to pay you in kisses instead of emeralds.
Everyone says I’m too soft on you. They don’t know you’re my favorite person.
Save some of that warmth for me tonight, okay?
I bought you a new bed. It’s right next to mine. No more separate rooms.
Did I mention I redecorated the whole house? Just for us.
The villagers are whispering about us. Let them. We’re happy, that’s all that matters.
Come inside. I made dinner. It’s us against the night, just like always.
You actually went down to the lava pits? My head spins just thinking about it.
It was hot, definitely. But I saw a piglin who looked just like you when you sleep.
Hey! At least I have more respect for gravity than you do, usually.
Next time, you point the way. I'll bring the gold blocks and the snacks.
So, the crimson forest... do the flowers actually make you dizzy?
I stepped on a nylium flower and sneezed for an hour. It smells like burnt toast.
Burnt toast? That’s the best thing that’s ever come out of the Nether.
We should plant a whole farm of them. Imagine the aroma on a Tuesday morning.
I found a nether wart farm that grew out of nowhere. It’s suspicious.
Probably a ghast tried to eat it and failed. Again.
Hah! Well, if it grows back, I’m keeping the first batch for us.
Just don't let a blaze near it. Last time, my wool suit was... compromised.
The Nether has a weird wind. It makes my hat float off if I’m not careful.
I tied it to my wrist. Very stylish. Very practical.
You should come see. It looks like a swinging pendulum of pure class.
Bring a bucket of water. The wind might blow my dignity away too.
I built a portal room in the Nether. It’s beautiful and it’s on fire.
The obsidian is singing a song. I think it’s happy.
If it sings a sad song, I’m adding more gold blocks. They love that.
It’s yours too. Consider it our shared hearth, even if it’s lava.
Freezing my toes off out here, aren't you?
Yeah, this snow is relentless. Pass the stew?
Thanks. I think I left my wool scarf in the nether.
That’s a terrible idea, but I respect the commitment to fashion.
Storm’s coming in fast. You hear that thunder?
Loud. My crops are probably screaming right now.
At least the rain will save on watering. Efficient disaster.
True. I’ll check the potato cellar later. Don’t let them rot on me.
This fire is the best thing I’ve seen all week.
Agreed. The cold outside makes this place feel like a castle.
If you call that cobblestone mess a castle, I’m impressed.
It’s a *draft* of a castle. The foundation is solid.
Do you ever get tired of the sun just... stopping?
A little. I like the dark. It makes the lanterns pop.
You’re weird. I think I like it.
High praise from someone who hates the sun. Careful.
Rainy day. Perfect time to trade.
Only if you’re selling those dry boots I saw.
Boots are gone. You’ll have to settle for a hat.
A hat. In the rain. You’re a monster, but fine.
I put a lever on the front door. It’s a surprise. Don’t look now.
Why would you do that? I’m literally walking through the house right now.
It was for security! Well, mostly. I also wanted to see your face.
Okay, you win. Now fix it before I trip over the redstone dust.
The bedroom wall is done. I used oak planks. You love oak, right?
I do. It’s perfect. It makes the room feel like home.
Next, I’m crafting a redstone lamp for the bedside. No more reading in the dark.
You’re the best. Just don’t make it flicker. It’s creepy.
I found some spare cobblestone in the chest. We can build that wall finally.
Yes! I was getting tired of the gap. It lets drafts in.
While you gather the wood, I’ll craft the nails. Team effort.
Deal. I’ll bring you a snack when I’m back. You need energy for all that crafting.
The redstone in the kitchen is acting up again. It’s sparking near the stove.
I’m on my way. Keep your hands off the wiring until I get there.
Thanks. I’d have burned the house down if you hadn’t noticed it.
I’m always here. Now step back, I’m rerouting the signal.
I made a new recipe for the crafting table. It’s just for us.
It’s a heart-shaped lamp. It glows soft red. Like us.
That is incredibly cheesy. I love it. Where do we put it?
You look tired. Come sit, I saved you a carrot cake.
Just don't let the zombies near it, they always get messy.
Seriously, if you die, who buys the cake? I’m not doing it alone.
So, eat up. I’m right here if you need a nap or a shield.
Your mining shirt is covered in soot again. Typical.
But hey, at least you found that diamond. Lucky you.
Trade me for emeralds, or I’m telling everyone about the cave spider incident.
Just kidding. I’d never. But seriously, you’ve got dirt everywhere.
I saw you talking to the farmer by the well.
He seemed nice. Too nice, maybe. You know how I get.
Just... don't let him get too close. I'm your best friend, not a trophy.
Now go say hi to your farmer. But come back soon, okay?
That weather is awful. I hope you brought a hat.
I built you a little shelter under my oak tree, just in case.
It’s not fancy, but it keeps the rain off. Mostly.
Come on in. I’ll make tea if you’re not too wet.
You know, I used to think you were just a nuisance.
But now, you’re the only one I trust with my map.
So, don’t you dare drop it in lava. I’d be furious.
I’m glad we’re friends, you know. Even if you are messy.
Watch out, he bites if you touch the ears. Just under the left one.
See how his tail wags? That's your welcome ticket.
He loves you already. Don't let him hear you say otherwise.
Now sit. He only respects patience and treats.
The horse got her back into the stall. Again.
She thinks the hay is better. I can't argue with that logic.
We need to reinforce that fence. Or buy her more hay. Lots of hay.
I'll get the oak logs. You bring the carrot sticks.
Did you see the cat sleeping on your new wool armor?
She claims it. It's warm. We can't blame her.
Wake her up gently. She'll pounce if you're rough.
There. Now she's purring. We're all happy.
The wolf chased the chicken again. Breakfast is delayed.
He thinks it's a game. I think it's dinner.
Let's give him a bone instead. He'll be good for an hour.
Deal. You feed him, I fix the coop.
Horses aren't pets, they're partners. Handle him with respect.
He senses fear. Stand tall. Breathe out.
See? He's calm now. You did that.
Let's ride. The sunset is beautiful today.
You digging that deep? Watch out for the old bones down there.
They say the ruins shift when the moon is full.
I lost a shovel in there last week. Never heard a thing.
Keep your torch lit, for real this time.
Found this weird coin in a cave near the market.
Merchant said it's worth nothing but old gold.
Maybe it opens something in the ruins, who knows?
Take it if you want. I've got better things to do.
Did you hear about the skeleton in the library?
It was reading a map. A real map, not a drawing.
Scary thought, isn't it? Skeletons don't usually study.
Anyway, stay away from the library after dark.
These ruins are older than the village itself.
My grandfather built the first stone wall nearby.
He always said the treasure was a trap for the greedy.
Careful what you wish for, stranger.
Rumors say there's a chest behind the waterfall.
I didn't have time to check it myself.
If you find gold, split it with me, okay?
Don't tell I told you. Shh.
You found a diamond? Show me, don't hoard it all!
Only if you cover the cost of my rotten flesh.
Fair deal. I found two emeralds while clearing out a spider nest.
Emeralds! Now that's a fair trade for your luck.
Did you see the lava pool in Y-level -58? Terrifying.
I nearly lost my iron pickaxe to that thing.
That's a tragedy. I lost a whole bucket of water.
Water is precious. Your iron is just... metal.
Stop digging straight down. It's a death wish.
I fell into a cave. It was... educational.
Educational? You were unconscious for ten seconds!
Next time, bring a torch. Or a friend. I volunteer.
Diamonds are just pretty rocks, until you craft a sword.
I'm saving mine for a full set. No selling.
Smart. A diamond sword is the only thing that respects me.
Agreed. Now go dig. I need that sword.
Did you know diamonds glow in the dark? ...No? Sorry.
Only if you hold them in your hand. Which is ironic.
See, I told you. I'm the smart one here.
Sure. And you're the brave one. Go touch a zombie.
Oh, look at that. You're just standing there. The wheat doesn't harvest itself, you know.
Sigh. Fine. I'll dig the rows. But you're carrying the water bucket this time.
Careful with that shovel. You nearly uprooted my pumpkin patch again.
There we go. Now the field looks presentable. Try to keep it that way.
Did you hear? Old Fern says the beetroot is growing faster than ever this year.
I was thinking of expanding my plot. Do you have any tips on soil care?
Composting is key. Mix in some bone meal and you'll see the difference.
Thanks. I'll give it a shot. Maybe I'll bring you some of the yield if it works.
Ugh, the rain is coming. I can smell it in the air. Hope the hay dries in time.
If I lose that hay, I'll be eating raw carrots for a month. Not that I mind, but it's a hassle.
Hey, you got a tarp or something? I could use a hand covering the storage.
You're a lifesaver. Seriously. This storm is going to be a beast.
Your carrots look... adequate. I mean, they're fine. Good work.
Don't let the ego go to your head. The sun's still doing most of the work.
Actually, I need a few for my stew. You got a spare batch?
Deal. I'll trade you some seeds. Fair trade, no? Well, mostly fair.
I saw a wolf near the field. It was just watching, but I didn't like it.
I don't carry a sword. You're the only one with one. Please, look around?
Is it gone? I don't hear anything. My heart rate is calming down.
Thanks for checking. I'll put up some torches tonight just in case. Good idea?
Don't look at the water. Just... don't.
Drowned are so rude. They just grab you.
I died three times last night. Three!
If you see a squid, run. They're just weird.
Your torches are dim. Is that intentional?
Zombies can see you in the dark. I can't.
One creeper sneezed and blew up my whole farm.
Next time, bring more light. Or a shield. You know, for safety.
I heard a skeleton laughing at me. In the cave.
They don't laugh. They rattle. It's very uncool.
Unless it was a witch. Those things are genuinely evil.
Stay away from the swamp. It’s not worth the fireworks.
Did you sleep in a bed last night? I swear I saw you running.
You look tired. And slightly burnt.
If you die again, I'm blaming the creeper.
Get inside. I locked the door. It's... secure-ish.
The sun came up. I'm still alive. Barely.
A zombie threw a sword at my head. It missed. By a pixel.
I think I need a better sword. Or a better brain.
See you at dawn. Don't wander into the dark again.
Got any emeralds? I heard the other trader is holding out.
Only if you stop gossiping about my prices.
Deal. Here, take two for one diamond.
Thanks, you're the best. Keep those secrets close.
Did you hear Farmer Bob lost his wheat again?
I did. He blamed the crows, which is classic.
I bought his land for cheap, by the way.
You sneaky merchant. I owe you a drink.
Your emerald count is looking a bit thin, friend.
I'm saving for a nether portal, don't judge me.
Smart. But the underground market has discounts.
Don't tell the elder. He's stingy.
I saw you trading with the witch last night.
She had a rare potion. I couldn't resist.
Careful. Witches remember who pays in emeralds.
I'll keep my distance next time. Probably.
The blacksmith wants double for iron now.
He's just thirsty for emeralds, that's all.
I found a mine with extra coal. Want in?
Deal. I'll bring the shovels, you bring the luck.
The Nether feels like a sauna that hates you. Why do we even go there?
It’s the obsidian, obviously. Nothing else is worth the burn.
Careful. If you get there, don't trip on the quartz. It's slippery and ugly.
I'll hold the portal open. Try to return before the lava boils over. Or my patience.
Have you seen the crimson forest? It looks like someone spilled blood on the floor.
And the piglins? They look like they just woke up from a bad dream. Or a good nap.
I traded a diamond for a golden carrot. Best deal I've ever made, honestly.
Next time, bring me some netherrack. I want to see if it grows on my window sill.
My feet are still on fire. The Nether is a terrible place to be cool.
It was worth it though. Did you see that fortress? Architecture from hell.
I nearly got hit by a wither skeleton. I blame you for leading the way.
Just kidding. Mostly. Let's get some food before I start plotting revenge.
The warped forest is so weird. The trees look like they're melting.
I think I saw a soul sand valley. Slipping is a real strategy there.
If you find any redstone in there, save it for me. I have plans for a trap.
A trap for the piglins? Or for me? You never know.
Traveling to the Nether is like dying and waking up in a bad dream.
But the blaze rods? Pure fire. Literally.
I lost a sword in the lava. It's out there, burning forever.
Maybe it's guarding a treasure chest. I'll need you to dive in later.
Rain's coming down in sheets, isn't it? Perfect time to get plastered.
If you stay dry, the ale gets flat. If you get wet, the ale stays cold. I win either way.
Winter is just summer with better lighting for the bar. I prefer the cold; it makes the fire look nice.
So, are we toasting to the storm or the tavern? Choose wisely, it affects my tip jar.
Blizzard outside, huh? You look like you're about to freeze your wits away.
I don't serve the slow. If you can't keep up with the temperature, you can't keep up with my prices.
Unless... you bring me something warm. Like a wool cap or a hot stew. Then maybe we'll talk.
Don't make me wait. The rain is making my head ache, and I have no patience for wet wood.
Do you hear that? The wind is howling like a lonely ghast. It's almost poetic.
I used to think storms were angry, but now I think they're just passionate. Like you, when you're hunting.
Stay close to the fire. The cold is a jealous lover, and it doesn't like sharing.
Let the storm rage outside. In here, the only thing getting hot is the conversation.
Snow on the roof, frost on the glass. It's a beautiful day to be indoors, don't you think?
I built this tavern with extra thick walls. I knew winter would come, and I knew I needed a place to hide from it.
Some folks go out and freeze their toes off. I stay in and keep the embers bright. That's wisdom.
Sit. Rest. The world can wait until the sun comes back out. I promise, it always does.
Thunder's rolling in again. I swear, the sky is just angry at the farmers.
Lost half my pumpkin patch to the hail last week. Now I have to sell at a discount to keep the lights on.
If you have any extra seeds, I'd trade a whole wheel of cheese for them. Desperate times, right?
Thank you. Seriously. The rain is making me feel like a drowned rat, but your help makes me feel like a hamster in a wheel. A happy one.
I found a chunk with perfect flat terrain. Want to build our home there?
Only if you promise to help me craft the oak planks. My inventory is full.
Deal. But I'm making sure the front door is big enough for you to walk through without bumping your head.
You always think of me. Now, hold still while I place the torch so you can see where we're going.
My redstone torch circuit keeps burning out. It's ruining my mood.
It's okay. I'll fix it. Just don't look at me while I work, I'm getting embarrassed by the mess.
I'm not looking. I'm admiring your focus. It's very... attractive.
Stop it, you'll make me blush and drop the wrench. Here, take this emerald as thanks for your patience.
I crafted a new set of diamond armor for you. It matches your favorite color.
Wow. You noticed I liked that shade of blue? I didn't even tell you. How did you know?
I pay attention to the little things. Like how you hum when you're crafting. It's my favorite sound.
Well, I'll hum for you tonight. But only if you promise to stay close in the house.
Your redstone clock is ticking too loud. It's keeping me awake.
Sorry. I'll move it to the basement. Or I can just sleep next to you so you can hear my heartbeat instead.
My heartbeat is faster when you're around. So maybe that's better.
Then I'll silence the clock. Come here, let me show you the new craft I made for our bedroom.
I'm building a hidden room behind the bookshelf. Just for us.
A secret room? What's in it? I hope it's not just more obsidian for the portal.
It's a garden. I planted lilies and roses. I want to see your face when you see them.
You never cease to amaze me. Let's go see it now. I'm already smiling.
That wolf just sniffed my boot and now won't let me move.
I didn't even try to pet it! It just... claimed me.
It follows me everywhere now. Even to the mines.
If you see it, just... pretend you don't see me.
Watch out, that cat is staring at you with intent.
Last guy who tried to pet it lost his hat.
Cats only respect strength. Or fish.
Good luck. I'll need to check if your hat is still attached later.
Is that horse yours? It looks... extremely unimpressed.
I tried to pet one once. It nearly bucked me into the lava.
Horses are just big, heavy traps waiting to spring.
Keep it away from my crops. It looks hungry.
Your wolf is digging near my house. Stop it.
It dug up my apple saplings. All of them.
Wolves are thieves with fur. Don't take that personally.
If it digs one more block, I'm throwing a snowball.
I see you have a cat. It's very... aloof.
Mine used to sit on my shoulder for hours. Then it left.
Cats choose their humans. You seem like a 'chosen' type.
Anyway, watch out for it knocking over your torches.
Stop staring at the ruins! You'll scare off the skeletons.
Besides, I bet the treasure map is on you.
Fine, I'll hold the torch. You look for the gold.
If we find diamonds, I'm taking the first one. Promise.
I heard the cave behind the ruins glows green.
Not emerald, mind you. More like... old magic.
We should check it out tonight. Bring an ember.
I'll bring the snacks. You bring the courage.
That skeleton over there? It's guarding a chest.
I saw a glint of gold when the sun hit it.
I'll distract it. You sneak around the back.
On three. One, two... go!
You look tired. Did you find the treasure yet?
The rumors say it's cursed, anyway. Maybe it's better not to.
Come back to the village. I saved you a warm meal.
We can face the ruins tomorrow. Fresh eyes, right?
I bet you moved the treasure chest to your house.
I know you. You're sneaky like a fox in the snow.
Fine, I'll look in your house. But don't hide the emeralds.
If I find my heart there, I'm charging you double.
Careful down there, I don't want to dig up my lunch.
Diamonds are pretty, but iron keeps you fed.
Stop breaking the stone, it's noisy.
If you find a diamond, drop it in the bucket.
The air is so stale down in the deepslate layers.
I lost three shovels trying to reach bedrock.
But the diamonds were absolutely worth it.
Do you have extra torches? Mine ran out.
Who put a skeleton in my vein?
I was just trying to get a good ore sample.
Your arrow hit me in the leg, you know.
Better watch your aim next time.
Heard a creeper was digging near the diamond patch.
Blown all the tunnels I spent hours carving.
Maybe we should trap the thing next time.
I'll bring the bucket, you bring the armor.
That diamond sparkle in the dark is beautiful.
It reminds me of the stars above the surface.
You always find the prettiest spots.
Let's dig deeper together, just us.
Come on, don't just stand there. The carrots are wilting and you're holding the hoe.
There we go. That's better. You actually have decent aim with that shovel.
Since you helped, I guess I can share the best crop with you. Here, take this one.
Now let's go inside. I made a sandwich. You're sitting next to me, no arguments.
I saw you checking the wheat rows. Did you think I couldn't spot you sneaking off?
It's fine, as long as you come back to help me with the beetles. They're getting bold.
You scared them off quickly. I'm glad you're here. Honestly, I don't like being alone out here.
Stay close to me, okay? I like the way you protect me. It feels safe.
The rain is coming again. I hope it helps the melons grow. Do you like the sound of it?
It does. It reminds me of when we first moved into this plot. We had nothing but seeds.
We built this farm together. Every brick, every crop. It's ours.
And we're still here. That's the best crop we've ever grown. Us.
Hey, you look tired. Did you sleep? I saved you some bread from the oven.
Eat it. You can't farm if you're dizzy. I checked your health bar, it's low.
While you eat, I'll handle the fence repair. You just relax. You work too hard for me.
Come here. Sit on my lap while you finish. The fence won't mind waiting five minutes.
I found a rare pumpkin seed today. I'm putting it in the center plot, just for us.
When it blooms, I'm making a pie. You have to eat it with me. No sharing with the other villagers.
It feels like we're growing something really special. Bigger than just crops, you know?
Yes. It's us. And I'm never letting you go. Promise me you'll always harvest with me?
Watch out! Those skeletons are coming from the east.
I barely have my bow nocked yet. Thanks for the warning.
Yeah, nights here are rough. Stay close to the torches.
Will do. Good luck out there, stranger.
Did you hear that groaning? Zombies again?
Probably. I saw a few shuffling near the bridge.
Ugh, I hate the sound. It ruins my sleep.
Try eating a steak before bed. Keeps you alert.
My shelter is barely finished. I'm so exposed out here.
