Add a door, at least. Creepers hate them.
Haha, yeah, doors. I got that part.
Just saying. I lost a whole farm to a creeper last night.
If you see any wolves, don't pet them at night.
Why? Are they hostile in the dark?
Not hostile, but they get skittish. And they run into things.
Smart tip. I had one knock over my torches before.
It's getting dark. You ready to face the night?
Ready as I'll ever be. I have my iron armor.
Good. I'll need backup if a Wither spawns.
I'll be there. Let's hope it doesn't.
I heard the farmer up the street is selling diamond armor for just two emeralds.
No way, that’s a steal! I should’ve gone there first.
Shh! Don’t tell him I told you, or he’ll raise his prices.
Your secret is safe with me. Mostly.
You still owe me three emeralds from that last deal.
Pay up, or I’m telling the whole village you trade with zombies.
Just kidding! Here, I’ll throw in a carrot for you.
You’re a lifesaver. I was running low on snacks.
Did you hear that blacksmith tripped over his own anvil?
I was there! He looked like a wobble in a puddle.
We should make bets on when he drops something next.
Deal! I’ll bet five emeralds he does it by dinner.
I found a pile of emeralds in that cave yesterday.
Lucky you! I only found dirt and despair.
Here, take two. I can’t carry them all anyway.
You’re the best. Thanks, buddy.
The shepherd says his sheep talk. Rumor has it.
If they talk, they’re probably complaining about the wool prices.
Exactly! They’re unionizing for better emerald rates.
I’d hire them if they promise not to strike.
Careful where you step, that obsidian looks unstable.
I heard the Crimson Forest is full of thorns.
Did you bring enough netherrack for your portal?
Don't get lava-burned, I'd hate to clean up the mess.
So, you're actually going to the Nether?
The heat alone will make you regret it.
Unless you brought a full set of fire resistance.
Just don't blame me if you come back melted.
The Nether is truly a place of wonders.
The glowing mushrooms just fascinate me.
Have you seen the Nether Wart farms?
I think I'm going to go tomorrow!
I hear the Soul Sand Valley is beautiful.
But the Golems there are not friendly.
They protect their territory fiercely.
Maybe save the pretty parts for later.
Did you know you can farm Nether Gold?
It's much more profitable than stone.
Most players don't even know where to look.
Maybe I should show you, if you're lucky.
The rain's coming in, love. You're coming inside, right?
Unless you plan on getting wet again, that is.
I saved you a seat by the fire.
Pass me that bottle, will you? You've earned it.
Winter's here. My lungs hate it, but I love the snow.
It's like the world holds its breath.
We should build something warm for spring, don't you think?
Maybe a greenhouse? Just the two of us.
Stormy night, eh? Perfect for bad decisions.
Remember that time we stole those sheep?
We never got away with it, by the way.
Let's try again. I have a plan this time.
The wind howls like a creeper tonight.
Keeps me on edge, I admit.
But you're here, so it's okay.
Stay close. I'll keep watch.
Spring is coming. The flowers are already blooming.
I planted something for you in the garden.
It's a surprise. Go look.
Hope you like it. I picked it just for you.
Did you put the redstone lamps in the hallway yet? It’s pitch black in here.
I was waiting for you to bring the repeaters, you little procrastinator.
Here, take this one. You always mess up the delay timing.
There we go. Now the house actually looks like a place we live in.
Why does the crafting table keep breaking? Did you punch it again?
No, the piglin bossed me. It’s not my fault.
Whatever. Just stop breaking the furniture with your sword.
I’ll craft a new one. But you’re paying for the planks.
I built a secret passage behind the bookshelf. Just for us.
You didn't tell anyone? That's my favorite kind of surprise.
It leads to the garden. I planted lilies on the other side.
Let's go see it. I've been waiting all day to show you.
The redstone clock in the kitchen is running fast. Everything is burning.
I calibrated it to cook the bread faster. It’s working as intended.
My 'intended' is on fire. Please help me put it out.
Got it. Next time, let's stick to manual timers, okay?
I moved the crafting station to the center of the room.
Now it blocks the light from the window. Are you trying to make us cave dwellers?
It’s more efficient. We don’t need sunlight to craft iron.
Fine, I’ll move it back. But you’re cleaning the dust off the windows.
You look lost. I'm just trying to sell emeralds, not lead expeditions.
Not looking for a tour. Just a quick trade, unless you want to get stuck in this village forever.
Fine. Here’s your iron. Don’t touch the other stalls or I’ll call the guards.
Next time, just point at what you want. It’s faster than explaining your life story.
That sword of yours... are you going to break it on a zombie or a flower?
Hopefully the zombie. Flowers have better things to do than be chopped up.
I saw you off in the swamp. You okay? Those things bite back hard.
Just stay out of the dark, huh? Not that I’m worried. Just... for your own sake.
Your house is... colorful. Did you really use wool for the roof?
It’s not a palace, but it’s not a shack either. I think.
You’re the new one, right? The one with the fancy clothes.
Try to keep it quiet. The elders get cranky when things change too fast.
You’re staring at my cat. Is it going to bite?
No, but he’s shy. And you’re a stranger. That’s a bad mix.
He only purrs for the people who bring him fish. Maybe start there.
Don’t scare him. I’d be very upset if he stopped eating.
The weather’s been weird. Too much rain for this time of year.
Ruins my crops. Do you know how hard it is to farm in the mud?
You seem fine. You must have a good place to stay out of the rain.
Anyway. I’ll be inside. Keep your boots dry, I guess.
That wolf looks like it's plotting world domination. Or just wants a treat.
I bet it eats bones like they're bread. Crunchy and satisfying.
Careful, though. Last guy who tickled its belly got a shoe-bite.
Just offer a bone from a distance. No sudden moves, trust me.
This cat is ignoring me. Again. Typical.
It only pays attention when I'm cleaning the barn.
Maybe you can distract it with a fish. I have none.
If it ignores you, just pretend it's your fault. Works for me.
My horse spooked at a skeleton. A tiny one. It was a baby.
Now it refuses to go near any bones. Even my lunch.
I tried giving it carrots. It just looked at me with judgment.
Maybe try riding it. Sometimes fear makes them brave. Or weirder.
Look at this cat. Pure chaos in fur form.
Knocked over three buckets of milk. On purpose. I'm sure.
But then it brought me a dead rat. As a gift.
I guess I should be grateful for the pest control. Or is it pest placement?
This wolf is staring at my bread. Intensely.
If I drop it, it takes it. If I hide it, it waits. Patient devil.
I gave it a bone. Now it follows me everywhere. Shadow mode.
Don't feed it, or you'll be on duty too. Trust me.
Stop staring at the wall, I know you're trying to hide the map.
Fine, fine. The entrance is behind the mossy stones, third stone from the left.
Just don't blow it up. I spent three days deciphering that inscription.
Meet me at the cave mouth at dawn. Bring extra torches, I'm not walking in the dark alone.
Did you hear the new rumor? There's gold in the ruins west of the river.
Old Man Steve swears he saw a skeleton guard move last night.
If it's real, we split the loot fifty-fifty. No takebacks.
Deal. But if you get ambushed, I'm not carrying you out.
I found a chest in the ruins but it was locked tight.
That sounds like the key is on the other side. Painful, isn't it?
I'll check the upper level. You watch the entrance, okay?
You're a lifesaver. I'd have spent hours picking that lock.
They say the treasure is cursed. You don't believe that, do you?
Curses are just stories to keep people away from good loot.
Good. I brought an iron golem just in case. Don't look at him, he's shy.
You're ridiculous. I love that you're ridiculous.
Look at this map. It's in Ancient Script, right?
It says 'Guarded by the most loyal friend.' Clever.
So I guess I have to stand here until you figure out the rest.
Thanks for waiting. I'll buy you a diamond sword when we're done.
You found a diamond? Lucky you, I'm still digging through gravel.
Honestly, it's not about the gems, it's about the view from the bottom.
Careful down there, the zombies have unionized.
Just... breathe. The air is thinner and the despair is thicker.
Diamonds are just pretty rocks that make you greedy.
I saw Dave drop his whole inventory into a lava lake. Tragic.
Maybe if you built a fence, you wouldn't fall in.
Go away, you're blocking my light.
Ooh, shiny! Did you bring any for the village treasury?
We're building a diamond fountain in the center square!
Every emerald counts, even the ones from old mineshafts.
High five! Well, high arm, since we're both in dirt.
I heard a Creeper hissed at me in the deepslate layer.
It was right behind me! I swear I saw the fuse!
Maybe we should stick to farming until we get better armor.
Stay close. The dark is darker than it looks.
Diamonds are cold. I prefer the warmth of a good stew.
One emerald buys a carrot, which buys happiness.
The cave air ruins my soup. It gets too... earthy.
Come inside, the fire is crackling nicely.
Did you see Bob’s turnips? They’re bigger than his head.
I thought he was trying to grow a new breed of sheep.
Careful, or he'll start charging us for the view.
Anyway, my carrots are finally ready. Want to taste test?
The rain is coming, I can smell the dirt.
If it floods, I’m blaming the chickens.
They always peck at the drainage ditches.
Let's check the silo before the storm hits.
Why did the wheat refuse to grow?
Because it was tired of being stalked.
I’m tired of being stalked by cows, though.
Pass me a carrot, will you? I need to bribe them.
Your fence is crooked. It’s upsetting the sheep.
They’re stress-eating the tulips. You’re to blame.
Just straighten it out, for the love of the harvest.
Once it’s fixed, I’ll bring you some pies. They’re amazing.
I heard the trader is selling cheap emeralds.
He’s been losing weight, so he’s cutting costs.
Don’t tell him I told you, though.
Buy some seeds for me if you have extra emeralds.
The sun is setting and you're still out here?
One creeper and you're history.
I saw a skeleton on the roof earlier.
Get inside. Now.
My bed is locked in my house.
But the zombies keep finding the gap.
Do you have a torch? Just one?
I'll trade you an apple. It's slightly bruised.
Did you hear that?
It sounds like a ghast.
Stay behind me if you can.
Don't look at it. Just run.
I hate night shifts.
The moths are worse than the zombies.
Unless the zombies eat the moths first.
Keep your shield up, just in case.
Your armor looks... patchy.
Are you trying to survive or die?
Here, take this potion. It's not healing, but it helps.
Now stop looking like a target.
Got any emeralds to spare? The market is dry.
Why do you always hold back your best stock?
Keep talking and I'll sell your boots to a zombie.
Fine. Here. Now stop crowding my stall.
Heard the blacksmith lost his left eye to a creeper.
Funny how emeralds don't stick to dynamite, eh?
If you have spare gems, I'll buy that eye back.
Jokes aside, he's selling cheap iron today.
The wheat prices are up. Again.
Farmers are getting greedy or I'm going broke.
Pass me a loaf, and we'll call it even.
Better than the tasteless potato bread I made.
That new house? Built by a skeleton.
Must have found a shovel in the ruins.
I bet it's full of cobwebs and bad jokes.
You should check it out. I dare you.
Watch out, the pig in the corner is plotting.
It stole my last emerald yesterday.
Squeal one more time and I'm selling it for pork.
Stay back. I mean business this time.
Careful with that Nether wart. It bites back if you look it wrong.
I saw a piglin scream at a mushroom once. It was not funny.
The crimson forest smells like burnt sugar and regret.
Just don't throw gold unless you want a mob boss in your face.
Endermen are rude, but at least they don't steal your bread.
I once got stuck in a nether portal for three days. Do not ask.
The soul sand fire is surprisingly warm, if you ignore the lava.
Bring a torch. It helps the spiders see you. And then you see them.
Blazing rods taste like spicy cinnamon. Don't try it.
I miss rain. Nether rain is just falling ash. It’s depressing.
If you see a Ghast, just run. Or scream. Or hide in a block.
But the view from the fortress? Worth every burn.
Witching in the Nether is illegal in three dimensions.
I traded a diamond for a rotten chunk of quartz. I regret it.
The quartz forest is silent. Too silent. I don't like it.
Stay close to me. The shadows there... they watch.
Netherite is heavy. So is my patience with you.
You look like you're about to step in a magma pool.
I won't carry you. I don't have the stamina for your stupidity.
Fine. I'll watch your back. But you owe me a cake.
It’s pouring outside. Stay by the fire, we’ve got stew.
The wind is howling like a ghast tonight. Creepy, right?
Don't worry. If a creeper gets in, I'll handle it.
Just sit back. You earned your rest after that storm.
Spring's finally here! The mushrooms are popping up everywhere.
Bet you still can't pick mushrooms without getting spores on your shirt.
Hey! I've gotten better. Watch this.
Not bad! Okay, you win. Now help me clear the blockage.
This heat is brutal. We need to move to the tundra.
The tundra? You'd freeze your tail off in the snow.
Fine. But if I freeze, you owe me a new armor set.
Deal. But only if you let me keep the cool scarf.
The rain makes me think of that time we got trapped in the cave.
Yeah. I still have that wet wool blanket. It’s a trophy.
We survived. That’s what matters. Most people didn't make it out.
Here's to surviving the next storm. Drink up.
Winter's coming. Your crop fields are going to die.
I have a greenhouse! I'm ahead of you, just you know.
Nice. Did you get the glowing lichen for the lights?
Yep! Come over, I'll show you. It's pretty magic, isn't it?
You finally built a roof? I was about to start installing the redstone lights myself.
Here, I crafted some torches while you were placing blocks. Don't say I didn't help.
Just wait until we wire up the automatic doors. It's going to be so elegant.
And I'll make sure the crafting table is always stocked with wood for you.
Your redstone contraption just sparked my interest, literally.
Show me how you wired that. I want to learn from the best.
You have such steady hands when you craft. It’s mesmerizing.
Let's build something more complicated together this weekend.
I left the extra emeralds on the crafting table for you.
You shouldn't have to beg for materials to make our home beautiful.
Look at this oak log I found. It's perfect for the floorboards.
Come sit with me while I craft the rest. I like your company.
Your house looks cozy. I can see your life in the details.
I made you a heart from redstone blocks. It's for your desk.
Does it light up when you get close? I thought it would be cute.
I'm glad you like it. It's just like how you make me feel.
I accidentally broke your crafting table. I'm so sorry!
But look, I replaced it with a better one. Oak is sturdier.
I also added a chest for your tools. You can keep them safe now.
Don't be mad. I only did it because I care about your stuff.
You’re standing in my way. Move.
I don't have time for small talk.
Just... take the emeralds and go.
Don't let the door hit you.
Is it always this warm here?
I guess I’m not used to the heat.
Maybe you should grab some ice pops.
Thanks. Good idea.
I see you have a sword.
Just trying to keep the creepers away.
They are very loud, aren't they?
Try not to blow up my crops.
Your house... it’s interesting.
I’m still working on the roof.
Do you have any good blocks for that?
Maybe some quartz. It’s bright.
Do you hear that singing?
I was just humming to myself.
It’s a nice song.
I should probably get back to work.
Shoo! That wolf is not a toy, it's a guard dog.
You poked it, now you answer for it.
Just watch your back, then.
Hope you brought armor.
Careful, that cat bites if you're clumsy.
See? I told you it's temperamental.
Maybe buy it some fish to apologize.
Don't let it chase you into the Nether.
This horse is my best friend, don't scare it.
He only trusts people who share their bread.
Nice try, but he's picky.
Maybe try carrots next time, eh?
Why do you always touch things?
My wolf just yawned at you. Bold move.
I don't have all day for your antics.
Go mine something, at least.
Look at that kitten, just a floof of chaos.
It knocked over my wheat last hour.
But I couldn't be mad at that face.
You should get one, it cures the blues.
I found a map fragment in the ruins, just like you. Want to split the loot?
Only if you promise to carry the heavy stuff this time.
Deal. I found a chest with emeralds and a suspicious looking book.
Let's go check the other room. I have a feeling you'll find something for me.
The villagers say there's a temple under the river. Just you and me?
I'd go anywhere with you. But bring torches, I hate the dark.
Don't worry, I'll stay close. The rumors say the traps are tricky.
Good. And if we find gold, we buy ourselves a house together.
I heard the ruins are cursed. You still want to dive in?
If it's cursed, I'll curse the curse. Just keep holding my hand.
Okay, hand held. I found a lever that looks like a puzzle.
Solve it and I'll kiss you. Deal?
Stop staring at the map. Look at me. I'm more interesting.
You're right, the map is boring. I like the view of you better.
Mmm. Now, back to the ruins. I want that diamond sword.
If you get it for me, I'll wear it for you every day.
The treasure isn't gold, it's the time we spend here. Don't you think?
I was looking for emeralds, but you're right. You're the prize.
Then let's clear this room. No more looking for loot, just us.
Just us. I like that. Come here.
I just hit Y-level -58 and saw three diamonds in a row. Legend stuff, right?
Three? You lucky git. I only got a cobblestone generator and a cave spider.
Wait, you didn't drop the diamonds, did you? Don't lie to me, bestie.
I kept them safe. Here, take one. We share the glory now.
My torches ran out in the deepslate layer. Total panic mode.
Okay, breathe. Did you make it back to the surface alive?
Barely. A zombie almost touched me. I still hear that hissing.
Come sit by my campfire. I'm brewing some strength potions. You need to chill.
I found a secret cave system with no monsters. Just... silence and crystals.
No monsters? That's suspicious. Sounds like a trap, but a pretty one.
It was just a quiet spot. I wanted to share it with you, not just mine it.
Okay, I'm coming. Pack two lanterns. We explore this together.
You look tired. Did you spend the whole night mining diamonds again?
Just a few more veins. I promised the guild I'd get them all by morning.
Forget the guild. They can wait. Your health bar is dropping, friend.
You're right. I'm going to bed. Thanks for watching my back.
I built a diamond elevator. It's ugly, but it works. Don't judge me.
It's a monstrosity. I love it. It matches my soul perfectly.
Next time, use more wool. We need to make it look less like a cave-in.
Deal. I'll buy the wool. You just bring the diamonds. We're partners now.
Step off my wheat, adventurer. It's for bread, not your shoe polish.
Sorry, I didn't mean to trample the good stuff.
Hmph. Next time, look where you're walking. The soil doesn't forgive.
Just don't let the moths get near the drying racks, eh?
Carrots are back this season. Sweet, crunchy, and cheap if you barter nicely.
I've got a stack of emeralds if you're interested.
Deal! These carrots are fresher than yesterday's sun, I promise.
Come back when the beets are ready. They're a bit spicy, trust me.
The rain won't stop, and my potato crop is turning to soup.
That sounds terrible. Did you try moving them under the shelter?
Too late, they're already soggy. I'll have to compost them all.
Well, at least the compost will make the next batch stronger.
Honey blocks? In a farm? Who builds this madness?
It's a bee hive experiment. Slower growth, but better yield.
Bees and wheat? You're either a genius or a fool, and I can't tell which.
I'll watch. If the bees sting me, I'm charging you double.
The wheat is ready. Grab a scythe, let's harvest before the night falls.
You got it. I'll clear the field, you watch for pests.
Heads up! A spider is creeping near the seedlings.
Got it. Nice work, we saved the batch. Let's count the yield.
Don't step into the grass tonight. I just saw a zombie shuffle past the oak tree.
Thanks for the heads-up. I was just about to head out.
Smart move. I'll be in the shelter. Come by if you need a torch.
Will do. Stay safe out there.
I hide in the dirt when the sun goes down. It's not pretty, but it works.
That's... one way to do it. I usually just sleep in a bed.
Beds are overrated. Have you ever been chased by a creeper while trying to sleep?
No, but I've seen them. Good thing I keep my distance.
Those skeletons are terrible marksmen. I almost got shot at dawn.
Ugh, skeletons are so annoying. They always find the worst time to shoot.
Maybe we should build a taller fence? Just in case.
Good idea. I'll bring the wood. You bring the torches.
I heard the witch in the swamp has a new brew. It glows green.
Witches are bad news. I stick to my sword and shield.
Smart. I'll stay away from the swamp tonight. It's too foggy.
Fog is the worst. Can't see anything until it's too late.
I lost three apples to the monsters last night. Just three.
Haha, you're kidding. You have a whole garden.
That's the point! It feels like a personal attack when they eat my crops.
Okay, okay. I'll guard the farm tonight. You just sleep.
Stop staring at my stall, I know you're short on emeralds.
Fine, here's a discount. But only because you look hungry.
Don't tell the farmers I'm giving you free stuff, they'll riot.
Just promise to bring back some emeralds next time, okay?
Did you hear? Old Miller bought a diamond sword with three carrots.
He claims it's a 'strategic investment.' I just saw him trip over it.
Anyway, if you have emeralds, I'll trade. If not, bring gossip.
Better than hearing about zombie raids all day, trust me.
Your emeralds are shiny. I almost forgot you were actually broke.
Just kidding. I've got extra bread if you're hungry.
The blacksmith says you mined a netherite ingot? No way.
Show me. I need to see if you're still a hero or just lucky.
I saw you talking to that fox. It looks hungry.
Want to trade some wheat? I have too many.
Gossip says the foxes are forming a union. Wild, right?
If they strike, I'll support them. They have good grooming.
Emerald prices are up. Blame the new mayor.
He thinks a diamond is worth five emeralds. Insane.
I still have a few diamonds. Want to swap before I melt them down?
Just don't let the mayor's guards see. They're nosy.
You went to the Nether? Please tell me you saw a Wither Skeleton.
It chased me all the way to the obsidian platform! I almost lost my pickaxe.
Nice save. I still get nervous when the lava starts bubbling, though.
Next time, bring extra torches. Those Ghasts are hard to see in the dark.
Did you see the Crimson Forest? It’s so... red. And squishy.
It’s not squishy, it’s just... organic. Mostly. The Nether Wart grows there, you know.
Right, right. Magic mushrooms. I’d trade you a stack for a few of those.
Deal. But only if you promise not to let Blazes melt my new wool cap.
I found a warped forest. The trees looked like they were screaming.
They were just trying to get your attention for the nether wither skulls.
Screaming trees, huh? I’d give anything to see one in action.
Next trip, I’ll bring you a photo. Or at least a very detailed sketch.
So, Nether. Lava. Ghasts. What’s the one thing you’re glad you brought?
A shield. That Ghast fireball came from nowhere and nearly cooked my armor.
Smart move. I forgot mine last time and ended up naked in a lava lake.
Ha! At least you’re still here to tell the tale. Let’s grab some food.
I heard the Nether has a different weather system. Is it always hot?
It’s not just hot, it’s humid. And it rains lava. Or so it feels when a Blaze sneezes on you.
Lava rain... that explains why I need to wear my fire resistance armor.
Exactly. And if you see a Rain Cloud, run. It’s never good.
Storm's howling out there, isn't it? Perfect excuse to stay in.
I finished a new ale recipe. It's got a hint of pumpkin spice.
Careful, it's stronger than it looks. Don't say I didn't warn you.
Here, sit by the fire. The storm won't stop for hours.
Cold enough to freeze your ears off out there.
You bring any carrots? I could use some for the stew.
Only if you promise to taste the first ladle.
Deal. Now stop shivering, you're chilling the beer.
Did you see that lightning strike the oak tree?
It was dramatic. I thought it was going to catch fire.
Glad we're inside. Safety first, eh?
Next time, bring a bucket. We'll catch some rain for the garden.
The snow is finally stopping. Finally.
My feet are frozen solid. Do you have a spare pair of boots?
Maybe. But only if you help me shovel the entrance.
Fair enough. Besides, it's better than standing in the slush.
Rumor has it the north pass is clear of blizzards.
But don't trust the map. The wind shifts weirdly there.
If you go, I'll save you a seat by the hearth when you return.
Just don't get lost. I need my storyteller back.
Your house looks like a mushroom got drunk and fell over.
I used three types of stone and a single oak log. It’s called avant-garde.
Avant-garde? I think you just ran out of blocks and stopped caring.
Fine, it’s ugly. But it keeps the rain out, and that’s what matters.
Did you know that redstone dust conducts electricity in the dark?
No, it conducts signals, not electricity. Please don't call it that.
If you say 'signal' one more time, I’m unplugging your lamp.
Deal. Electricity. It’s just easier to say.
I spent four hours crafting that crafting table. It’s my masterpiece.
A crafting table? That’s just four planks. You’re joking, right?
It was the *perfect* planks. Symmetrical. Aesthetically pleasing. You just don't have vision.
Okay, okay. It has vision. I’ll buy you a pie for your trouble.
Watch this. I’m going to build a house out of glass and hope the lava doesn't touch it.
That’s not a plan, that’s a cry for help. Lava melts glass, you know.
That’s why I’m buying obsidian! But I’m too cheap to do it *now*.
Fine, I’ll save you when the glass turns into a puddle. Just don't burn my wool.
I put a door in the wall, but now I can't get in. What did I do?
You didn't place the door in the right slot. It’s just a texture now.
Right. The bottom slot. I was looking at the top one. My eyes are deceiving me.
It happens to the best of us. Here, I’ll help you fix the latch.
Oh, you're new here. I'm just digging some coal.
Nice pickaxe. Mine's always stuck in the dirt.
You probably know a shortcut to the caves.
If you find emeralds, split them with me, okay?
Your farm is looking pretty barren today.
Too many weeds, not enough carrots.
I brought some seeds in case you're desperate.
Don't say I didn't warn you about the weeds.
Do you ever get lonely out in the woods?
Just the wind and the birds, mostly.
Maybe we could walk together next time.
Only if you promise to keep up.
That house you built is... unusual.
The roof leans to the left, you know.
I could show you how to fix it, if you want.
But I'm not doing the heavy lifting.
I saw you talking to that zombie last night.
Weirdos always act like they're normal.
Well, I guess you can help with my inventory.
Just carry the torches, try not to drop them.
My cat just knocked my iron off the shelf. Again.
And I dropped my only sword trying to pick it up.
Guess I'm fighting creepers with a stick and a grumpy cat.
At least the cat purrs. I suppose that counts as morale.
That horse of yours looks like it's judging your mining skills.
He nuzzled me last night, though. So maybe you're doing okay.
Just don't let him eat my wheat or I'll have to kick him off the fence.
Kidding. He's sweet. Unlike some people I know.
Wolves are useful, but cats are... aesthetically superior.
A wolf will guard your door. A cat will steal your heart and your fish.
Besides, if a creeper comes, the cat will just hide under the bed.
So you still need a wolf for protection. But you deserve a cat for style.
I traded three fish for a stray cat. Best deal of my life.
Now it sleeps on my wool block and chases every bit of wool dust.
You should get one. They're basically tiny, furry store clerks.
Just don't ask it to trade. It'll just knock your items into the lava.
My horse bolted when a bat flew by. I'm still on the ground.
Turns out, 'gentle giant' is a relative term when it's a skittish stallion.
I think I'll stick to walking. Or maybe a donkey. They seem less dramatic.
If you see a calm horse, let me know. I have dirt to spread.
Found a rusty coin in the ruins. Want to split it?
Only if I get the shiny bit. You take the rust.
Deal. But if it’s a curse, you’re buying my new boots.
Boots? More like new armor. Stay close, okay?
They say there’s a chest under the old bridge. Really?
Probably just cobwebs and grief, but let’s check. I’ll bring bread.
Bread? What if we find diamonds? You’re too practical.
Practical keeps you alive. Diamonds are nice, but your smile is better.
I found a map fragment. It looks scary. Help?
Give it here. It’s just a map, not a skeleton. Breathe.
It points to the lava lake. You’re joking, right?
No jokes. I’ll bring water bottles. We go slow, together.
Grandma’s old journal mentioned a cellar under the house.
She hid my first birthday gift there. Let’s dig it up. I’ll hold the torch.
If it’s a spider’s nest, you’re running. I’ll defend the perimeter.
Deal. And if we find treasure, we buy cake. No arguments.
Rumor says the ancient ruin glows at night. Fancy a walk?
My hand is warm. The ruins are just stones. You’re the light.
Shh. Listen. The wind sounds like a lullaby. Stay here with me.
You're already down there? I thought you were afraid of the dark!
Afraid? Me? I just lost my lantern in a cave spider's web last week.
Haha, fair enough. Bring me back a diamond if you survive the trip.
You're on! But if I see you, I'm stealing it first.
The air down here tastes like old stone and regret. What do you see?
Diamonds, mostly. But also... I think I found a weird mushroom cluster.
No way! I bet it glows. That's magic, you know that, right?
We're keeping this between us. No telling the others, or they'll mob the cave.
My back hurts. And my knees. And my dignity.
You look tired. Here, I saved you a sweet berry bush back at base.
You're a lifesaver. I was about to eat a rotten fish out of desperation.
Next time, tell me if you're hungry. I always pack extra.
I found a pocket of nether quartz in the deep end. Do you want some?
No way, you keep it! I need it for my new redstone contraption.
A contraption? You're getting suspiciously good at this engineering thing.
Just trying to automate my life. One step at a time.
Did you hear about Steve? He fell into a lava lake. Alive, but... smelly.
Oh no! Did he lose his gear? I hope he's okay.
Lost his sword, but he's got a cat now. So, it balances out.
A cat! I should get one too. Maybe one that can mine?
The wheat is finally ready. Want to harvest it with me?
Only if you promise to watch my back from the creepers.
I've got your back, always. Come on, let's start.
Look at that golden glow. We make a great team, don't we?
I planted some carrots for you. They should be ripe by dusk.
You always remember the small things. It's so sweet.
I like knowing you enjoy my harvest.
Let's eat them together under the stars tonight.
The rain is coming. Stay close to the farm.
I'd rather be with you than worry about the beetroot.
Then hold my hand. The storm is loud.
As long as you're here, it's just weather.
I expanded the field for us. New soil, new start.
You really think about our future. It makes me happy.
We'll build a house right next to it soon.
And we'll name it after the first sun we saw together.
The chickens are acting weird. Come check this out.
They look like they're plotting something. Just like you.
Plotting what? I'm just here for the eggs.
I like that you're always here for the silly stuff.
Watch out, the night is getting dangerous.
I usually hide in my hut until the sun comes up.
Have you seen any zombies nearby?
Stay safe, stranger.
Those skeletons are a real pain at night.
I lost my bow to one last night.
You should craft extra arrows before dark.
Good luck with the night shift.
The moaning is coming from the west cave.
I wouldn't go in there if I were you.
Unless you want to die, that is.
Stay on the surface, it's safer.
Did you hear that creeper just now?
It sounded right behind my house!
I hope it doesn't blow up my fence.
Please, do something about it.
I saw a spider climb the wall last night.
It was the size of a sheep, or bigger.
I locked the doors tight after that.
You should check your door hinges too.
You want to trade? Show me the emerald, hide the snitch.
Three emeralds for that oak log. Don't argue with the market.
Did you hear the farmer by the river lost his iron? Scandalous.
Transaction complete. Keep your coin away from my stall.
Emeralds for wheat? My nose says you're short on cash.
The baker's wife swears her bread tastes better with snow fungus.
If you haggle again, I'll charge you double for the gossip.
Take your emeralds. I have a crowd to serve.
Your emeralds look suspiciously clean. Did you mine them today?
The mine at the north ridge is dangerous. Ask the zombie why.
I trade in goods, not secrets. Keep your map to yourself.
Here is your gold. Do not return before noon.
An emerald for a potato? You are either rich or foolish.
The librarian says the rain will stop by evening. He is usually wrong.
If you are rich, I will sell you that emerald. If foolish, I will keep it.
Good luck with your potatoes. Do not let them rot.
I saw you digging in the corner. Trying to steal my emeralds?
The smith claims he found a diamond in the dirt. I doubt it.
If you dig again, I will call the guards. Just kidding. Probably.
Keep your shovel away from my counter. We are done here.
Careful near that nether brick, love. It’s unstable.
I know, I just want to see the lava ocean.
Fine, but I’m holding your hand the whole time.
Deal. Now, which way to the crimson forest?
Did you pack enough netherrack for the bridge?
Yes, Dad, I have three full blocks.
Good. If you hear a ghast, don't run, back away slowly.
I’ll be careful. Save me a piece of cake when I’m back?
The air here feels so heavy, doesn't it?
It is. But I like it here with you.
Let's build a small shelter before the night cycle hits.
I already started on the walls. Come help me.
Look at that piglin. It’s staring at you.
He’s just curious. I won't pick up the gold.
Good call. Let's just walk behind it.
Phew. Now let's find some quartz for your lamp.
My feet are killing me in this nether wart field.
I know, right? Let's rest in that cave for a bit.
Perfect. I brought you a golden apple.
You’re the best. I was starving.
That rain is going to ruin my crop rotation again.
Well, maybe it's the clouds trying to water your carrots for free.
Free? I'm paying for it in mud on my boots.
Next time, I'll bring a bucket so we can collect some together.
It’s too cold out here to think about anything but stew.
I have a secret recipe for pumpkin pie that beats any stew.
Prove it. I’m not eating pie in this wind.
Deal. But if I win, you owe me a warm drink.
Did you hear the thunder? It shook the whole tavern.
It was loud. I thought my fence posts were going to snap.
If one snapped, I’m blaming the lightning, not you.
Noted. I’ll add ‘lightning’ to my excuse list.
Snow is nice, but it ruins my trading routes.
Maybe we can trade you some warm wool for your complaints.
Warm wool? Now you’re just being distracting.
Distraction is my job. You just have to accept it.
The wind is picking up. You should head inside.
I'm tough. It's just a little breeze.
Tough doesn't mean warm. Come get a fire going.
Fine. But I'm bringing the game I caught earlier.
Oh, hello. You look like you're staring at my fence for a reason.
Just checking if the wood is good. It’s... sturdy.
It’s oak. I prefer it. Pine splinters. Ask me again if you want to know why I hate pine.
Well, don't touch it. I just polished it.
You’ve got dirt on your cloak. Did you mine today?
Just a little. Found some coal in the cave.
Coal is good. I use it for smelting. You got any spare?
Maybe. If I have enough to trade you an emerald. We'll see.
It’s raining. Ugh. Mud is the worst. Don't you agree?
Yeah, it’s slippery. I nearly slipped on a slime last week.
Slime? In the rain? That’s just asking for it.
Well, at least I didn't fall in a hole. Probably.
You carry a lot of iron. Are you building something big?
Just expanding my house. It gets crowded.
My place is small, but cozy. I like the walls close.
Cozy is good. I should come over sometime. To look at it.
You have a strange look in your eye. What are you thinking?
Just thinking about where to go next. The desert is calling.
The desert? You'll die of thirst. Or heat. Or sand.
Maybe. But it's quiet. I need quiet.
That wolf over there? It bites. Keep your distance.
I saw a cat sit on it yesterday. The cat is fine, mostly.
Better to be safe than sorry. They are wild after all.
If you feed them, I'm not responsible for the mess.
Nice horse. You tame it yourself?
Bought it from the auction house. Good value.
It's a sturdy breed. Won't spook easily.
Try not to ride it too hard. It gets grumpy.
Is that a cat? It looks very aggressive.
He just has bad taste in owners.
Careful. He scratched my arm last week.
Just be glad he didn't go for your eyes.
Your wolf is well-behaved.
Took some time to train him, though.
He helps me guard the farm at night.
Good luck with yours, if you get one.
I prefer cats. They are quieter than horses.
Horses are too big for small houses.
Cats just sit there and judge you.
Don't tell the horses I said that.
Found a strange map in the attic, honey. It looks old.
It points to the ruins behind the village? That place is haunted.
We have armor now. Come on, let's see what's there together.
Deal. Just keep me close, okay?
Did you hear the elder talk of a golden chest in the cave?
I did. The maps say it's deep in the mines. Dangerous, but worth it?
Worth it if we can buy that new house. I'm coming with you.
The ruins are overgrown. I found some ancient seeds there.
Seeds? We can plant them in the garden. Imagine the harvest.
If they grow, we'll have food for winter. You're brilliant.
That rumor about the diamond room... it's real, isn't it?
Shh. I've got your back. We face them together.
You're heading down there again? The cave spider bites hurt twice as bad when you're tired.
Just bring a shield. You never know what’s lurking in the dark.
I found a diamond once. Took three hours to dig the tunnel. Not worth it.
Good luck. Or bad luck. I don't really care which.
Level 11 is the sweet spot. Trust me, I've seen the charts.
Any deeper and the lava pools get... aggressive.
Bring buckets of water. It’s a lifesaver if you hit a vein near the bottom.
Come back and show me what you found, okay?
Diamonds? I prefer emeralds. Less risk, more value.
Plus, zombies don't chase you as hard for green glass.
You're a fool if you dig straight down, by the way.
Keep it that way, and maybe you'll survive long enough to trade with me.
The cave air is so crisp down there. Nothing like it up here.
I once found a diamond that glowed in the dark. Magic, I think.
You should come with me sometime. We could explore the void together.
Just promise me you won't drop your torches. I hate the dark.
Diamonds are overrated. Cobblestone builds are forever.
One lava leak and your diamond sword is toast.
My house is made of stone. It’s solid. Like my friendship with you.
If you find a diamond, save one for me. I need a roof patch.
You're up? The carrots are waiting, and so am I.
I was napping. The sun is already blinding, give me a second.
Fine. I'll bring coffee to the field if you hurry up.
You're a lifesaver. I owe you a stack of bread later.
Did you water the wheat before bed? It looked thirsty.
Absolutely not. I left that duty to you, the 'expert'.
So you neglected our food supply for a nap? Wow.
Okay, okay. I'm going to check it right now. Don't worry.
The pumpkins are ready for harvest. Come help me move them.
My back hurts. Can't we just let the villagers eat them?
I'll carry the heavy ones. You just guide the path, okay?
Deal. I'll point you to the biggest ones. You're the strongest here.
I planted some flowers near the door. Do you like them?
They're pretty. Did you move the fence posts? It looks different.
Yes, I made more room for the berry bushes. It's better now.
Smart move. I love that you think of these little things for us.
It's raining. Perfect time to rest in the kitchen.
Only if you make soup. I'm starving.
Potato and carrot soup. Coming right up. Stay put.
Thank you. This is exactly what I needed today. You're great.
I saw a creeper in the mine again. Please tell me you have your sword ready?
Don't worry, I've got a fully enchanted sword. I'm bringing you a diamond in return.
Only if you come back to me. I can't sleep with a hole in the ground open.
I'll be careful. The bed is too warm without you anyway.
Did you hear that? I swear the spiders in the cave are talking about us.
Probably just hungry. I was about to say they look like they're judging my armor.
Your armor is fine, but I still want to be close to you when the sun goes down.
Deal. I'll stay on your side of the door tonight. Just don't let them bite me.
I left torches in the garden so the skeletons don't steal our crops again.
You really thought of everything. I feel so safe knowing you're handling that.
Just don't stay out too late. I saved you a slice of pie and a cozy spot by the fire.
I'm already heading over. The night is cold, and your company is warmer.
A zombie knocked my door off its hinges last night. Are you even alive?
Alive and well. I killed it and repaired the door. You're safe now.
You're my hero. I hate that I need you, but I'm glad I do.
And I'm yours. Now come inside before I have to fight another one.
I brewed some potion of fire resistance. Want to hold hands and walk through the Nether?
Only if you promise to keep me safe from the lava. And maybe a kiss for every portal.
Deal. The heat of the Nether is nothing compared to your gaze.
Let's go. I've never been so brave, or so scared, in my life.
You traded an emerald for a potato? That's the worst deal I've ever seen.
Well, I was hungry! Potatoes are better than shiny green rocks, right?
True, but if you don't have emeralds, you can't buy the nice wool for our new rug.
Fine. I'll dig up some diamonds. Just don't tell the iron golem I used his lance as a pickaxe.
Dad says the village elder is hoarding all the wheat. He's going to starve us.
Breathe. We have a full barn. I'll go trade a few emeralds to keep the peace, though.
You're the best. Oh! And Grandpa dropped a stack of emeralds in the garden again.
I'll pick them up. Hold on, I think I hear the zombies waking up. Stay close.
I found a chest full of emeralds in the mines! Look, I'm not selling one.
You're a hero. That means we can finally afford the bookshelf for our library.
Wait, does that mean you can stop complaining about the cold stone floor?
I never complained! I just... noticed the draft. Come on, let's go buy the carpet.
Mom, the butcher said you trade dead sheep for emeralds. Is that true?
Only the really fluffy ones. It's a family business, sweetie. Now pass me that emerald.
Do you think I can learn to trade? I like picking up shiny things.
Of course. But first, help me put the gossip about the blacksmith's wife in the compost bin.
I heard the village is short on emeralds. Should we buy some cheap crops now?
Good idea. I'll check the mine. You keep the crops warm. I trust you.
While you're down there, did you see the new fence? It looks crooked.
It's 'rustic chic'. Besides, it keeps the creepers out. That's all that matters.
The Nether smells like burnt sugar and regret. Trust me.
I saw a Piglin dance in the lava last week. It was terrifying and weirdly beautiful.
Just don't let the Ghasts see you staring. They really don't like that.
Maybe bring some gold. Just in case the dancing gets too intense.
Crystal caves are like a fever dream made of glass and silence.
I got stuck in a pillar once. The silence is louder than any hissing piglin.
You need a torch for the dark corners, not just for the Ghasts.
If you find a shulker, just... walk away. Some things are better left alone.
Basalt deltas? More like lava soup. It's all slippery and hot.
I broke three boots trying to cross the bridge. Don't ask how I landed.
Pack extra ladders. And maybe a potion of fire resistance. You're welcome.
And if you see a Blaze, run. Don't look back. Seriously.
The Nether is just the Overworld, but the lights are on fire.
I tried to farm Nether Warts in a cave. It got... messy.
Ghasts are basically angry jellyfish with fire breath. Who designed that?
Keep your head down and your luck high. You'll be fine.
Stranger? I've seen weirder biomes than this. You look lost.
The Nether roof is tricky. One wrong step and you're in the void.
I trade Nether Quartz for Diamonds. Only if you've got something shiny.
Don't crash my shop. I don't have time for your mess.
Pour me another ale, it's freezing out there.
Here you go. Mind the storm outside?
Freezing? I'll say. My toes are numb.
Stay by the fire, I've got your back.
Spring is finally here. The crops are popping.
Yes! I planted pumpkins last week.
Nice. I bet they'll be huge.
Let's trade some seeds later.
Did you hear about old Steve's mine collapse?
I did! He's okay, just lost his tools.
Rainy weather ruins everything, huh?
At least we're dry here. Cheers to that.
Winter's coming. Your roof leaky?
A little. I need some oak planks.
I've got spares. Come over tomorrow.
You're the best. I owe you a steak.
This thunder is loud. Scary, huh?
It's just rain. I'm right here.
You're right. Better than being out there.
Let's wait it out with a stew.
Watch your step. I just laid down a redstone wire.
If you break it, you buy it. That's the law.
Actually, I have some spare repeaters.
Trade you a stack of emeralds, then.
Your house looks... interesting. Very... unique.
Did you even use a crafting table?
I use a workshop, obviously.
Maybe try using actual blocks next time.
Psst, have you seen my new auto-farm?
It uses pistons to push the crops into hoppers.
Want to see it? It's behind the wheat field.
I saved you a spot, just in case.
Redstone is just... messy, isn't it?
I spent an hour on one lever.
Then it broke. So frustrating.
Maybe we should team up on a project?
Careful, that crafting table is fragile.
I mean, it's just wood, but... it's *my* wood.
If you drop it, I will charge you double.
Kidding. Mostly. Don't break it.
Your sword arm looks rusty. Did you forget how to swing, or are you just showing off your clumsiness?
Watch it, or I'm selling your tools for dirt. Literally.
Jokes aside, I saw you off that creeper. Not bad for a clumsy fool.
Maybe grab me an emerald? For your 'services'.
I baked a pie. It's in your house. Don't eat it all. I mean it.
It's got pumpkin. You like pumpkin, right? Everyone likes pumpkin.
If you eat it all, I'm telling the whole village you're a glutton.
Okay, fine. If you leave a slice, I'll buy you a cookie later.
Your farm is a disaster. Those crops are wilting from the stress.
Come on. Let's fix it together. I have the seeds, you have the energy.
I'll even let you pick the first tomato. It's the greenest one, though.
Don't trip on the fence. I'm not catching you. Probably.
I saw you talking to the sheep. Do you actually talk to them?
They're cute, I guess. But you're the weird one for narrating their lives.
Actually, their wool is really soft. You should try petting one. It helps with stress.
If you fall in love with a sheep, I'm not helping you build the barn.
You've been staring at that flower for ten minutes. Are you okay?
It's a rare orchid. I've never seen one before. It's just... beautiful.
I get it. Nature is pretty when you stop trying to mine it for resources.
Let's sit here for a bit. No swords, no shovels. Just us.
Your wolf kept licking my face. I think it's a compliment.
It definitely thinks it's the boss of the household.
Just don't let him chew on your saddles, or I'll be very cross.
Maybe give him some bones? He looks hungry.
I saw your cat sleeping on that horse earlier.
Did the horse even notice? That's some serious trust.
It was just standing there, looking confused but tolerant.
You really have a soft spot for weird animal combos.
My horse kicked the fence yesterday. My fault for distracting him.
It was a really nice fence too. Oak, at that.
Maybe keep the cats away from the stable?
Fair point. I'll start locking the stable door.
Your wolf is actually a great guard dog. Didn't scare off anything, but looks tough.
I mean, he did bark at a slime. Loudly.
That slime had no idea what was coming. Poor thing.
I might adopt a dog myself. Just to see if it's as dramatic.
I tried to pet the cat. It ran away. I'm not a dog person either.
Horses are fine, but cats are pure chaos.
Maybe if you offered some fish, it would change its mind.
I'll try that. Thanks. I just want a friend.
I found a chunk of ancient ruin stone in your bag. Did you dig it out from the old temple?
Careful with that. The last guy who touched it ended up buried up to his neck in sand. We don't need that happening to you.
Besides, if you find any gold, I want the first pick. My honeycomb reserves are running low, and I'm not asking the neighbors again.
Come inside, the soup is ready. We can map out the ruins by the fire and plan our next safe dig.
You look exhausted. Did the cave spiders chase you through the ruins again?
I heard a rumor that the center of the old dig site is actually a bedrock trap. You should have told me you were going there.
Next time you find treasure, bring it home to show me. I want to see what you found, but I want you safe first.
Here, drink this. It’s my special potion. No more digging until I check those ruins with you.
I saw that shimmering chest in the ruins. Did you take it? I hope you didn't trigger the skeleton trap.
If you did take it, we need to split the loot. I've been saving up for that new enchanted book, and you know how much I need it.
Stop teasing me. I'm just glad you walked out of there in one piece. That place is cursed, everyone says so.
Come on, let's go home. I made a dinner that's better than any treasure you'll find in that dusty hole.
Did you hear the gossip? They say the ruins are moving. I hope you didn't dig near the north wall.
If the walls moved, you could have been crushed. I was worried sick. Why didn't you text me when you got close?
I'm not mad. I'm just... careful. You're my favorite person, and I don't want to lose you to a cave-in.
Let's check the map together tonight. I'll brew some potions so we can explore safely next time, together.
I found a golden apple in the ruins. It's for you. You need the health boost before we go back out.
Eat it. And don't save it. I've seen you hoard food, and I want you strong for the next dig.
The rumors say the treasure room is just a storage closet now. But I still want to see it with you.
Pack your gear. I'll bring the torches. We'll be careful, and we'll share the view.
You think diamonds are easy? I've seen you dig straight into a lava lake.
Just use water. Or a bucket. I have no idea what you do down there.
If you bring back a single diamond, I might spare a word of praise.
Don't let it burn you. That would be an embarrassing end for a hero.
I found a diamond in the old cave system. It was glowing so bright.
It was under a patch of gravel. I almost missed it!
Maybe you'll get lucky next time you head underground.
Keep your torches lit, okay? It gets dark down there.
Diamonds? Ha. I've seen more than I can count.
But the deep caves? That's where the real treasure is.
You need iron tools at least. Gold breaks like paper.
Now go show me what you've got. Don't waste my time.
I heard a creeper exploded near the diamond vein last night.
It blew out half the cave wall. Everyone is scared.
Are you staying up there? It's too risky to go down now.
Please be careful. I don't want to lose another friend.
Deep caves are cold. And damp. And full of things that bite.
I'd rather farm carrots. At least they don't hiss at me.
If you find a diamond, trade me a carrot. That's the deal.
Just don't bring any monsters back to the village. Please.
I saved you a spot by the wheat patch.
You look tired. Sit down, I made bread.
The crops are good, but you are better.
Stay with me while we harvest, okay?
The rain finally stopped. Good, my potatoes are safe.
You were out there in the mud, weren't you?
Come inside, I have a warm towel for you.
We make a good team, you and me.
I planted a new row of carrots today.
Do you think they will grow big enough?
If they fail, I will blame the sun. And you.
Just kidding. I love you, you know that.
The chicken coop is overflowing with eggs.
I am going to make you a giant omelet.
Don't look at me like that, I am just hungry too.
Save some for me, please?
My hands are so dirty from the soil today.
Can you help me clean them? I don't want to see mud in my bed.
Your touch is very gentle. I like that.
Let's just sit here for a moment. No work.
Drop those emeralds. I bought the good wheat for a pittance, but you? You're bleeding me dry.
Hey, I'm saving for that diamond sword! You're welcome for the lesson in budgeting.
Fine, fine. Here. But if you die to a creeper, I'm not throwing a party.
I'll keep the emeralds. You keep the diamonds. We're even... mostly.
Did you hear? Old Tom is buying sheep wool with emeralds. At night. In the dark.
I told him to buy hay, but he wanted the fluffiest stuff. Who does that?
Maybe he's making a very expensive cloud. I hope it doesn't rain on us.
Seriously, if that cloud forms over my farm, I'm suing him for emotional distress.
I have these two rare emeralds. One for you, one for me. Fair, right?
Only if you promise to use yours to buy me a cake. I saw a new recipe.
Deal. But if you burn it, I'm telling everyone about the time you cried over a burnt toast.
That was a one-time thing! And the toast was... suspicious. Anyway, cake time.
You're looking rich. Did you find a vein or did you just get lucky in the market?
Found a little gold in the deepslate. But mostly, I traded off some rotten flesh.
Rotten flesh? You monster. I respect it, though. I'll try that.
Just don't let the zombies get your arm. Or your soul. Good luck.
I saw you leaving the village in a hurry. Everything okay? You look tense.
Yeah, just... some bandits. I'm fine. Don't worry, I handled it.
Tch. 'I handled it.' Next time, call me. I bring the good potions. And the bad temper.
Okay. Next time, I call. But only if you buy the potions. No cheap stuff.
I brought you a chorus flower from the Crimson Forest. It glows like your smile.
Your eyes are prettier than a Ghast's fireball, but at least you don't explode.
We should build a bridge in the Nether. Just the two of us, away from the village.
Come here. Let me share this Netherrack so it burns for both of us.
Did you get that Soul Sand? It's the only thing that feels as calm as you.
I'd cross lava for you. I've done it for better pizza, so imagine this.
The Nether is hot, but not as hot as when you laugh at my jokes.
Stay close to me. The Wither Skeletons are scary, but I'm scarier if you get hurt.
I found a new biome with purple grass. It looks like magic, just like you.
Let's go there together. I promise not to leave you behind in the fog.
The fog is thick, but I can see you clearly. You're my compass.
If we get lost, I'll just hold your hand until we find the way home.
I mined some Quartz for you. It's white like your heart, isn't it?
Don't mine too deep. I get worried when you're in the dark with those Creepers.
I'd rather be stuck in a cave with you than anywhere else in the Overworld.
Keep me warm. The Nether is hot, but your touch is better.
I saw a Strider swimming in lava and thought of you. You're a smooth move.
You're the only one I'd share my fire resistance potion with.
The Nether is a mess, but you make it beautiful. Just look at you.
Let's stay in the Nether. I like it here when it's just us and the heat.
The rain is just annoying. Get over here, under my cloak.
You're cold, aren't you? I knew it.
Here, hold this hand. It’s warm enough for two.
Let it rain. I have everything I need right here.
Another frosty night. Perfect for staying in.
The fire is crackling. I made extra stew.
Just the two of us, safe from the snow.
Stay close. The cold can't touch us here.
Spring is coming. I can smell it in the soil.
We should plant flowers. Just for us.
Imagine the petals in your hair. It would be stunning.
I can't wait for you to wear them. Come help me plant?
That storm out there... it's scary, isn't it?
But I'm not scared with you here.
You are my safe harbor in any storm.
Let's just sit here. The world can wait.
The sun is out! It's practically shouting at me.
I bought this honey for a sunny day. You have to try it.
Spoon-feeding you would be fun, but I'll let you try first.
If you like it, I'll make it every sunny day for you.
I put a lever on the door, but now I can't get in.
Did you use a sticky piston? I told you that was the safe way.
Well, the redstone torch flickered at the worst moment.
Come here, let me fix it before you lock yourself out again.
The basement is finally finished. Look how cozy it is.
Cozy? It's a hole in the ground, Dad. But thanks.
It has wool walls and a trapdoor. That's top-tier engineering.
Fine, it's nice. Just add a bookshelf for luck.
I crafted a new set of iron armor for the cellar.
You didn't have to do that, but thank you.
Someone has to keep the house safe while you're napping.
I was resting my eyes! I'll make dinner to say sorry.
The farm fence is broken again. A wolf got in.
I saw that wolf. It was staring at me with those cold eyes.
So we need a new fence. And maybe a dog.
A dog! Yes! I'll craft the leads. Let's go now.
I put a redstone lamp in the hallway. It's beautiful.
It's lovely. I love how you light up the house.
I just wanted to see your face when you came home.
You always do this. My heart can't take it.
Stop wandering off, I made your favorite stew.
You always work so hard, let me take care of you for a minute.
Just sit down, your boots are caked in dirt again.
I saved you the good chair, the one by the fire.
Did you get the wool for the new rug?
Almost, but the sheep were being stubborn again.
Ha! I’ll help you round them up tomorrow.
Deal. But you have to let me pick the color scheme.
The wind is howling tonight, isn't it?
It is. I’m glad we finished the roof repairs.
Come closer to the fire, you look cold.
You always know exactly what I need.
I found a rare flower while exploring the forest.
Oh! Is it the glowing one from the cave?
Yes, it’s perfect for our garden bed.
You always make the best gifts for me.
The kids are finally asleep.
Good. I’ve been waiting for this moment all day.
Just for a moment, let's forget about the farm.
I love being home with you.
Who is a good boy? I’m pretty sure it’s you.
Look, even the village cat is sleeping on your lap.
We should name him after that horse we missed.
Just don’t let him bite the farmer again, okay?
The foal looked at me like I owed him carrots.
He’s probably plotting to steal our entire wheat stockpile.
Remember when we trained the grey one? He was a menace.
Let’s just call him 'Carrot Thief' to save trouble.
Did you see the wolf that followed us home?
I think he’s just lonely. Look at that tail wag.
We have enough space in the barn for one more.
Just don't let him eat your boots again.
The cats are fighting over the last treat.
It’s like watching a tiny, furry war council.
We should get more treats to keep the peace.
You handle the big one, I’ll get the small one.
That horse remembers where we buried the treasure.
He’s the only one who knows we took extra iron.
If he speaks, we’re both in trouble.
Let’s give him a carrot to keep him quiet.
Psst, did you hear the dig site by the old oak is cursed?
I saw a skeleton face staring back at me from the dirt. Spooky, right?
Bring your best sword then. I’ll bring the torches and the bad luck.
If we find treasure, I call dibs on the gold blocks. You take the emeralds.
They say the ruins in the swamp hold a map to the lost temple.
I’ve been saving up for a compass and a map. Ready to ditch the farm?
Swamp zombies are annoying, but I’ll handle them if you handle the treasure.
Just promise me you won't drop the loot in the water again.
I found a weird block in my mine. Glowing purple. What is that?
Don't touch it! I think it's tied to the old ruins' curse.
Okay, calm down. I brought a potion of protection. Drink this.
Now, let's crack it open and see what treasure is waiting inside.
Rumor has it, the treasure in the deep ruins is guarded by a dragon.
A dragon? Please. We have Elytra and enchanted gear. It’s nothing.
If we survive, I’m buying you a full set of diamond armor. Deal?
Deal. But you’re carrying the torches. I’m handling the dragon.
I think I broke something in the ruins. The walls are shifting.
Relax. I’ve got a block of bedrock. We can hold the wall up.
Actually, that’s a good thing. There’s a chest right behind that wall.
See? Mistakes lead to treasure. Let’s open it.
Careful down there. The air gets thin the deeper you go.
I saw a wither skeleton last night. You didn't see it, did you?
Diamonds are rare. Don't expect to strike rich every time.
Just keep your pickaxe sharp. Good luck out there.
You're heading to level -59? That's pretty deep.
I hear the lava pools down there are wide. Be careful.
If you find any emeralds, I might trade you something.
Safe travels. Try not to fall in a cave-in.
That ore looks like coal. Again.
Diamonds are usually found deeper. Just saying.
I found one last week. Smallest thing ever.
Good luck. You'll need it.
Mind the creepers. They love dark places.
If you get hit, run back here. I'll wait.
Diamonds are worth more than gold. Remember that.
Don't be long. I have things to do.
Your armor looks thin for deep caves.
One skeleton shot and you're done. Just a fact.
Maybe buy some better gear before you go down.
Whatever you do, don't blame me if you die.
Hey! Come look at this pumpkin, it's got a face. A mean one, I think.
If I name it Steve, will you promise not to dig it up for blocks?
Deal. But only if you help me water the carrots next plot.
Perfect. Now pass me the hoe, you lazy bone.
Did you hear Old Man Paul's wheat crop failed again? Total disaster.
He said it was the rain, but we all know it's his bad luck.
Shh! He might hear you. Or maybe not, his hearing's gone.
We should give him our best seeds just to watch him struggle harder.
My potato field is overrun with creepers. I'm not digging them out.
Come on, bring your sword. I'll bring the torches. Teamwork.
If you blow up a potato, you owe me ten golden carrots.
Deal. Now move, before they hiss at me again!
Look at this pumpkin. It's perfectly round. Suspiciously round.
I think a witch touched it. Or maybe just the rain. Hard to tell.
If it glows, we're selling it. No questions asked.
50/50 split? I'll take the glow, you take the weight.
I made you a pie. Don't look at it, just look at me.
It's... mostly flour. And hope. And a little apple.
If you don't eat it, I'm putting it on your windowsill. Forever.
It's the best pie in the village. Trust me. Eat it.
Stay away from the door. If I see a creeper, I’m not opening it.
I prepared torches, but the dark feels... hungry tonight.
Just keep your sword ready. I can’t protect everyone alone.
If we survive this, I’ll owe you a lot. Maybe a few emeralds.
Did you hear that? I think a zombie is chewing on my fence.
Please, don't just stand there! Help me!
Okay, okay... breathe. We have a shield now.
That was too close. I think I need a drink.
Shh. The skeletons are singing again. It’s so annoying.
If you shoot them, they drop bones. I need those for my wand.
Hurry up, the moon is high. I don't have all night.
Fine. You can have one bone. It’s not much, but I’m grateful.
My farm is going to be destroyed. Those slimes are everywhere.
Can you guard the wheat? I’ll deal with the cows.
Thanks! I know you’ve got this. You’re strong.
When this is over, I’ll trade you a pumpkin pie. It’s delicious.
Look at that moon. It’s beautiful, isn't it? If only it wasn't so dangerous.
I don't mind the cold. As long as you're here to keep me warm.
Careful. A spider just bit me. It’s nothing, really.
Let’s go inside. I have a bed and... I’d like to keep you close.
Got any spare emeralds? I heard the iron prices are up again.
Only if you trade fair. Last guy tried to swindle me with rotten flesh.
Deal. Two emeralds for that block of iron, no less.
Don't tell anyone I sold you that cheap. It looks bad for my reputation.
Did you hear about Farmer Bob? He tried to barter a single carrot for a diamond.
I laughed so hard I dropped my whole stack of wheat. Total disaster.
Bob just shrugged and said 'it's organic, it has value.' Cheeky guy.
Anyway, if you have any bread, I'll trade you a loaf for two emeralds. Fair, right?
Your armor looks shiny. Did you mine that iron yourself?
Must be tough work. I see a lot of people getting eaten by zombies down there.
Joking! Mostly. But bring me some coal and I'll give you a torch. Useful, right?
Better safe than sorry, eh? Stay out of the cave if you can.
The weather is awful today. I can't get anyone to buy my wool.
Rain ruins everything. Even the sheep look grumpy.
If you're holding any wool, I'll pay double for it right now. Desperate times.
Thanks. This might actually save my week. Keep the change.
Whispering is rude. I can hear you plotting something shady.
I saw you talking to the blacksmith. Did you buy that new sword?
Smart move. I'm not saying I'm scared of skeletons, but I am a bit nervous.
Keep it between us, okay? I have a reputation to maintain.
Come on, I'll guard your back while you cross the lava.
Don't look at the blaze, look at me.
See? I told you we'd make it back in one piece.
Now that we're safe, can I hold your hand?
This nether forest is way too quiet for my taste.
Unless you count the sound of my heart pounding next to you.
You're smooth. Even in the Nether.
Let's find a portal home before I say something too embarrassing.
I found these netherrack bricks... they look like our house.
Maybe we can build a nursery room here, don't you think?
Only if you promise to help me with the redstone wiring.
Deal. But you're carrying the heavy blocks, partner.
That ghast was screaming like it was in love with you.
It probably just wants to steal my favorite person away.
I'd rather be shot by a fireball than leave you.
Good. Now stop talking and shoot the next one.
I got you a chorus fruit from the spawn. It's sweet, like you.
Careful, it might teleport us into a lava lake.
Worth the risk if it means we end up close together.
Eat it, then. I want to see that sweet face.
Blinding rain, isn't it? Stay out of the mud if you value your boots.
Grab a seat by the fire. The soup's hot enough to melt the frost off your armor.
Don't touch the candle. It's enchanted to keep the damp off the wood, and it bites if you mess with it.
If you finish that bowl, I might tell you which cave is dry enough to sleep in tonight.
Winter’s here, huh? Your wool coat is already starting to look like a cloud.
I brewed this cider with apples from the north orchard. It’s got a kick, so drink slow.
It burns a bit, doesn't it? That means it’s working against the cold.
Next year, I’m planting cactus in the greenhouse. Bet you can’t guess why.
Thunder like that usually means the lava flow in the nether is shifting. Watch out for stray fireballs.
Keep your shield up. The rain here conducts static. It’s nasty if you’re wearing enchanted gear.
See that flash? That’s not lightning. That’s a Wither Skull breaking the cloud cover.
Run. Don't look back. I'll hold the door, but I can't save you from that thing.
Spring is finally here. The flowers are blooming, and I think I can smell the bees.
Come with me. I found a patch of sunflowers that haven't been picked yet.
The light hits the petals just right. It’s like the world is smiling at us.
Stay a while? The sun’s still high, and I don't want this moment to end.
Stormy nights are the best for trading. Everyone’s stuck inside, so prices go up.
I’ve got emeralds, but I’m only selling them for double the usual rate. You’re welcome for the 'discount'.
If you can't pay, you can work off the debt. Shovel coal until your hands bleed.
Or, you can just leave. The door's right there. It doesn't lock during storms, unfortunately.
Hey, did you finish the redstone wiring in the basement?
Almost done. Just need to place the last repeater.
Good. Don't trip the pressure plate again, last time it launched me into the wall.
Haha, that was one time. Come, let's test it together.
The kitchen crafting table is out of reach for the cat.
I moved it to the second shelf. You're welcome.
Thanks. Now, can we craft some wool for the new rug?
Already on it. I even dyed it your favorite shade of teal.
Watch your step, the floor is sticky from the syrup crafting.
Oh no. Did I get it on your boots?
A little. I'll clean it up. Stay there, it's almost done.
Here, hold this. The glue is setting in the corner.
The new window frames look perfect. You have a good eye.
Thanks. I wanted to let more light in for your reading nook.
It's beautiful. Come sit with me, the light is warm.
Just the place. This is my favorite corner of the house.
I made you a new crafting grid layout. It's faster.
Oh, nice. You put the tools in the top row?
Yes. I know you always reach for the hammer first.
You always know what I need before I ask.
You didn't bring me a diamond? I was hurt.
Okay, okay, I brought an apple. Consider it a peace offering.
It's not the gift, it's the thought, which was clearly a rotten one.
Fine. You're forgiven. Now help me move this chest.
I saw you talking to that zombie. Were you flirting?
He just asked for my inventory. I was very polite.
Polite? With a stick? You're a menace, you know that?
Next time, punch first, ask questions later. You're stuck with me anyway.
My heart is breaking. The sunflower in your farm died.
It was a sacrifice to the Harvest Goddess. Don't be so sentimental.
Sentimental? I just miss the yellow. It matched my shirt.
I'll plant three. One for you, one for me, and one for the shirt.
You look tired. Did you sleep in that cave again?
It was cozy. And warm. Unlike your side of the bed.
My side is cozy! It's the side with the wool. You're just a cold-blooded creature.
Here. A blanket. Don't freeze to death, you idiot.
I think I like you. Like, a lot. The 'best friend' lot.
Careful. I might start talking in your sleep. Like you do.
I dream about you building that ridiculous castle.
It was a vision. And I was in it. Wearing a crown. It was... nice.
Your wolf is staring at me like I owe it a bone. Mind introducing us?
He's just curious. He doesn't bite... usually.
Usually is doing a lot of heavy lifting there, friend.
If he does bite you, just tell him I said you're a good dog.
That cat of yours has more dignity than half the villagers I know.
She only respects me when I have fish. It's a very mercenary relationship.
I tell my villagers that about my sheep. They never believe me.
Maybe your sheep need a lesson in perspective. Or a treat.
Your horse looks like it's judging my building skills.
Don't listen to him. Horses have no taste in architecture.
See? He's just jealous he doesn't have a stable of his own.
I'll build him a fancy stall. Maybe with a mirror for his ego.
I think I left my cat in the house. Do you hear any purring?
Actually, I saw her chasing a bat in the corner. She's fine.
Oh, thank goodness. That cat has a death wish, you know.
She's basically a tiny ninja. You should see her pounce on a spider.
My wolf keeps trying to herd the villagers into the pen. What's wrong with him?
He's just trying to be helpful. Villagers are easier to manage when they're together.
Helpful my foot. He pushed Old Bob into the water. Again.
Maybe he's training you to be a shepherd. Or a water skier.
Heard a rumor about a chest full of diamonds under the old ruins.
Don't trust it too much, but my heart says go dig.
If it's a mob farm, I'm blaming you for the skeletons.
Bring a shovel and I'll bring the luck. Deal?
They say the ruins have a room full of emeralds. Sounds fake.
But if it's real, I'm buying every single one from you.
Only if you don't charge me 'discovery fees.'
We'll split the profits fifty-fifty. Fair and square.
Old maps say there's a dungeon beneath the wheat fields.
You're joking. Mobs under my crops? That's a disaster.
I'll clear the mobs if you let me keep the loot.
Fine, but I'm keeping the emerald hoe.
Whispers say the ruins glow at midnight. Magic, maybe?
Or it's just exposed glowstone. Don't get your hopes up.
Either way, it's a perfect place for a night watch.
I'll bring torches. You bring the stories.
Saw a creeper near the ruins. It looked... confused.
Confused is still explosive. Keep your distance.
Unless you want to test if it likes carrots.
No. I'm not feeding you to a creeper, no matter how cute it is.
You're down here? Don't get lost.
I only go as deep as Y-level -59.
Diamonds are rare down there. Careful.
If you find a lot, maybe trade me.
That pickaxe looks rusty.
You'll be digging forever with that.
I use iron. It's faster.
Maybe I'll sell you a new one. Eventually.
Did you see the mossy cobblestone?
It's everywhere down here. Weird, right?
I like the quiet in the deep caves.
You seem like you'd like it too.
Careful, there's a lava lake nearby.
I drowned last time. Not fun.
Keep your buckets full.
Don't ask how I know.
Are you looking for diamonds?
Most people just want emeralds.
Diamonds are for building, though.
Whatever you need, I guess.
The wheat is golden. It looks like a sunset, you know?
It does. We worked hard for this harvest, my love.
Come inside. I saved you the best pumpkin pie.
Just in time. I was getting hungry.
Did you water the carrots? I can't find my bucket.
Yes, they are all fat and ready to eat. Relax.
I was just worried. They are our winter supply.
I know. That is why I am here. Let's go in before it rains.
Look at these new seeds. I thought you would like the melon ones.
You remembered! I love that you pay attention to details like this.
We should plant them by the river. The water is good there.
Deal. I will fetch the shovel. You bring the love.
The chickens are acting strange. They won't go into the coop.
Probably the weather. Let's check the roof for leaks first.
You are right. It is leaking. Good catch, my dear.
I will fix it in the morning. Let's just make sure they are warm tonight.
I made bread with the flour from today's wheat. It smells amazing.
You always make the best bread. It is our favorite treat.
I was thinking we could start a bakery stall if we have extra.
I would love that. We can name it 'Our Harvest'.
Don't you dare let a creeper near my hay bales again.
I was busy trying not to die, remember?
Exactly! You survive, I farm. We're a team.
Deal. Now go guard the door, I'm tilling soil.
That skeleton shot me in the leg again.
Ouch. Did you use the golden apple?
No, I was too busy tripping over my own feet.
Next time, I'm carrying you. You're just a burden.
I saw a zombie holding a shovel. It looked... official.
Probably a town guard who missed his shift.
Hilarious. My house is next door to that zone.
Come inside then. I made soup. Zombies hate heat.
Stop sleeping with one eye open. I've got your back.
I can't help it. Those Wither Skeletons are rude.
Rude and loud. I'll brew a potion to silence them.
You're the best. Now, less brewing, more hugging.
I lost my iron sword to a pillager. I'm so mad.
Shh. I saw the pillager drop it. It's in the bush.
Really? You're a lifesaver. I hate pillagers.
Let's burn the camp down. For fun and justice.
Emeralds only. No apples, no dirt. I'm serious.
Why are you staring? Do you have emeralds or not?
Fine. Here. Try not to drop it on the cobblestone.
Next. And tell no one I gave you a discount.
Oh! A new face. Did you hear about Old George's farm?
He got eaten by a creeper. All his wheat, gone in a puff.
Now his emerald prices are up. You want a bag of his seed stock?
Deal? I'm not holding my breath, but the offer stands.
Your armor looks... questionable. Have you been mining?
I don't want to trade with someone who might explode in my shop.
Bring me five emeralds and I'll sell you a bed. For safety.
Better safe than a crater in my floor. Go on.
Psst. You hear the rumors about the blacksmith?
He's hiding a stash of diamonds under the anvil. Sworn secret.
Don't tell him I told you. Or I'll double your emerald prices.
Now go. And watch out for the skeleton in the alley.
Trade? Me? No way. I'm on break.
Go bother someone else. They don't have my standards.
...Unless you have a rare flower. Then maybe.
And keep your distance. I don't trust newbies.
You really don't need to go back to that lava sea, do you?
Just grab some fire resistance potions, okay? I'll wait up for you.
If you get stuck in a soul sand valley, just yell. I'll hear you.
Come back to our home before the zombies start knocking again.
Did you see that crimson forest? It looks like a nightmare.
The trees were breathing, I swear. We have to build a greenhouse here.
I bet nether wart grows faster if we sing to it. Let's try.
Just make sure the piglins don't steal our seeds, okay?
I left your favorite melon slices on the portal frame. Eat before you go.
The air in the Nether is dry. It'll make your bread stale if you carry it too long.
If you find a quiet corner, send me a bone. I'll know you're safe.
Hurry back. The soup is getting cold and I miss your face.
Did you bring the obsidian blocks? I don't trust the cheap portal.
Last time you used a broken portal, you came back with a piglin tattoo.
I'll hold the flare if you need to light it. Don't burn the house down.
Just remember, the Nether is not for us. We belong here.
I saw a shulker in the basalt delta. It was singing.
It sounded like the wind in our roof. Do you remember that night?
Maybe it was lonely. Let's bring it a lantern when we return.
Come back to me. The Nether has no sun, but you are my light.
Blasted rain again. Ruined my crop rotation plans.
Guess I'll just watch you get soaked while you complain.
Not that I'm complaining. Just noting the irony.
Anyway, the fire's lit. Don't let the damp get to you.
Snow's deep enough to bury a whole house if you're not careful.
You really think you can shovel that much? Bold of you.
Keep going. I'll be here with the hot cocoa.
Just don't freeze. That's a bit tragic for a tavern regular.
Wind howling outside. Sounds like a ghoul trying to get in.
If it actually gets in, I'm billing you for the damage.
Or maybe we let it in. Ghoul stew is a delicacy, you know.
Kidding. Mostly. Sit by the fire, it's safe here.
Rainy day. Perfect time to discuss your mining methods.
You left that tunnel open? Really? The water's gonna get in.
Next time, plug it. Or I'm not selling you torches.
Jokes aside, go fix it. The storm is picking up.
Spring is coming. The mud will be unbearable.
Unless you're planning to dig trenches. I respect that.
The cows will be happy, though. Fresh grass means happy cows.
Happy cows mean good cheese. That's a win for you.
Look at that oak house. Did you build it with a hammer?
