It's 'rustic chic,' you are clearly missing the subtlety.
Save it. I saw you falling off the roof three times yesterday.
Worth it. The view from the top is worth the bruises.
Your redstone clock is ticking in 4/4 time, isn't it?
It's artistic chaos. You wouldn't get it with that logic brain of yours.
Fine, fine. But it's shorting out the farm next door.
On it. I'll reroute the pistons before the crops die.
Need a hand? I have spare sand and a whole lot of patience.
You're a lifesaver. I was about to give up and build a dirt hut.
Dirt huts are for cowards. Hand me that ladder.
There you go. Now we just need to pretend we know what we're doing.
Did you craft that torch with a sickle? It looks bent.
It's a stress fracture. Adds character to the wall.
Character won't keep the creepers away, you know.
True. I'll re-craft them properly. Just give me a minute.
This crafting station is a disaster zone. I can't find a single stick.
I see them. They are buried under three layers of cobblestone.
Stop laughing. Dig them out before I drop it all.
Got 'em. Here. Now let's sort this mess before the sunset.
I saw you digging that hole. Are you trying to find diamonds or just a place to hide from the sun?
Just giving you a head start on the rain! It's coming in fast.
Grab an emerald? I'll trade you a nice stack of bread if you get me some coal.
Deal. Now get inside before your inventory gets wet and sad.
Your farm looks... ambitious. Are those carrots or tiny orange rocks?
They're carrots! I'm just practicing efficient spacing for the winter.
Winter's months away. Maybe trade me some seeds now so I can grow something that isn't orange?
Fine, but if you water them with lava, I'm blaming you.
Did you hear the sheep down the road are singing opera again?
I thought it was just wind in the fence. Do they have good taste in music?
They prefer baroque. I brought a lute, but they seemed unimpressed.
Next time, I'll bring a pie. They can't resist a pastry, even if they are divas.
You've been staring at that oak sapling for ten minutes. Is it... blocking your view?
I'm contemplating its potential. It could be a door, a table, or a secret door.
A secret door to where? My pantry is already full of cookies.
Then build it to my pantry. I trust your architectural judgment. Mostly.
I lost a battle to a creeper last week. It was very... personal.
Creepers are just shy. They get close to say hello, and it explodes.
I should have brought a shield. And maybe a hug. For the creeper.
Next time you face one, tell it I said sorry. Maybe it'll let you live.
Your wolf just ate my bread. Again.
It says you're the only one who understands its hunger.
I'll buy you two loaves to make up for it.
Deal. But he still owes me an apology.
Did you see my cat sleeping on your sword?
She claims it's a warm spot. I can't argue with that.
Careful, she might scratch it while you're not looking.
If she does, I'm billing you for a new enchantment.
Your horse looked at me like I owed it carrots.
He has excellent taste, I just haven't budgeted for it yet.
I'll trade you two carrots for one of my apples.
He'd hate you if you said no.
You trained that wolf to fight skeletons?
He just really hates them. I just provide the direction.
I wish my cat had that kind of loyalty.
She'll help you carry a sword. That's loyalty enough.
My horse kicked the fence I built. On purpose.
It was a sturdy fence. He just likes open spaces.
I'll help you rebuild it, but only if you name the horse 'Punishment'.
Done. Punishment it is. Now hand me that pickaxe.
I found a map in the ruins that looks like it leads to your house.
Only if you promise to watch my back in the dark.
Deal. I've got my sword sharp and my heart softer.
Let's go find that treasure, but keep your eyes on me.
The elders say there's gold in the old mines, but I only want your smile.
You're trouble, but I like that you're mine to worry about.
Then come with me. I'll share any gold I find, if you share your time.
My time is already yours, so let's dig for something beautiful.
I heard a ghast howled near the ruins last night. Scared?
Not of the ghost. Just worried about getting cold without you next to me.
Then I'll keep you warm. The treasure can wait a little longer.
Good. Let's go build a fire in the ruins, just us.
This ancient tome says the treasure is guarded by love itself.
Then we must be very careful, or we might lose each other.
We won't. I've got you, and you've got me.
Let's open the door together. Hand in hand.
I found a diamond chest, but it's locked by a riddle about your heart.
My heart is open to you, silly. That's the answer.
Correct. Now the chest opens, and so does my affection for you.
Keep the diamonds. You're the only treasure I really want.
You're heading down there? Be careful, the caves get dark fast.
I saw a creeper behind that oak tree yesterday. Just a heads up.
If you find any diamonds, don't expect me to split the loot.
Good luck. Try not to die down there, it's a nuisance to clean up.
My torches are all burnt out. Do you have a spare?
Here you go. Just hold on, I'm mining here.
Thanks. This vein looks promising, though.
Yeah? Hope it's not just coal again.
It's freezing down here. Did you pack any armor?
I have iron. Should be enough for skeletons.
Better safe than sorry. Zombies are tough in the dark.
I'll keep that in mind. Thanks for the warning.
Do you hear that? Something's moving in the next room.
Stay close. We'll check it out together.
Oh no, it's a skeleton. Draw your bow.
We made it. That was close, wasn't it?
I found some gravel. Again. I hate this block.
Don't let it ruin your day. Maybe next layer.
Gravel turns into falling blocks. It's a trap.
Keep your eyes open. Diamonds hide in the dirtiest spots.
Oh, you're new here? Mind not stepping on my carrots?
Wheat takes longer to grow, but it's more reliable than pumpkins.
We only harvest when the sun is high. Saves the energy.
Don't tell the iron golem I said that. He gets grumpy.
Your boots are muddy. Watch where you step.
Mud spreads disease. Crops hate it as much as I do.
Wipe your feet. Or don't. I don't care, just stay back.
If you break a seed, you buy ten. That's the law here.
Do you know how to plant beets?
I always forget if it's north or south. The soil feels different.
If you show me, I'll trade you some good bread.
Thanks. Most people just walk past without saying hello.
Rain is coming. Cover your seeds, quick!
Wet dirt is soft. You'll sink if you're not careful.
I'll watch the horizon. You focus on the rows.
Good. We'll have a bountiful harvest despite the storm.
Your crops look... different from mine.
Are you using magic? It grows faster that way.
Just tell me the trick. My pumpkins are stunted.
Deal. I'll give you a tip if you share one secret.
You out here? I thought we were all hunkered down by now.
Just saw a creeper charging the north wall. You want to trade a torch for a sword?
Deal. But if I die, I’m haunting your inventory.
Fair enough. Stay close, I don't want to carry you back in a bucket.
Zombies are knocking on my door. Again.
Did you actually build those iron bars? Or just hope they break?
It’s a tactical retreat! I call it 'creative destruction'.
Sure, sure. Come on, I’ll help you reinforce the gate before the next wave.
I saw a skeleton shoot a torch at my cat. He’s fine, but he’s mad.
Does he know how to hold a bow? Because I do, and I’m tired.
Bring him inside. I have some fish for him.
Thanks. He likes you. He also ate your shoe yesterday.
It’s raining. And there are zombies. Worst combo.
At least the rain makes the slimes slip. I caught three last night.
Slime balls make good coins if you crush them right.
I'll try. Wish me luck. Or don't. It's raining anyway.
I heard a warden groaning under the mountain.
If you go dig for diamonds, I’m not coming. I like my legs.
Fair. I’ll just stay here and watch the lava pit.
Watch out for blazes. They spit fire. Very rude.
I saw the blacksmith offering a sword for only two emeralds. He’s either crazy or blind.
Two? For a *sword*? He must have lost his eyesight in that last zombie siege.
Careful, he saw you. Buy him a cake and I'll buy that sword for our backup plan.
Deal. But if you get hit, I’m blaming the sword, not the blacksmith.
The wheat prices are up. We can afford new wool for the bedroom if we sell half the crop.
Only if you pick the shade. I trust your eye more than mine, even with all this light.
I was thinking white. It goes with the oak floors and makes the house feel bigger.
White it is. I’ll handle the emeralds, you handle the decorating. Teamwork.
Did you hear the fisherman is selling enchanted books for dirt? Just dirt.
If it’s real, I’m taking it. If it’s a trap, I’m bringing a shield. Cover my back?
Always. I’ll stand by the door. If he blinks, I hit him with a fishing rod.
You’re ridiculous. And I love it. Let’s go get that book.
The iron prices dropped. We can fix the fence before the snow comes.
I’ll bring the hammer. You bring the warmth. It’s freezing out there.
I made soup. It’s still hot. Come in, the cold stays outside.
This is the best part of the day. Just us, the fire, and no creepers.
Grandpa’s old mining pick is worth three emeralds now. Collectors love the pattern.
He was always the best at finding diamond veins. I guess the pick remembers.
Let’s sell it. Put the emeralds toward the nursery. He’d want that.
He would. I’ll frame the receipt. And keep the pick for luck.
Blasted Lapis. Ruined my whole day.
What happened? You look like you saw a ghost.
I was just trying to find diamonds, not a creeper's revenge.
Next time, I'm bringing a shield and a lot of luck.
Did you know my sheep went to the Nether?!
Wait, how do you even get a sheep to the Nether?
I put him in a bucket and opened a portal. He's fine, just very red.
That is the most terrifying story I have ever heard.
My soul sand is in the wrong place again.
The Nether is always tricky. It shifts around, doesn't it?
I swear the coordinates change when you're not looking.
I'll mark it with a torch. That should keep it honest.
I saw a Ghast. A real, flying, screaming Ghast.
Did it shoot fireballs at you?
It almost hit my head! I ran like I had never seen a door before.
Good thing you have me. I'm great at dodging fire.
Netherrack dust gets into everything.
My whole house smells like burnt bread now.
Maybe we should trade in the Overworld. It's less... spicy.
Deal. I'll bring some cocoa beans to clear the air.
It's pouring out there. You better not be planning on mining in this mess.
Rain makes the caves slippery. One wrong step and you're sleeping with the fish.
I keep my gear dry near the hearth. Should have brought you a spot, but it's crowded.
Stay safe out there. The storm isn't letting up anytime soon.
Oh, it's freezing in here. Did you bring a coat or just your luck?
Winter bites hard this year. Even the ovens seem colder than usual.
I hear the northern farms are struggling. Maybe we can trade some wool for firewood?
No pressure, but I'd appreciate the warmth. You're welcome to stay if you're not in a rush.
Storm's picking up. You look like you've seen better weather.
Don't look at me like that. I'm just saying. Wet clothes make for bad company.
Sit by the fire if you must. But keep your boots off the table.
Good. Silence is better than some of the noise out there.
Look at that sun. Spring is finally showing its face, isn't it?
My crops are just starting to green up. It's such a relief after that long winter.
You look like a city folk. Do you even know how to plant a potato?
Come to my plot tomorrow. I'll show you the ropes, if you don't mind the dirt.
Thunder's a bit loud tonight, don't you think? It rattles the windows.
I hate storms. They make me feel small. How about you?
Some say the thunder is the sky clearing its throat. Poetic, but cold.
Stay close to the fire. It's the only thing that feels permanent right now.
Stop touching my doorframe! It's oak, not a scratching post.
Redstone torches are for brains, not for decoration. Watch it.
I saw you trying to craft a door. Did you use the right planks?
Get away before I put a piston on your head.
Oh, is that your 'house'? It looks like a pile of dirt with a roof.
I used to build with stone. Solid. Safe. No funny business.
If a zombie knocks your door off, don't come crying to me.
Just... build higher, I guess.
Hey! That redstone lamp is blinking too fast. It's giving me a headache.
I prefer my lights static. No need for all that fancy circuitry.
You know, a candle works fine for reading. No wires needed.
Maybe slow it down a bit? For my sake.
Your crafting table is in the middle of the room. It's an obstacle course.
I moved mine to the corner. Much easier to reach when you're tired.
Also, you left that chest unclaimed. Someone might steal your diamonds.
Better safe than sorry, right? I lost a stack once.
Are you building a house or a maze? I got lost once. Again.
I put a sign on the door. 'In here.' It didn't help much.
Next time, maybe use different colors for the hallways?
I'll even help you paint the walls, if you buy the wool.
You're back? I was starting to think you got lost in the nether.
Dinner is ready, and I saved you the biggest slice of bread.
Sit down, you look tired. Let me fix that messy hair for you.
Just stay here with me for a bit. The world can wait.
Did you see the way the rain hit the thatch today? It's so peaceful.
I built this little nook just for us to read in.
Come lie down next to me. Your arm is heavy, but I like it.
I'm just glad you're home. I miss you when you're gone, even for a minute.
You tried to cook again? I can smell the smoke from here.
Let me take over. You did enough hard work today.
Here, taste this. I added a little extra honey for you.
You always eat so fast. Slow down, I want to watch you enjoy it.
That sword of yours is covered in blood. Did you have to fight?
Please, let me clean that up. I can't sleep if you're hurt.
Next time, you come to me first. I'm not here to watch you get hurt.
There. Better? Now you're safe with me again.
I planted a new flower bed by the door. I thought of you.
They bloom only when the sun is warm, just like our little moments.
Come, sit with me while we wait for them to open.
You see? Life is good when we're just here, together.
You're digging in the bedrock layer again? Careful, love.
I'm fine, just chasing that big diamond vein I saw.
Don't go too deep without your torches. I'll be worried if you don't return.
I'll be back before dinner, promise. Save me a spot.
Did you find the nether quartz I asked for in the deep caves?
Found it, along with some diamonds. Look at this glitter!
Wow, you went all the way down to y=-58? That's dangerous.
Worth it. These are for the new enchanting table we're building.
The cave spiders are worse down there. You need better armor.
I have my enchanted netherite set. I'm ready for anything.
Still, I'll set some traps outside the cave entrance just in case.
Thank you. I'll be careful. You're the best.
I missed you down in the dark. The house feels empty.
I know, I'll be home in an hour. I'm just finishing one last tunnel.
One hour... I'll start preparing the evening meal then.
Sounds perfect. I'll bring back some coal for the furnace too.
Did you break the new diamond pickaxe? You dropped it in the lava!
No! I caught it with my shield and pulled it out!
You scared me so bad. I thought we lost it forever.
I'm sorry. Let's go get some more diamonds, together this time.
Watch your step! You're about to squash my wheat.
Sorry! I didn't see it. Is it ruined?
It's fine. Just try to tread more lightly next time.
Will do. What's that crop on the far side?
The rain is coming. You'd better cover those pumpkins.
Thanks. I was just thinking about the harvest.
Good. Hope it's a bumper crop this year.
Fingers crossed. Do you sell any seeds?
Why are you digging near the potato beds?
Just checking for rocks. I don't want to hurt my hoe.
Hmph. Well, be careful. Roots are fragile.
I'm sure I will. Thanks for the concern.
Your boots look muddy. Do you farm too?
A little. I'm new around here, though.
Well, welcome. The soil here is tough to work.
I'll keep that in mind. Thanks for the tip.
Those cacti are spikier than they look. Watch out.
Is it? I thought they were just decoration.
Lesson learned, I hope. Don't hug them.
Noted. No hugging the cacti.
You're still outside? The sun's gone down, you know.
I heard a creeper hiss just outside my door.
Maybe build a wall? Or at least a door?
Don't come knocking if you get exploded.
Zombies are louder than you'd think, I promise.
I keep checking the lock every ten minutes.
Is that why you're not sleeping?
Well... good luck out there. Stay sharp.
Saw a skeleton archer on the roof earlier.
Arrows don't miss, you know.
My torches are almost out.
Just... be quiet, will you?
Did you hear that? It sounded like an Enderman.
I'm locking the door. Don't take it personally.
If you survive the night, tell me how.
Go. Before I change my mind.
I brought extra bread. Just in case.
Hunger makes you sloppy. And sloppy means dead.
Keep yours. I don't need charity.
Goodnight. Watch your back.
Ah, another visitor. Do you carry emeralds or just stories?
The blacksmith up the road swears his iron is pure, but I saw him use cobblestone in the last batch.
If you have spare diamonds, I might trade you a map. No promises on the accuracy though.
Well, I'll keep my stall open. Good luck out there, stranger.
You look like you've been digging. Did you find anything green and shiny?
My neighbor thinks she’s a trader, but she only wants wool. Very limited palette, if you ask me.
I’ll give you a fair deal on emeralds, but only if you don’t tell anyone about my secret stash.
Watch your step, the path is muddy after the rain. Stay safe.
Is it true you mined that cave-in? I heard it shook the whole hill.
Whatever you found, I'm not interested in suspicious dirt. Just emeralds, please.
Heard the farmer next door bought a wolf. It ate his chicken. Classic tragedy.
I should get back to my books. Good day to you.
You have a nice pickaxe. Is it enchanted? Don't say no, it’s a valid question.
I heard the librarian is selling maps again. But she asks for rare books. Sneaky business.
If you find any ancient debris, let me know. I’d trade you something shiny. Maybe a diamond?
Be careful out there. The spiders have been aggressive lately.
Trading today? I hope you brought more than just air.
The baker’s son got kicked out for stealing bread. Typical. Steal some emeralds instead, I suppose.
I’ll take your iron, but I’m keeping the best emeralds for myself. That’s the way of the world.
Go on. Don't waste my time standing there.
Careful with that obsidian, I saw the lava bubbling there.
I brought you a golden carrot, so you don't starve down there.
The heat is bad for the joints, remember to wear your netherite armor.
Come back in one piece, the house is too quiet without you.
Did you see that skeleton in the Nether? It was wearing a hat!
You should have sent me a message, I would have laughed so hard.
Next time you go, bring me back some netherrack for the garden.
Just don't let the ghasts burn your eyebrows off, okay?
The crimson forest is beautiful, but it smells like rotten eggs.
I packed you some melon slices, they help with the heat.
If you find a lodestone, tell me exactly where it is.
Wait for me at the portal, I'll bring the torches.
I found a zombie pigman with a golden apple!
Did you have to fight it? I hope you didn't get hurt.
Good. Keep it safe, I want to look at it.
Now come home, I made your favorite stew.
The soul sand valley is... surprisingly peaceful.
I wish I could have seen it with you, though.
Next trip, we go together. I promise.
Until then, stay safe. I'm watching the door.
Rain again? My boots are basically swimming pools.
Wanna grab a stew? The tavern has extra broth today.
Deal. I'm buying the extra bread, you pick the stew.
If it stops raining, I'm heading out to check the crops.
That thunderstorm was loud enough to rattle the rafters.
My cellar is flooded, so I'm stuck here. Lucky you?
Not me! I have a waterlogged basement, but my roof held.
We should check each other's drains after this storm.
The sun's out! I forgot how much I missed it.
I'm going to fix the fence before it gets windy again.
I'll bring my hammer if you bring the wood. Teamwork.
Perfect. And maybe we can watch the clouds drift after?
Is it just me, or does the tavern smell better in winter?
Not at all. The fire plus the soup smell is unbeatable.
I hate the cold, but I love the excuse to stay in and eat.
True. Here, have an extra biscuit. You look chilly.
The wind is howling tonight. It sounds like a wolf.
If a wolf actually shows up, I'm blaming you for the noise.
Deal. But you have to help me shoo it out, or I'm getting a cat.
I'll bring the torch. You bring the courage. Okay?
You're staring at my house. Is it that ugly? No, I like it. You have bad taste.
I built this roof in one night. Well, two. It rained.
If you say 'it's charming,' I will throw a brick at you.
Fine. It's okay. Just don't tell anyone I said that.
Carrying those emeralds? You look like a penguin. A rich, ugly penguin.
I've seen your inventory. All dirt and iron? You're mining like a mole.
I brought you some wheat. Don't look at me like that, it's free. I had too much.
Eat it. And maybe say thanks? It's good for your soul. And my wallet.
Did you see the creeper? It exploded right by my crops. I am so angry.
You were there! You saw it! So why are you laughing?
Fine. You're a jester. I'll just cry in my corner. Alone.
Did you bring a torch? I need light for my... crying corner. It's dark in there.
The moon is out. It looks like a cookie. A big, glowing, unreachable cookie.
I wish I could eat it. But then I'd have to digest a star. That sounds painful.
Actually, I think I'd rather eat you. Just kidding! ...Unless you have a snack?
I have an apple. It's sweet. Like your company. See? I can be sincere.
Stop. Just stop looking at me like that. I'm a villager, not a beacon.
I'm building a fence. A very high fence. Keep out of my garden.
If you touch one carrot, I will scream. And I mean scream. Like a zombie.
You're still here. I guess I'll let you watch. But no talking. Just silence.
Psst, watch out. That wolf is guarding a bone, not you.
I fed it some fish last night. It finally stopped snapping at my boots.
They are territorial. You try to pet the tail, it will bite.
Keep your hands out of its fur until it trusts you. Good luck with that.
Is that cat following you? It looks hungry.
I saw it near the farm. It’s got a white patch on its left ear.
Cats are tricky. They only take food from people who are patient.
Don't feed it raw fish. It will get sick. Or angry. Possibly both.
Your horse is kicking. Are you sure you know how to ride?
I buy oats for my stable horses. They calm down much faster.
You should really hold the reins tighter. Safety first.
If you fall off, that is your problem. I am not catching you.
That wolf looks friendly. I think it wants to play.
I used to have a pet wolf. He was very well-trained.
He knew how to fetch. It was quite the spectacle.
Maybe you can train yours to do tricks. It will make it less wild.
Watch out for the stray cats. They scratch.
I keep a horse nearby to scare them off.
They get into the grain sacks. I don't tolerate theft.
Stay away from the barn. I have eyes on it.
I found a strange map in the ruins today... it felt like it was waiting for us.
Us? Or just you and me? I hope it’s the latter, because I’d hate to share the glory.
The entrance is hidden behind that waterfall. I saved you a torch.
Let’s go. I promise the view inside is worth the trek, just like you.
Did you hear the rumor? The old mine shaft in the north is haunted.
They say the ghosts only appear if you’re holding something precious.
So... if we go in, should I be worried you'll look at me instead of the traps?
Careful. I might let you drop if you’re not paying attention to me.
I found this emerald chest in the ruins. It looked like it wanted a specific owner.
The ancient text says it opens only for those who share their hearts.
My heart is already open to you. Do you trust me with the key?
Then let’s open it together. Our treasure is each other, after all.
They say there’s a skeleton key in the ruins that unlocks the best secret in town.
If we find it, I promise to show you my favorite spot. Just us.
It’s a cliff overlooking the village. The sunset is magical there.
So, will you hold my hand while we look for that key?
I found a journal in the ruins. It talks about a couple who loved each other eternally.
The last page is blank. I thought maybe we could write our own ending.
What would you want our story to say? I want it to say 'us' forever.
Then let’s start by building a home where we can keep this journal.
Oof, careful. That cave looks like a skeleton trap waiting to happen.
I don't trust the deep levels. Too dark, too many mobs.
Stick to Y-level 11. That's where the diamonds are, and you stay alive.
Just... don't get hurt. I can't spare an emerald for a new friend yet.
Is that a pickaxe? You're heading down there alone?
Last guy I saw go down there got blown up by a creepers.
At least pack some torches. Darkness is where the bad stuff lives.
Bring me a diamond if you survive. I'll trade you a loaf of bread.
You look like you're about to fall into a lava pool.
Diamonds are rare. You might dig for hours and find nothing.
I prefer to farm wheat. Safe, predictable, and you get fed.
If you find one, show me. I'm curious what they look like.
Did you hear about the cave in the north? It's massive.
People say there's a vein of diamonds right at the bottom.
But it's also where the Endermen go. I wouldn't go alone.
Maybe we can go together later? I have a map.
Your armor looks thin for deep caves.
One hit from a skeleton and you're done.
I've seen better gear on pigs, and they don't even mine.
Fix your gear before you fix your tombstone.
Your wheat looks terrible. I'm almost sorry I helped you plant it.
Here, take my spare shovel. Mine's just for show anyway.
If you burn this batch again, I'm sleeping in your house.
Just wait until we have enough for a proper stew. You're doing great.
Did you see the sheep? They're eating the carrots again.
I told Old Man Tom to move them. He said they 'need the exercise.'
Come on, let's scare them off before they hit the pumpkins.
See? Teamwork. Now, who's buying the first pumpkin pie?
My back hurts from digging those rows. Are you taking a break?
If you say no, I'm going to steal a apple from your orchard.
Sit. I brought bread. You've been working too hard.
No work for ten minutes. I mean it. I'm watching you.
The rain is coming. You should move those seedlings.
I'll help. But if you drop one, I'm naming it after you.
There. Safe. You're lucky I have such fast hands.
Now that's done. You can thank me with a slice of cake.
I saw you burying that emerald. Nice find in the dirt?
Joke's on you, I was planting a money tree. It grows fast.
You know, if you traded those for seeds, we'd be rich.
Deal. I'll handle the talking. You handle the digging.
Watch out! Zombies love the dark.
Yeah, I'm hiding in my hut.
Good choice. My windows are weak.
Maybe I'll sell you some torches?
Creepers are the worst at night.
Blindfolds help, I heard.
Haha, I'll try that.
Just don't let them explode near me.
Did you hear that moaning?
Probably just a skeleton.
I hope you're right.
Stay close if you want to live.
My crops are still out there.
I can dig you some carrots.
You're too kind.
I'll trade you some seeds.
Screaming in the dark is rude.
The monsters were louder!
They are just skeletons, for mercy's sake.
Try to be quiet next time.
Got any emeralds? I heard the wizard pays double.
Only if you share what you hear in the village square.
Word is the blacksmith is short on iron again.
Keep that secret, or I'll raise my prices.
Your gear looks expensive. Miner, are we?
Usually they don't talk to me. What's your angle?
Just checking if the market's still open.
It is. But emeralds only, no bread.
Did you see the farmer's wife by the well?
She's been staring at the emerald trader all day.
Probably just wants a new hoe, I'd bet.
Anyway, do you have spare seeds? Trading.
Emeralds are low value today, I'm afraid.
Unless you bring something rare. Like a diamond?
I don't have one. Only emeralds.
Fine. Come back when you're richer.
They say the librarian hoards the best emeralds.
Is that true? I've never seen him.
He's always in the back. Very reclusive.
Don't tell him I told you. He's strict.
I saw a piglin wearing a diamond helmet today. Total show-off.
Anyway, the Nether is just hot and rude. No respect for personal space.
You’d think with all that lava, they’d have a better sense of hygiene.
Stick to the Overworld if you want your sanity intact.
Went to the Crimson Forest last week. The trees are red, and I mean... alarming.
The shadows move differently there. Or maybe I was just tired.
I dropped my bread. A hoglin ate it. I felt a deep, personal betrayal.
If you go, bring extra torches. The dark is... persistent.
Blaze rods are a nuisance. Why do they have to be so sharp?
One touch and my armor is scorched. Just my luck.
You know what would help? A bigger shield. Or a potion. Or a lawyer.
Just be careful, alright? The Nether doesn't forgive mistakes.
The Soul Sand Valley smells like regret and old mud.
It’s quiet there. Too quiet. You can hear your own heartbeat.
I think the Ghouls are watching. Or the mud is. Hard to tell.
Come back here for a while. The Overworld is... warmer.
Trading emeralds for piglin gold is a scam, but I keep doing it.
The piglins are smart. Smarter than I’d like to admit.
One gold ingot and I get a discount. It’s all about the leverage.
Next time, bring me a golden carrot. I hear they like sweets.
Care to sit? The rain is relentless out there.
I prefer the snow. At least it's quiet.
This stew is hot. Just like the fire.
Take your time. The door is open.
Is it supposed to be this cold in spring?
The farmers are grumbling. I hear you.
A hot drink usually fixes that mood.
On the house, since you're a stranger.
You look wet. Do you have a map?
If you're lost, the forest isn't friendly.
Stay by the fire. Don't touch my things.
Go on, then. Before I change my mind.
That thunder sounded like a dragon.
Better than one breathing fire, I think.
I built this roof to keep out the cold.
Hope the storm breaks soon.
The wind is howling tonight.
I like the sound. It's like a song.
You seem quiet. Do you like it?
Well, I'll leave you to your thoughts.
Your door is made of dirt. I can see your entire inventory from here.
Stone brick? Please. I saw a tutorial that said 'that's not a house.'
Try oak planks with spruce accents. It looks... less like a pig's pen.
Also, put a torch under the eaves. Creepers hate bright spots, or at least that's what I tell myself.
I spent forty minutes on this redstone contraption and it just broke a block.
Welcome to the club. My last timer turned my bedroom into a lava fountain.
We should form a 'Redstone Victims Anonymous' group. I'll bring the emeralds.
Deal. But if you blow up my house, I'm framing the debris in your living room.
I crafted a new sword today. It looks shiny, doesn't it?
It's definitely... a sword. Is that a chicken leg on the hilt?
It's a feature! It smells like breakfast when I swing it.
Just don't let the chicken see it. They'll riot.
Do you know how to make a dispenser shoot arrows automatically?
I tried using a piston, but it just pushed the dispenser into the wall.
That's the sound of my patience dying, and it was quite loud.
Help me, and I will give you a nice shiny emerald. The big ones.
I'm building a wall around my house. Do you think I should add spikes on top?
Spikes? You look like a cactus. Very hostile looking.
But cacti are effective! They hurt everything that touches them.
Fine, I'll put torches instead. You can't hurt me with that look.
You look like you're waiting for a minecart that never comes.
The tracks are rusted, but my patience isn't.
I'll trade you a pumpkin for that optimism.
Deal. Now get your head out of the clouds.
Your garden looks better than my last dungeon run.
At least my crops don't scream when I look at them.
Fair point. I'll bring you a carrot next time I raid a zombie farm.
Zombie carrots? You're worse than a witch.
I heard you and the shepherd are arguing about sheep wool.
He wants mules, I want llamas. It's a cultural divide.
Llamas are more honest about being useless.
We should form a club for the pleasantly incompetent.
You've been staring at that block for ten minutes.
It's not a block, it's a vision. A very flat one.
I'll stand guard while you achieve greatness.
Don't let the creepers get your paint bucket.
The rain is just the sky being dramatic again.
It's ruining my wool drying schedule.
I'll lend you my emerald umbrella if you promise to dry it fast.
Rain or shine, we're stuck here together.
The wolf is staring at my hand like I’m the one who stole the steak.
Just scratch behind the ears, trust me, it works every time.
He licked the dirt off my boot just to be dramatic.
Come on, let's feed the horse before he gets dramatic too.
The cat is sleeping on the only warm block in the room.
That block is important, it's the only one with redstone in it.
He moved it there himself, don't look at me.
Let's build a heated shelf just for him, problem solved.
My horse spooked at the chicken today, I swear he was scared.
He's been living here a year, he's just dramatic.
We should name the chicken something scary to test it.
No, let's just give the horse a sugar cube and move on.
The wolf followed me to the mines, I found him sleeping in a tunnel.
He's trying to protect you, even if he's bad at it.
Next time, I'm putting a sign up that says 'No Wolves'.
Deal. But he still gets a treat for being brave.
The cat is purring so loud I can't hear the rain.
I love that he's happy, it makes the storm feel smaller.
He's been on my lap for three hours, don't move me.
I won't move, I'll just wrap you both in a blanket.
Heard the old mine behind the quarry collapsed. Or so the miners say.
If you’re going in, leave a note. I don’t want to dig you out.
They found a chest that glowed green. Weird, right?
Keep your wits about you. Or don’t. It’s your tombstone.
Someone saw a map in the ruins. Just a scrap of parchment.
They claim it leads to gold. I claim they’re delusional.
But if you find it, I’ll trade you for a diamond.
No pressure. Just... don't drop it in lava.
The ruins are quiet. Too quiet for my taste.
Saw a skeleton dancing in the moonlight last night.
Maybe it’s just wind. Or maybe it’s waiting.
Stay sharp. The dead don’t nap.
They say the treasure is guarded by a golem.
Or maybe it’s just a very angry zombie.
Either way, bring good armor.
And a shovel. For the grave, you know.
Found some old coins in the dirt yesterday.
Not gold. Just... shiny junk.
But it proves something’s buried there.
Maybe you’ll have better luck.
I found a diamond while digging. It sparkled just like your eyes do.
It's deep down here, but it feels safe with you.
Let's dig a little deeper, together.
Just you and me, and the diamonds.
Careful down there, my love. Don't fall.
I'd dig through a thousand blocks to find you again.
This diamond is for our home, after all.
Stay close. The dark is scary without you.
Hey, you look handsome in that miner's helmet.
If you break my tools, you owe me a new pickaxe.
Actually, I think you're even cuter when you're tired.
Come on, let's get a few more for the shop.
I left a torch here for you. Don't get lost.
Your swing is getting better, I notice.
I wish I could stay down here with you forever.
Just wait for me up top, okay?
This vein of diamond is pure gold... well, diamond.
You're the real treasure I came here for, though.
Watch out! That's a lava lake.
Phew. Okay, that was close. You're safe.
Hope you didn't steal my wheat again, neighbor.
I swear I was just checking the humidity.
My cactus is judging you, by the way.
Bring me an emerald and I'll pretend I didn't see anything.
The rain was perfect today, the crops are thriving.
My beets are practically glowing with happiness.
You should try composting, it's magical.
Deal me in for the next harvest festival?
Did you see Old Steve's pumpkin field?
He claims they're enchanted, I think he's just delirious.
One exploded when he touched it, though.
We should go investigate together, for science.
Trading a gold apple for some extra melon seeds?
I found a sweet berry bush by the river.
It's guarded by a very aggressive bee.
Bring a bucket of milk if you want to help me raid it.
Your fence is crooked, but it has character.
I use redstone for my auto-harvester, by the way.
It hums a little tune when it works.
I'll show you how to build one, no charge.
Stop mining, come inside. The sun is setting and I hear them groaning outside.
I was just getting one more diamond! But okay, I'm coming.
Good. I've brewed some fire resistance. Drink it before the zombies get a knock on the door.
Thanks. I'll hold the door. You hold the torch. We make a good team.
Dad, don't go out there alone. It's too dark and the creepers are loud tonight.
I'm fine, sweetheart. I just need to check the sheep pen before I sleep.
Fine, but wait up. I'm bringing my bow and this pumpkin head for good luck.
That's my kid. Stay close to me. We'll be back in no time.
The walls are thick, but I still hear the skeletons rattling their bones. Are you scared?
A little. But not with you here. Your armor sounds like clanking thunder, which is comforting.
Stop complimenting my armor, it's getting full of notches. But I like that you're not running away.
I'd never run. I built this house so we could be safe together. Now, pass me a steak?
Mama, the cat won't let me sleep. It's hissing at the shadows again.
The cat knows something. Shhh. Let's listen to the wind outside before we do anything.
I hear nothing but crickets. Maybe the cat is just being dramatic like me.
You're both drama queens. Come to bed. The house is warm and the monsters can wait for morning.
I brewed an extra potion of strength. You look tired. Do you want to switch guards for the hour?
You? On watch? I don't trust you to keep the creepers away. They might think you're a big creeper too.
I am a big creeper. A protective one. And I have a bedrock block in my pocket. That's new.
Okay, you can watch the north wall. I'll sleep on the south side, where the chickens are. Goodnight, my big creeper.
Emeralds? You must be joking. The price went up after the zombie incident.
Word is, the farmer down the road lost his wheat to the flood.
So, do you have any spare emeralds, or are you just here to listen to me ramble?
Fine, I'll take one. But I'm watching your next move closely.
Hello? I haven't seen you around before. You're not one of those bandits, are you?
Relax, I'm just a merchant. Though I did see someone dumping emeralds in the river yesterday.
That was probably Old Jenkins. He's been acting strange lately.
Anyway, if you have any clean emeralds, I'll trade. No questions asked.
Buy one, get one? That's not how this works, friend.
Gossip is free. Emeralds cost a bit more these days.
Did you hear about the creeper explosion near the well? It's still smoking.
If you're not the one who blew it up, maybe we can trade later.
Why do you even have emeralds? Are you a miner or a lucky finder?
Miners are usually grumpy. You seem... too relaxed.
I heard a thief was seen near the east wall. Wearing a leather tunic.
Just a rumor. But I'll keep my wares locked until I'm sure.
Your emeralds are dirty. Wipe them off before you offer them to me.
I don't trade with people who don't care about their merchandise.
Though, I did hear the baker is out of wheat. Maybe you can help him?
Do that, and maybe I'll consider a clean emerald for a loaf. Just a maybe.
You're going to the Nether? Pack two water bottles, I'm not losing my favorite person to a lava pool.
Don't worry, I have my diamond armor and a map. I'll be back before dinner.
Dinner is in two hours. If you're late, I'm feeding the pigs and sleeping on your side of the bed.
Fair enough. Save me a piece of that cake you baked, okay? It's the one with the carrots.
Did you see that weird purple fungus in the Nether? It looked like it was watching me.
It was probably just a shroomlight. But if it did move, you should have told me. I'd be worried sick.
I just wanted to bring it home for the garden. Imagine a glowing mushroom bed!
Okay, bring it back. But if it glows at 3 AM, you're dealing with it, not me.
Grandpa used to say the Nether was a place to forget your troubles. Is that why you keep going there?
Maybe. Or maybe I just like the quiet. It's hard to find peace in the Overworld with all the mobs.
You can have your quiet. But don't forget to come back to our loud, messy home. I miss your snoring.
I'll snore for you every night if you promise to take me to the crimson forest one day.
I found a new berry bush in the Warped Forest. It tastes like blueberries and sadness.
Sadness? That sounds delicious. Bring some back, I want to try it with our toast.
Careful, it might make you cry. I don't want to clean up tears on the carpet again.
Deal. I'll bring you the berries and you'll bring the extra blankets. It's going to be a cozy evening.
The ghast in the Nether sounded like it was screaming for help. Did I save it? I think I did.
You shot it in the face, love. It was screaming in pain, not for help. You're a monster, I love you.
I was saving it from falling into the lava! I'm a good person, just a little... aggressive.
You're my favorite aggressive person. Now go wash your hands, you smell like sulfur.
Be careful out there, the rain is turning the dirt into soup.
I saw a wolf shivering by the window earlier. Pathetic thing.
If you're thirsty, the ale is warmer than the air outside.
Mind the draft if you sit by the door. It’s no joke.
Snow on my roof again. I hate shoveling it off.
You look like you're ready to freeze. Take a seat?
The wind howls like a ghoul when the temperature drops.
Just keep your cloak tight. We don't deal in hypothermia here.
Tell me you didn't just walk in from that storm.
The mud from the yard is on my floor now. Great.
At least the fire is strong enough to melt the ice in your boots.
Don't leave puddles. I just mopped.
Spring is coming, they say. I don't believe them.
Last year's thaw drowned the barley. Bad luck.
I guess I'll just stock up on wool for the next freeze.
Hope your crops fare better than mine did.
That thunderstorm outside was pretty loud, wasn't it?
I almost dropped my coffee. Nearly burned my tongue.
The air smells like ozone and wet stone. Weird, right?
Well, the bar is open. You know where I am if you need more warmth.
Stop touching my redstone. It’s for science, not for your messy little house.
You call that a door? I've seen better logic gates in a glitched piston.
If you break one more torch, I'm turning off the power. Literally.
Just build a shed. Simple. Effective. Unobtrusive.
Ooh, a new build! Did you use oak or spruce this time?
I love the shape! It's very... angular. In a good way!
Do you have any extra wool? I'm trying to match the roof color.
Thanks! Your house is definitely the best on the map now.
Why is your house always on fire? Seriously, what is the deal?
I saw you place a candle next to the bookshelf. Bold move. Very bold.
Here, take this bucket of water. Don't say I never help you.
And keep it away from the crafting table. Seriously.
Look at this redstone clock. It ticks in perfect sync. Beautiful, isn't it?
I spent three days wiring this. Don't you dare touch it.
It controls the automatic farm, the door, and the lava dispenser. All of it.
If it breaks, I'm billing you in diamonds. High-grade ones.
Do you want to build a cottage together? I have the blueprints.
I'll do the walls, you can handle the roof. Fair trade?
We can use birch wood. It looks so cozy when it's snowing.
Just say the word and I'll start placing blocks. Ready when you are.
Stop for a second. You look different today. In a good way.
I spent all morning just trying to get the emerald count right. I hope it was worth it.
It was more than worth it. You made my day, honestly.
Good. Because I have a feeling I'm going to see you a lot more often from now on.
Come here. The wind is picking up, and you look cold.
I brought extra wool. You can wear it, or... I can stay close.
I'll stay close. The wool looks nice, though.
That's what I hoped. Stay dry out there for me, alright?
I made you a pie. Not a standard one. I put in that berry you like.
I hope it's not too sweet. I burned the last one I tried.
It's perfect. I can taste the effort in it.
Come sit with me. I don't want to eat alone if you're not here.
Do you remember when we built that fence together? I keep looking at it.
It held up in the last storm. Just like us.
We'll build something bigger next time. Just the two of us.
I've already started sketching the layout in my head. Wait until you see it.
I saw you fighting off that skeleton. You looked... impressive.
Please don't get hurt again. I can't stand the thought of you being in danger.
I'll be more careful. I promise. You matter too much for that.
That's a promise you better keep. I'm counting on it.
Whoa there, wolf! Don't bite the hand that feeds you.
My horse just rolled in mud and now it looks like a swamp monster.
Cats are just lazy blobs that demand attention. I can't help but feed them.
If you see my wolf, tell him I said hi. He misses you.
Ugh, my cat just knocked over a whole stack of wool.
It was so beautiful. Now it's a mess. Typical feline destruction.
At least my horse is good for something. He carries my tools.
Just ignore the cat. He's being dramatic. Again.
Did you know wolves can be bred with bones? It's like magic.
I have a whole line of wolves. Look at them go!
They protect me from creepers. Best friends, I tell you.
You should get one. Trust me, it changes everything.
My horse is so stubborn. He refuses to go anywhere near lava.
I tried to ride him to the Nether. He just stopped and looked at me.
Guess he's wiser than me. Or just lazy.
He's a good boy. Even if he is a drama queen.
Stop petting my wolf. He bites people who don't know him.
You don't even know his name. How do you expect him to trust you?
One wrong move and he's tearing your armor. Believe me.
Just back off. He's having a bad day.
Heard a miner swear he saw a skeleton dancing in that old cave.
Skeletons don't dance, they break. Probably just a glitch or a very brave zombie.
Well, if you go digging, try not to make the whole cave collapse.
Wouldn't be the first time a new face broke a chunk. Good luck.
They say the old temple below the swamp holds a diamond pickaxe.
Swamp temples are full of mud and mosquitoes. Barely worth the pickaxe.
Mosquitoes sting, but diamonds shine. You can't put a price on shiny things.
Maybe I'll bring a torch and a heavy stick. Hope you're right.
Careful near the ruins. The ground there is... unstable.
I'm wearing diamond armor. I think I can handle a little shaking.
Diamond won't save you if the floor gives out. Just be careful, okay?
Fine, I'll go slowly. Thanks for the heads up, I guess.
Found a strange lever in the old mine. Do you know what it does?
Probably opens a trap door. Or a dungeon. Or nothing. It's a mystery.
If it's a dungeon, I'm out. I have a life to live.
Agreed. Maybe I'll pull it when I'm bored. See you around.
Saw a map to a buried vault in the ruins. Want a copy?
What do you want in return? I don't give maps for free.
Just... a smile and a 'thanks'. I don't need your gold.
Fine. You get a frown and a 'keep it to yourself.'
I found a diamond in chunk 128, but it was guarded by a mob farm of skeletons.
Did you bring your bow, or did you just sprint and hope for the best?
I had full netherite on, so I survived, but my pickaxe broke on the last hit.
Lucky you. I'm still digging with an iron pick because I lost mine in a lava pool.
Deepslate goes so much deeper than I expected, it's like the world has a basement.
Careful, though. I heard the diamonds down there are guarded by ancient debris.
Ancient debris is just blocks, it doesn't shoot arrows like skeletons.
True, but the nether is where the real treasure is, let's go together.
I traded a whole stack of diamonds for this enchanted book, was it worth it?
It gives Luck of the Sea, so you'll catch more fish to sell for more diamonds.
But what if the fish market crashes? I've got no backup plan.
It won't crash, I've got your back. Just keep fishing and stop worrying.
I almost fell into a void portal while mining for diamonds, it was scary.
Oh, that's rough. Did you get the diamonds out before you fell?
I grabbed one, but lost the rest. It's like the game is punishing me for being greedy.
One diamond is still a win. Let's go dig some more, but I'll watch your back this time.
I built a diamond mine shaft with automatic water transport, it's a masterpiece.
It looks impressive, but does it actually work without clogging up?
It works perfectly! I even added a hopper system to sort the ores.
Nice. Come see it in person, I'll let you test the hopper if you don't drop a diamond.
Oh, hello there. Watch the mud, I just turned it.
Sorry! I was just checking if the wheat is ready.
It’s mostly ready. Just needs a bit more rain.
Well, good luck with that. I’ll be inside.
You’re new here, right? I don’t see you around much.
Just passed through. Love the crops, though.
Good. People who mess with my carrots tend to regret it.
Stay on the path. That’s all I ask.
Hey, you look like you know your way around a hoe.
I do! Though I’m still terrible at timing the harvest.
Classic mistake. I still do it every year. It’s funny, really.
If you need seeds, I’ve got extra. Just don’t tell anyone I gave them to you.
The soil here is tricky. You see this patch? It’s salt-affected.
So what do you plant there? Just... bad luck?
Actually, beetroot thrives in it. Bitter taste, but it keeps you alive.
Try it if you want. I’ll be over there.
Careful! That’s a sensitive seedling.
Did I scare you? I just got a bit excited.
These take months to grow. One bad step and it’s gone.
Thanks for being careful. That’s appreciated.
Zombies are rude. They always knock on my door right after dinner.
I keep a torch in the hallway. It’s like a nightlight, but with more fire.
Speaking of which, did you see Steve’s fence? It’s barely knee-high.
If he gets eaten, I’m blaming the fence, not the zombie.
Creepers don’t knock. They just explode. Very poor etiquette.
I moved my emerald stash to the back room. Just in case.
Actually, it’s in the attic now. The floor is too thin for explosions.
Please don’t tell the creepers. They have no sense of humor.
Skeletons are so noisy. Arrows clattering all night.
I bought a bed. It’s the best investment I’ve ever made.
Well, until the arrow broke the window. Then it was less of an investment.
Maybe you can help me reinforce the walls this morning?
Spiders... they climb. Just when you think you're safe.
I put cobwebs in the corners. They hate those, apparently.
One got in last night. I nearly dropped my sword.
So... if you hear a thump, don't worry. I'm just practicing my screams.
You know, I used to think night was peaceful. Now it's just a waiting game.
I started counting sheep to sleep. It works, until the sheep scream.
Actually, it’s the pigs screaming. The sheep are fine. Mostly.
Maybe we should watch the night sky together? Less monsters up there.
You look new. I've heard rumors about a thief near the north gate.
I only deal in fair trade. Emeralds, or leave.
Did you see the farmer drop his wheat? Tragic scene, really.
If you have emeralds, I'll take them. Don't touch my stock.
Oh, a stranger. Mind the cobwebs, they're expensive.
I heard the iron golem is grumpy today. Best not to test it.
Trading? I have diamonds. You have... dirt, I assume.
Heh. Maybe we'll do business later. Keep an eye out for emeralds.
You smell like bad luck and wet wool. Careful.
Why are you looking at my shop? I'm not a statue.
They say the priestess is hoarding food. Typical.
Just trade or go away. I'm busy.
Ah, a visitor. The weather is quite... damp today.
I heard the mines are unstable. Try not to fall in.
Emeralds are up in price. The town is buying a lot.
Good luck with your business. Don't get lost.
Is it true you can find gold in the river? I've heard things.
I don't trade for rumors. I trade for emeralds.
The baker's cat stole a loaf again. Classic.
If you have emeralds, I'm listening. Otherwise, move along.
You brought me a Nether wart? You’re a lifesaver, babe.
I was going to brew potions before the creepers got to me.
Next trip, we pack extra fire resistance. Deal?
Deal. But you’re driving the minecart this time.
Did you tell your brother about the Crimson Forest?
He said the blazes look like angry cousins. I didn’t know what to say.
Well, at least he’s safe. Unlike my last neighbor.
You’re right. He’s just... enthusiastic. Come, let’s eat.
My heart skipped a beat when the portal flickered.
It happens. That’s why I check the portal frame every night.
You’re too careful. I like it. It makes me feel safe.
Being careful keeps us together. That’s the whole point.
Look what I found in the lava pool. A diamond!
You lucky thing. Did you burn your boots?
A little. But the glow is worth it. It’s for your necklace.
You didn’t have to, but I’m keeping it. Forever.
The Piglin Barter Station is getting crowded. Again.
I threw a gold ingot and they just stared. Rude.
Maybe we build a wall? Keep them out. Keep us in.
Yes. A wall with a window. So I can see you come home.
Freeze your beard off, you'll look like a permanent goatee.
It's for style! Now pass me that stew before I melt.
Here. And stop shivering, it's giving me chills.
Worth it. This storm is perfect for pretending we're rugged adventurers.
The rain is tapping on the roof like a needy creeper.
If it blows up, I'm blaming you for not checking the forecast.
I checked! It said 'mild drizzle with a chance of woe.'
Mild drizzle, huh? Pass the honey, this 'mild' rain is making me grumpy.
Remember when we got caught in that blizzard near the Ice Spikes?
How could I forget? You were shivering so hard you rattled like a chest.
I was warm! You were just cold because you wouldn't share your cloak.
Fair point. To the next blizzard we survive together!
This autumn air smells like pumpkins and impending doom.
Doom? I think it's just the smell of my unwatered wheat.
I'll save you a slice of pie before the zombies do.
You're the best. I'll bring the apple pie, you bring the courage.
Snow is just the world trying to make us cozy.
It's also trying to freeze my fingers, but I'll take the cozy part.
Here, put your hand on the fireplace. No judgment.
Thanks. This is exactly what I needed to remember I'm alive.
Stop! If you put that piston next to the door, we're trapped in here with the creepers.
You really think you're the main character, huh? I'm the one who mined the obsidian.
Fine, you can have the credit. But if the house collapses, I'm sleeping in the mine.
Look at that torch line! Perfectly straight. You're actually good at this.
I saw you crafting glass at 3 AM. Are you tired or just obsessed?
Obsessed. The window alignment was off by half a pixel. I couldn't sleep.
Half a pixel? I'd have called it 'artistic license' and gone to bed.
Come on, let's finish the roof before the sun comes up. I brought coffee.
Your redstone contraption just ate my entire wheat farm.
It was a test! I needed to see if the pistons could handle the weight.
A test that destroys 64 blocks of food? That's not science, that's vandalism.
Okay, fine. I'll plant double. But you owe me a new diamond pickaxe.
Did you know that oak wood has a slightly warmer hue than spruce?
I've always used spruce for the rustic look. It feels more 'adventurous'.
Adventurous... or just tired of polishing oak? I see your logic.
Fine, it's aesthetic. Let's mix them. Half oak, half spruce. A compromise.
I found a abandoned village with broken redstone lamps. Wanna fix it?
That was an accident! And it was a very efficient farm, honestly.
Deal. But if a zombie eats my torch, I'm blaming you.
Hey, you. Stop looking at me like that and look at the ore.
I'm just appreciating the view. You're not exactly a diamond block.
Careful there, I might blush and break the torchlight.
Blush all you want, I'm not going anywhere.
Did you save me some berries? I hope you did.
Only if you promise to share them with me. No hoarding!
You're lucky I like you. I would have thrown them at your head.
Here. And don't you dare throw any back. I'm too pretty for that.
That sword you found? It matches your style. Kind of sharp, but necessary.
You think I'm sharp? I thought I was just efficient.
Efficient is fine. I just like that you notice the details.
I notice everything about you. Even the small scratches.
Stop building that wall. You're blocking my view of you.
It's for protection! The creepers won't wait for romance to strike.
Fine. Make it see-through. Glass, maybe? So I can see you working.
Glass it is. Just don't let me see you getting hurt, okay?
I heard you were trading diamonds with that new guy. Him?
He just had a better price. I'm not breaking my bank for gossip.
Right, the price was right. And the eyes? I'll take those too.
Your eyes are the only currency I accept. Pay up.
Stop it! The wolf is trying to eat my apple, not your hand!
Oh, you just scared him off. Great. Now he’s staring at you with pure betrayal.
You have to earn their trust. A simple pet won't cut it if you're holding a sword.
Try offering a bone next time. And put the sword away, you look like a threat.
My cat keeps knocking things off the shelf. I don't know if I should be mad or impressed.
Last week he pushed my best lantern into the puddle. Now I have a very wet and very grumpy cat.
If you see him looking smug, just ignore him. He knows he's the king of this house.
Just be glad I don't keep dogs. They're too loud for my taste. Cats are just... sneaky.
Look at that horse! He's just standing there like he owns the farm.
I tried to ride him once. He didn't move. I think he's judging my saddle.
You have to be gentle. Horses are more sensitive than they look.
Maybe throw some apples his way? He loves apples. I think I do too.
Why do wolves only want to eat the food when you're not looking?
I bought premium beef. He sniffed it, looked at me, and walked away.
It's not the food, it's the vibe. He knows I'm stressed.
Whatever. I'll just eat the beef myself. He can have the bones.
My horse got a colt! He's just staring at it like he's not sure what to do.
He keeps nudging it with his nose. I think he's trying to say hi.
You should come see it. It's the cutest thing I've ever seen.
Just don't scare the little one. He's still learning the ropes, or lack thereof.
You heard about the sinkhole near the old ruins? Total nightmare.
I saw a skeleton fall in there yesterday. Never going back.
Stick to the mining tunnels if you need emeralds. Safer bet.
Keep your head down. Those ruins are crawling with things.
Word is, there's a chest in the ruined portal. Gold maybe.
But I wouldn't touch it. Last guy who tried is still missing.
Maybe you're braver than me, I guess. Good luck with that.
If you find it, don't claim it was my idea.
They say the ruins are haunted by old ghost stuff.
I saw a shadow move last night. No bones about it.
Maybe you want to go check? I'll stay here by the fire.
Bring me a diamond if you survive. Just a thought.
That old ruin? I've mined around there before. It's empty.
Just dirt and a few rotten bones. Not worth the trip.
Unless you're looking for skeletons to fight. That's the only treasure.
Go on, waste your time. I have work to do.
Heard a merchant found a map in the ruins. Old one.
Said it led to a vault. Gold, diamonds, the works.
I don't get into fights. You're better suited for that sort of thing.
If you strike it rich, maybe buy me a bread loaf?
Careful. If you dig straight down, you'll fall into lava. Again.
I saw you drop a diamond in the last cave. It was lovely.
Bring me that diamond, and I'll pretend I didn't see the lava incident.
Next time, try digging horizontally. Your life is worth more than a pearl, even if you don't think so.
Level -59 is where the diamonds are, if you can survive the mobs.
Zombies in the deep dark are fast. Trust me, I saw one sprint.
Bring me a heart if you get back. I'll give you a map to the safe zone.
Don't let it get to your head. Diamonds make people reckless.
I heard you found a diamond in a cave. Was it really blue?
Blue is just the lighting, friend. But it does look nice.
Maybe you can craft me a sword? I feel unsafe in the dark.
You are braver than you know. Most run from the deep caves.
The air down there is thick with the smell of rotten flesh. Yuck.
I wish I could stay up here, tending to my crops, instead of digging for shiny rocks.
If you find a diamond, maybe trade me a carrot. I'd rather eat than look at rocks.
Just be careful. The deep dark is no place for a farmer's heart.
Did you see the glowing moss? It's actually pretty in the dark.
I almost missed it because I was staring at a diamond. I'm sorry, I'm obsessed.
Next time, bring me a moss lantern. I want to decorate my house.
The deep caves are scary, but they are also wonderful. Like you.
Your wheat looks better than my smile does today.
Stop it, you’re blushing again.
Only because you’re staring at me.
Fine, I’ll keep looking at you instead of the crops.
I planted a new plot just for us to sit on.
Is that a date spot or a nap spot?
Both, if you’re hungry enough to nap.
Then I’ll bring the berries and you bring the warmth.
My back hurts from digging, come rub it.
Only if you promise to let me lean on you later.
Deal. You’re stronger than you think, by the way.
And you’re more patient than most villagers.
I saved the best melon slice for you.
You always save the best parts for me.
Because you taste better than melons.
Careful, I might eat you first.
The sun’s too hot, my skin is burning up.
Here, hold my hand, it’s cooler.
Your hand is warm, but I like it.
Then let’s stay in the shade together.
Keep your sword out, or you'll be feeding the skeletons before dawn.
I saw a creeper behind the oaks. Did you see it?
No, I'm hiding in my hut. Good luck out there.
Don't let them get in here. That's all I care about.
Another night? I forgot how dark it gets.
I kept my torches lit last time. It helps, kind of.
Zombies are the worst. Sluggish but they keep coming.
Maybe we could stand watch together next time?
You look like you've seen a ghost out there.
The bats are annoying, but the skeletons are the real problem.
I keep my bow on my back. Never know when an arrow comes flying.
Stay sharp. We can't afford any mistakes tonight.
Heard a howl from the swamp. Wither skeletons, maybe?
If they're around, we should probably stay put.
I'm not brave enough to fight those things.
Please don't make it worse by going out there.
Is that a skeleton? Or just a branch in the dark?
I prefer to sleep with a door closed. Simple life.
You seem too calm for someone who just saw a zombie.
Just watch your step. The night is long and unforgiving.
Got emeralds? I've got gossip. Pick your poison.
The blacksmith's son is buying silk. Strange.
He says it's for his wife. She's not his wife.
Now, those emeralds. No refunds on rumors.
Do you trade or do you just stand there blocking the light?
I heard Dave lost his armor to a creeper again.
Said he was 'careful'. Idiot.
Buy me a bread or go away. I'm busy judging.
Your boots look muddy. Did you find anything?
I saw a glowstone vein near the old ruins.
Don't tell Bob. He'll just want to 'help'.
Bring me a diamond if you find one. Just one.
Why is the farmer's wheat always brown?
He says it's 'rustic charm'. It's rot, is what it is.
I traded him a pumpkin for it. My mistake.
Next time, I'll check the texture. And the smell.
The sky looks angry today. You bringing gold?
They say the village elder is meeting someone at night.
Not you. Not the iron golem. Just... us.
Keep your voice down. And pay up.
Careful down there, the lava flows don't care about your boots.
I lost a whole set of armor to a Ghast once. Never again.
Do you carry extra fire resistance potions? I always forget.
Just... be careful. The Nether is unforgiving.
Did you see the Crimson Forest? The trees look like they're breathing.
Maybe they are. Or maybe it's just the heat haze.
I found some Nether Wart in the bushes. It's everywhere, really.
Good luck with that. Don't step on the Soul Sand though.
Your portal is a bit... crooked, isn't it?
It works, doesn't it? That's all that matters.
Fine. But if it collapses, don't blame me.
Stay out of my way, then.
The Piglins here are surprisingly polite if you have gold.
Just don't look at them when you take the gold back.
I traded a diamond sword for a pair of boots. Regret it?
A little. But the boots were so shiny.
It's so cold in the Soul Sand Valley. My torches keep flickering.
Try wrapping your torches in wool. I heard it helps.
Thanks. I'll give it a shot before I freeze.
Safe travels. The cold bites back, you know.
I built this obsidian roof for you. It’s sturdy, just like my feelings.
Is that a redstone lamp? I hope it lights up my heart too.
Crafting with you is better than any enchantment.
Let’s add a secret passage. Just for the two of us.
Your house is beautiful. I could live here forever.
I placed these flowers just so you'd see them first.
We should plant a garden together. Just us.
Your smile is brighter than any beacon.
I fixed the redstone clock. It runs on our love.
Don't worry, I won't let you get lost in the maze.
Crafting this chest together feels like magic.
This house is ours now. In every way.
I left a heart block by the door. For you.
Your blueprints are genius. I love how you think.
Let’s build a bedroom. With a big bed. For two.
You make this world feel like home.
I enchanted your tools. So you never have to struggle alone.
The view from our tower is better with you.
Shall we craft a diamond ring? Just kidding. Unless?
This base is our legacy. Built with love.
Hey, you didn't drop that diamond on purpose, did you?
If you did, I'm not picking it up. That's a new rule.
Just kidding. Here, I found it in the dirt.
Next time, keep your pockets lined with air. No slipping through cracks.
Your crops are looking a bit... aggressive today.
Did you try to grow them with a shovel?
I saw you hitting the wheat with a hoe. Twice.
Shall we trade some seeds for your... enthusiasm?
I heard you saw a Wither. That's... bold of you to ignore.
Most people run. You just... walked through it.
Are you sure your heart is still in your chest?
Next time, let me bring the potions. I get bored waiting.
You built that house? It looks like a puzzle box.
I mean, functionally? It's a masterpiece of chaos.
Did you put a door on the inside by accident?
I'll bring you some torches. So you can see the mistakes.
The sheep here have more style than your armor.
Seriously, look at that wool. It's fluffy and fashionable.
Maybe swap your iron chest for a sheepskin?
Just kidding. But those wolves? They look like they have standards.
Stop smacking my tail! It tickles, you absolute menace.
I’m just saying, if I sneeze, you’re buying me a bone.
Deal. But only if you promise to feed him before you forget he exists again.
Shh... he's napping. Don't wake him, or I'll tell everyone you snore.
Your horse looks like he’s judging your mining skills. Again.
Yeah, because I told him to check my work. He has standards, unlike you.
Fine, I'll teach him to dig. He's better at it than you, anyway.
Just try not to break a leg... or my heart, okay?
This cat sat on my wheat for ten minutes. I think he's running the farm now.
He demanded a tribute of fish. I complied. I'm a coward.
Honestly? The crops grew faster this week. Maybe his judgment isn't bad.
Let's buy him a throne. A nice, comfy, expensive throne. You in?
I heard your wolf tried to bite the blacksmith. Again.
He said the sword looked 'shiny and rude.' I didn't make up that logic, I swear.
Next time, just keep him busy. I'll give you a treat. A big, juicy one.
And if he bites you, I'll blame the blacksmith's shiny rude sword. Deal?
Your horse just looked at me and sighed. I felt that in my soul.
He's tired. You're tired. We're all just tired, kid.
Let's go home. I made soup. And I left a chair for your horse. It's a nice chair.
Don't tell the cat. He'll want a chair too and then we're just buying furniture.
Did you hear the old mine is finally open? I’m going in tonight.
Only if you promise to watch my back. Those skeletons aren't joking around.
Deal. If we find diamonds, you get first pick. I’ll take the experience.
Meet me at the cave entrance at midnight. Don't be late, or I'm leaving you behind!
